title: Sr. Systems Development Engineer , US Amazon Dedicated Cloud Security
descriptionHtml:
AWS Security is seeking a seasoned Senior Systems Development Engineer to join our team building next-generation infrastructure solutions for Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC). ADC extends the full power of AWS cloud infrastructure to customers, countries, and organizations with the most stringent security, compliance, and data sovereignty requirements — including government, defense, and regulated industries.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where your systems expertise and architectural decisions will directly shape the reliability, scalability, and security of infrastructure operating at global scale.

As a Senior Systems Development Engineer, you will own the design, implementation, and operational excellence of the systems and automation platforms that power Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC). You'll lead complex infrastructure initiatives end-to-end — from ambiguous problem definition through architecture, build-out, and long-term operability. You'll partner closely with software engineers, security engineers, and product teams to translate demanding customer and compliance requirements into robust, automated, and scalable infrastructure solutions. You'll also serve as a technical anchor for your team: mentoring engineers, driving systems engineering best practices, and raising the bar on automation, reliability, and operational rigor.

Our Engineering Philosophy

At AWS, we "work backwards" — we start with the customer and work our way back to the technology. Senior engineers at this level are expected not just to execute, but to define what needs to be built and why. We're looking for systems engineers who can synthesize complex operational and compliance requirements into clear infrastructure strategies, move fast with high judgment, and continuously raise the bar for what's possible in some of the world's most demanding environments.

This position requires that the candidate selected must be a US Citizen and currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


Key job responsibilities
- Architect, deliver, and operate large-scale infrastructure automation and deployment pipelines for ADC environments with a focus on security, availability, and repeatability, repeatability, observability, and fault tolerance
- Drive technical design reviews and alignment across multiple engineering and operations teams
- Define and champion systems engineering standards, tooling, and best practices across the organization
- Proactively identify and resolve systemic infrastructure risks before they become customer-impacting issues
- Mentor and develop junior and mid-level engineers, accelerating their growth and technical effectiveness

Customer Engagement

In this role, you will be a direct representative of AWS to some of our most strategic and demanding customers. You will engage with customers throughout the full lifecycle — from onboarding and solution design through ongoing operations and continuous improvement.
- Serve as a trusted technical advisor to customers, helping them understand ADC capabilities, constraints, and best practices
- Engage directly with customer technical teams to gather requirements, troubleshoot issues, and deliver solutions that meet their operational and compliance needs
- Translate complex customer requirements — including security, sovereignty, and regulatory mandates — into actionable infrastructure designs and implementation plans
- Lead and participate in customer-facing technical reviews, briefings, and working sessions, communicating clearly to both technical and executive audiences
- Act as a customer advocate within AWS, surfacing feedback and emerging needs to product and engineering teams to drive roadmap prioritization
- Support customers during critical operational events, providing hands-on technical guidance and coordinating cross-team response efforts when needed
- Build and maintain strong, trust-based relationships with customer stakeholders, ensuring long-term satisfaction and confidence in ADC solutions


A day in the life
Who You Are
- A challenger and motivator — You embrace hard problems and drive innovative automated solutions. Personal and professional growth is part of your everyday mindset, and you bring that energy to your teammates as well.
- A clear and compelling communicator — You can articulate designs and complex concepts to audiences ranging from interns to directors, through well-documented code, written artifacts, and verbal communication.
- Curious and contrarian when it counts — You're not a path follower by default. You're comfortable taking a contrarian viewpoint when it genuinely serves the customer, and you actively seek out new approaches and perspectives.
- A proactive, long-term thinker — You think critically about growth, scale, and global demand. You consider the full range of choices and outcomes before committing, and you help your team do the same.
- Patient and persistent — You understand that global impact is an iterative process. You operate with an ingrained improvement loop: setting goals based on customer feedback, designing solutions, executing, refining, and continuously raising the bar.


About the team
Why AWS

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Experience with infrastructure as code, ops automation, and configuration management tools such as Chef, Puppet, or Ansible
- Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance

Preferred qualifications

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

title: Applied Scientist, International Machine Learning
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to join an innovative team of scientists who use machine learning and statistical techniques to create state-of-the-art solutions for providing better value to Amazon’s customers? Do you want to build and deploy advanced ML systems that help optimize millions of transactions every day? Are you excited by the prospect of analyzing and modeling terabytes of data to solve real-world problems? Do you like to own end-to-end business problems/metrics and directly impact the profitability of the company? Do you like to innovate and simplify? If yes, then you may be a great fit to join the Machine Learning team for India Consumer Businesses.

Machine Learning, Big Data and related quantitative sciences have been strategic to Amazon from the early years. Amazon has been a pioneer in areas such as recommendation engines, ecommerce fraud detection and large-scale optimization of fulfillment center operations. As Amazon has rapidly grown and diversified, the opportunity for applying machine learning has exploded. We have a very broad collection of practical problems where machine learning systems can dramatically improve the customer experience, reduce cost, and drive speed and automation. These include product bundle recommendations for millions of products, safeguarding financial transactions across by building the risk models, improving catalog quality via extracting product attribute values from structured/unstructured data for millions of products, enhancing address quality by powering customer suggestions

We are developing state-of-the-art machine learning solutions to accelerate the Amazon India growth story. Amazon India is an exciting place to be at for a machine learning practitioner. We have the eagerness of a fresh startup to absorb machine learning solutions, and the scale of a mature firm to help support their development at the same time. As part of the India Machine Learning team, you will get to work alongside brilliant minds motivated to solve real-world machine learning problems that make a difference to millions of our customers. We encourage thought leadership and blue ocean thinking in ML.

Key job responsibilities
Use machine learning and analytical techniques to create scalable solutions for business problems
Analyze and extract relevant information from large amounts of Amazon’s historical business data to help automate and optimize key processes
Design, develop, evaluate and deploy, innovative and highly scalable ML models
Work closely with software engineering teams to drive real-time model implementations
Work closely with business partners to identify problems and propose machine learning solutions
Establish scalable, efficient, automated processes for large scale data analyses, model development, model validation and model maintenance
Work proactively with engineering teams and product managers to evangelize new algorithms and drive the implementation of large-scale complex ML models in production
Leading projects and mentoring other scientists, engineers in the use of ML techniques


About the team
International Machine Learning Team is responsible for building novel ML solutions that attack India first (and other Emerging Markets across MENA and LatAm) problems and impact the bottom-line and top-line of India business. Learn more about our team from https://www.amazon.science/working-at-amazon/how-rajeev-rastogis-machine-learning-team-in-india-develops-innovations-for-customers-worldwide

title: SLP Specialist INTL, Worldwide Operations Security
descriptionHtml:
Our operations network, known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service, delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. To keep our operations network secure and assure operational continuity, we are looking for a hands-on and detail-oriented professional who wants to join our team as Security and Loss Prevention (SLP) Specialist. In this key role, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of security operations, delivering concrete on-the-ground contributions through direct operational support to our sites. You will deliver security as a service to our operational sites across the end-to-end supply chain to protect our people and prevent loss.

Key job responsibilities
• Execute day-to-day security operations and conduct regular physical security checks at assigned sites
• Support resilience of our business operations by contributing to emergency and crisis planning for sites within your area of responsibility
• Contribute to the identification of vulnerabilities (e.g., loss, associate experience, process improvement) and define appropriate mitigating actions while ensuring compliance with legal and ethical standards
• Serve as point of contact for and coordinate measures to manage risk with local and external management (e.g., law enforcement agencies and industry associations) on all security-related matters
• Ensure compliance of your assigned sites with Amazon global security standards


A day in the life
As an SLP Specialist, you will join a team of Security and Loss Prevention professionals providing security as a service to business customers across multiple business units within a dedicated geographical area. Your daily focus will be on hands-on execution of security operations, including conducting physical security rounds, monitoring CCTV systems, and responding to immediate security concerns. You perform regular physical security audits and investigate policy violations, security-related incidents, and loss events. During your investigations, you collect information by monitoring systems and tools, analysing data reports, and conducting interviews. You execute established procedures to address security incidents and implement approved solutions for identified vulnerabilities. Your findings help to identify vulnerabilities in our processes, for which you contribute to the development of mitigating measures. You play a key role in maintaining the physical integrity of our sites by auditing and monitoring the health status of our systems and, jointly with subject matter experts and external suppliers, maintain their functionality. You interact on a daily basis with our external security service providers to ensure delivery of high-quality security services and a smooth customer experience. You also act as point of contact for multiple internal and external departments (e.g., legal, HR, security service providers, local law enforcement) and subject matter expert in Security and Loss Prevention-related matters. Finally, you deliver loss prevention-related education and awareness programs to other teams and liaise with various stakeholders on policy and procedure across all management levels.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in security and loss prevention
- Experience with MS Office Professional Suite, including Microsoft Excel to manipulate and analyze data
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- A relevant degree, degree equivalent, or industry certification
- Relevant experience with physical security systems, investigation techniques, and/or management of contract security officers
- Relevant experience with retail, warehouse, distribution centre services, delivery service, or supply chain
- Relevant experience in working with data
- Driver’s license

title: Data Center Controls Engineer, Deployment
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As part of the global controls team, you will work with highly motivated experts and innovators in the data center industry. You will be responsible for troubleshooting, project management, and maintaining the building management system (BMS) and electrical power monitoring system (EPMS). Using Amazon leadership principles, you will develop new processes and standards while innovating in the controls space. AWS Data centers have multiple components such as generators, uninterruptible power sources, diesel generators, electrical switchgear, power distribution units, variable frequency drives, automatic/static transfer switches, chillers [air-cooled and water-cooled], pumps, cooling towers, heat exchangers, CRAHs, air economizers, etc. All these components have local control systems that interact with each other via open and/or proprietary communications protocols. The BMS is the primary method of control of all mechanical systems within a data center. The EPMS is the primary method of monitoring all electrical systems within a data center.


Key job responsibilities
• Train and assist internal customers and stakeholders with the creation, design, configuration, validation, installation, commissioning and operation of BMS and EPMS systems.
• Provide technical assistance and support to operations during life cycle of the data center. • Review results and action items from the quarterly maintenances for BMS and EPMS and take actions to get them resolved.
• Develop BMS & EPMS projects scope of work, schedule, budget, and level of efforts (LOE) to projects requested by customers and stakeholders.
• Manage scope, schedule, finance and execution of BMS and EPMS improvement projects in AWS data centers.
• Assist in procurement related activities including request for quotation/proposals, responding to request for information, review of vendors proposal and issuance of purchase orders.
• Participate in AWS global on-call schedule to provide immediate BMS and EPMS technical support to in-service data centers. • Attend project related meetings, coordinate with project leaders and regularly report status to Controls and stakeholder’s management.
• Support Controls projects related commissioning activities in the data centers.
• Review, implement, troubleshoot and iterate on the controls sequence of operation (SOO) and provide necessary feedback to the design team.
• Develop and modify controls logic programming and graphical user interfaces.
• Manage multiple stakeholder deliverables, requirements and navigate challenging situations.
• Financially manage BMS and EPMS service contracts.
• Frequently visit (locally) assigned in-operation data centers to troubleshoot, meet customers, supervise vendor’s work to ensure compliance with the scope, design, SOO and applicable local codes.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related field
- Experience carrying new design concepts through exploration, development, and into deployment or mass production
- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience with power management and power monitoring systems

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure experience
- Knowledge of critical data center equipment
- Knowledge of engineering documentation, electrical diagrams and standard operating procedures
- Knowledge of building codes and regulations including Life Safety, BOCA, NFPA, NEC, or OSHA
- Experience in project management in data centers or comparable critical infrastructure
- Experience in Data Center Engineering Operations, with a deep understanding of electrical and mechanical data center infrastructure
- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains

title: パートナーソリューションアーキテクト / Partner Solutions Architect (ISV & AWS Marketplace)
descriptionHtml:
クラウドと AI の力で、ビジネスの常識を変えたい方へ。

Amazon Web Services (AWS) は、クラウドテクノロジーを通じて世界中の企業のイノベーションを推進するリーディングカンパニーです。私たちのパートナー組織では、ISV（独立系ソフトウェアベンダー）パートナーとの戦略的協業を技術面からリードし、AWS Marketplace を通じたビジネス成長を加速させるパートナーソリューションアーキテクトを募集しています。

特に本ポジションでは、以下の 2 つのテーマをリードしていただきます：
- AWS Marketplace を通じたソフトウェア流通の変革 — パートナーソリューションの AWS Marketplace リスティング最適化、CPPO（Channel Partner Private Offer）の活用拡大、共同 Go-to-Market 戦略の技術支援
- AI エージェント時代の連携基盤構築 — Amazon Bedrock や MCP（Model Context Protocol）/ A2A（Agent to Agent）を活用し、AI エージェント同士が自動的に発見・連携する次世代マルチエージェント環境の構築を支援

社内では営業、SA、プロフェッショナルサービス、サポート、製品担当、業界担当など多様なチームと連携し、パートナーとその先のお客様に最大の価値を届けます。必要に応じて AWS 開発チームへフィードバックを行い、テクノロジーそのものの革新にも貢献いただきます。

Key job responsibilities
- ISV パートナーに対する技術的なトラステッドアドバイザーとしての SaaS 化やモダナイゼーション支援、Well-Architected レビューの実施

- AI/ML ワークロードおよび AI エージェント連携（MCP、A2A）の技術設計・PoC 推進
- パートナーとの共同ソリューション開発、技術検証（PoC）、ホワイトペーパー・リファレンスアーキテクチャの作成
- AWS 社内チーム（Sales、SA、BD、Product）との連携による共同 Go-to-Market 施策の推進
- 各種セミナー、技術イベントやワークショップの企画・登壇
- お客様やパートナーからのフィードバックの AWS サービスチームへの還元によるプロダクトロードマップへの貢献

A day in the life
ワークライフバランス

メンターシップとキャリア成長

title: Design Engineer/Project Manager for ICT Structured Cabling, Cabling Infrastructure Technology
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Cabling Infrastructure & Technology is a growing and innovative global team that design and implements ICT infrastructure to support Amazon’s portfolio of corporate offices. Operational excellence is at the forefront of our approach, raising the bar across all aspects of the project delivery process to provide our customers with a seamless IT delivery experience.

For the EMEA region we are looking for an exceptional individual with a successful track record and progressive career history in the area of low voltage structured cabling, as a Design Engineer/Project Manager. This role will be office based with 20% travel throughout EMEA.

The successful candidate will be responsible for partnering with our design consultants and internal customers to standardize our structured cabling and server room designs to accelerate delivery and lower cost across our portfolio of building launches. This role requires an experienced professional with a background in structured cabling and has experience of generating designs as well as providing effective oversight. The Design Engineer/Project Manager is expected to collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders and external vendors to drive best practices and establish tools, and standards consistent with large corporate deployments. The candidate will be required to have more than a cabling background. It is expected they will also have a strong IT background with knowledge of other facets of an IT network, such as networking, WiFi, AV, Security, PDU, UPS and Smart Building technologies. Your experience will help us to drive continuous improvement and development for our infrastructure.

As a member of this global team, you will engage with key stakeholders and vendors across various disciplines to ensure the ICT infrastructure is compliant with Amazon & Industry standards and ready for commencement of building occupation.
You are the right person for this job if you have a solid end user focus and a passion for producing high-quality deliverables. You must be a self-starter and a critical thinker to deliver results with a curiosity and drive for learning. You must demonstrate the ability to efficiently plan and prioritize deliverables and resources across multiple projects and working groups. This position requires you to manage stakeholder expectations, budgets, schedules and scope. You must exhibit bias for action, and not rely on others to show you the path forward. You are the right person for this position if you take ownership and challenge the status quo.

This is an opportunity to leverage and grow your existing experience in an innovative and highly collaborative environment where the results of your efforts will directly impact Amazon and its customers.



Key job responsibilities
Collaborate with internal stakeholder teams to select Design Consultants & Low Voltage Contractors

Identify and implement design opportunities to lower the cost to serve

Review Request for Pricing and renegotiation of bids

Implement a vendor agnostic approach to design & implementation by setting the tolerances

Update budget tracking tools

Refine the current infrastructure design material in line with best practice

Implement design best practice and standards to deliver construction ready designs

Coordinate supply chain forecasts

Flexibility to work with stakeholders in different time zones

Review Design Consultant weekly progress reports and host update meetings.

Identify risks on critical path and provide resolution

Support Vendor Manager with QBR by providing operational metrics

Main POC for all internal customers for escalations, questions or recommendations of all aspects of the structured cabling and containment pathways

Travel 20% to time to meet with stakeholders, vendors and visit project locations

Training of LVCs and Design Consultants on Amazon specifications and standards

Attending progress/room ready meetings in person or online and collaborate with QAQC team

Participate in the infrastructure life-cycle planning and design to align cabling roadmaps

Timely and concise communication (both written/verbally) with key stakeholders

Develop, track, and report project metrics as necessary


A day in the life
As a Design Engineer/Project Manager, you'll standardize structured cabling infrastructure while collaborating across disciplines. Your days include reviewing consultant design proposals, identifying cost optimizations, and coordinating with stakeholders across time zones. You'll work with vendors and design teams to ensure infrastructure meets Amazon and industry standards. You'll mentor consultants and contractors on Amazon specifications, host cross-functional progress meetings, and update tracking tools to keep leadership informed on budget, schedule, and risk. Throughout, you'll balance strategic planning with hands-on problem-solving, ensuring projects deliver high-quality results on time and within budget.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in MS Excel, Word, and Windows Operating Systems
- Experience in project management
- Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities, or experience working with customers with a passion for delivering exceptional service
- Experience managing multiple projects, prioritizing, planning, and managing time
- Experience communicating with customers, technical, regulatory, business teams, and management to collect requirements, describe product features, and technical designs
- BICSI Certification or internationally recognized equivalent 5+ Years’ experience in delivery and coordinating corporate office fit outs from design concept through to deployment/construction and close out.
- 5+ years Information and Communications Technology (ICT) design experience
- 5+ years of working experience with Audio Visual, WiFi, fiber optic components, copper cabling, and interconnect products, technologies, and standards

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and interpreting construction specifications and drawings for all domains
- Project Management Professional (PMP) or equivalent certification
- Registered Communications Distribution Designer Certificate (RCDD)
- Certified Network Infrastructure Technician (CNIT)
- Certified Network Infrastructure Design Professional (CNIDP)
- Certified Telecommunications Project Management (CTPM)
- Experience of Revit, Auto-CAD, Bluebeam or other Computer Aided Design Tools.

descriptionHtml:

title: Data Scientist II, Device Economics
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking Data Scientist II with strong science application skills to join our Device Economics team. This role will focus primarily on Amazon's innovative devices and services (e.g. Echo Family of Devices), working at the intersection of economic modeling, forecasting science, and business strategy. The ideal candidate will be responsible for pre-launch forecasts, annualized overall forecasts, identifying substitution patterns, and partnering closely with product managers and marketing managers to understand the evolution of the Devices portfolio.


Key job responsibilities
Forecasting & Modeling
1. Develop and maintain pre-launch forecasts and annualized overall forecasts for Amazon Devices
2. Identify and model substitution patterns across the device portfolio
3. Build economic and financial models to support demand planning and business decisions
4. Formulate relevant analytical frameworks to address key economic issues in device forecasting

Science Communication & Collaboration
1. Explain complex science models and methodologies to non-technical stakeholders including product managers and marketing managers
2. Collaborate with economists, data scientists, and applied scientists across Decision Science
3. Present results of analyses to cross-functional teams and leadership
4. Build trust in science models and forecast outputs with product teams
Innovation & Strategic Thinking
1. Think creatively about ways that leading-edge analytics and emerging data sources can address Devices' most pressing business challenges
2. Help internal teams leverage analytic tools to better manage innovation
3. Conduct empirical studies and perform quantitative and qualitative research
4. Identify opportunities to improve forecasting accuracy and business impact
Cross-Functional Partnership
1. Work closely with product managers and marketing managers to understand portfolio evolution and business strategy
2. Support DSO leadership in quarterly business reviews and strategic planning

A day in the life
Your days will be split between refining and building models and working with business leaders to interpret them. You own science-based forecasts that can directly impact Amazon's bottom line on the order of multi-million dollar decisions.
- You will perform model refreshes or updates to analyses as needed; and,
- You will be expected to develop new techniques to process large data sets, address quantitative problems, and contribute to design of automated systems.

About the team
The Decision Science team within DSO (Device Supply Organization) is responsible for forecasting and demand planning initiatives across Amazon Devices. The DSO team of 300+ engineers, scientists, and PMs applies quantitative methods and data-driven approaches to replace judgment-based decisions with science-driven forecasts. Decision Science focuses on lifetime demand forecasting using econometric and machine learning models for rapid reforecasting, mix adjustments, and portfolio management for new product launches. We also inform to go/no-go investment decision for new product initiatives

Basic qualifications

- Master's degree in econometrics, statistics, industrial engineering, operations research, optimization, data mining, analytics, or equivalent quantitative field
- 3+ years of data scientist or similar role involving data extraction, analysis, statistical modeling and communication experience
- Experience using data and metrics to drive actionable insights at scale

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of methods for statistical inference (e.g. regression, experimental design, significance testing)
- Experience with AWS technologies
- Experience with demand forecasting in retail, e-commerce, or consumer electronics
- Background in portfolio optimization or product mix analysis
- Familiarity with substitution modeling and cannibalization analysis

descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 16, 2026

The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Data to join our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HCLS) practice. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside HCLS customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

This role requires approximately 50% co-location on site with customer, AWS and partner teams within the U.S.

title: Software Development Engineer, AWS OpenSearch Service
descriptionHtml:
Imagine running search and analytics at any scale without thinking about clusters, capacity, or version upgrades. Where your queries return in milliseconds whether you're indexing a thousand documents or a hundred billion. Where the platform scales, heals, and secures itself so your team can focus on the questions, not the infrastructure.

That's what we build.

Amazon OpenSearch Service is the fully managed and Serverless AWS service that lets customers deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, observability, and AI-powered retrieval. We serve hundreds of thousands of customers running mission-critical workloads across every AWS region, and we are part of the AWS Database and Analytics organization.

Come join the OpenSearch Control Plane team. We are responsible for a service that:

- Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud-native OpenSearch clusters and collections, freeing customers from sizing, scaling, and patching decisions
- Guarantees high availability and durability for mission-critical search and observability workloads at the scale of the most demanding internet businesses
- Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of an OpenSearch cluster or collection — from creation through scale-up, scale-out, upgrade, replication, and fail-over

The OpenSearch control plane is not just any distributed system. It orchestrates a fleet of clusters across every AWS region, detects and recovers from node failures in seconds, and serves workloads that span petabytes of customer data. Most recently, we launched **OpenSearch Serverless NextGen** — delivering ultra-fast collection provisioning and true scale-to-zero capacity, so customers pay only for what they use and get a working environment in seconds rather than minutes. We are not done; this is one of many investments raising the bar for what customers can expect from a managed search service.

OpenSearch itself is a community-driven, Apache 2.0–licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases advancing core search, vector search, and analytics. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine — one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

We work in Java, Rust, Python, and Go. We contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene. We are customer-obsessed, operate with the entrepreneurial pace of a startup inside one of the world's largest cloud providers, and value strong intuition backed by metrics.

**Operations is core engineering on this team, not overhead.** Engineers operate what they build, and we treat customer-impacting incidents with the same engineering rigor we apply to feature work. Reliability and Static Stability is a forcing function for design, not a phase after launch.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and operate components of a large-scale distributed control plane — reason about failure modes, multi-tenant isolation, and blast-radius before writing code
- Look for opportunities to simplify — consolidate duplicate abstractions, remove dead code, reduce configuration sprawl, and challenge complexity that doesn't earn its keep
- Treat operations as core engineering — own the systems you build end-to-end, participate fully in incident response and RCAs, and drive operational improvements that reduce cost and maintenance burden
- Solve real problems in cluster orchestration, capacity provisioning, lifecycle workflows, multi-tenant infrastructure, query routing, and operational tooling
- Use AI coding assistants and GenAI tools effectively across the software development lifecycle — from design and prototyping through coding, testing, code review, debugging, and operations — applying engineering judgment to validate AI-generated output against Amazon's correctness, security, and operational bar
- Write robust, efficient, and maintainable code in Java, Rust, Python, or Go
- Partner with senior engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete deliverables; prototype, test, and validate
- Continually challenge what exists and explore what should change to better serve customers

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Electronics Design Engineer, Amazon Robotics
descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about electrical design and bringing innovative hardware to life? Do you thrive on solving complex circuit design challenges that span analog, digital, and power domains? Do you want to see your electrical designs enable products that delight millions of Amazon customers? If yes, you'll fit right in here at Amazon Robotics.

Amazon Robotics is seeking an Electronics Design Engineer with deep expertise in electrical design and circuit validation to lead the design and integration of electronic robotic systems.

We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply cutting-edge advances in robotics, control systems, and mechatronics to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers' experiences in ways we can't imagine yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.


Key job responsibilities

• Design and analyze electrical circuits and systems for robotic platforms, including motor control electronics, sensor interfaces, power distribution, communication systems, and safety-critical circuits

• Create detailed electrical schematics with clear specifications using industry-standard schematic capture tools (OrCAD, Altium, or similar)

• Generate smaller layout (e.g., sensor designs) yourself and lead larger layout (e.g., motor controllers) undertaken by our internal and external team

• Build circuit models and simulations (SPICE, MATLAB, or similar) to predict performance, conduct trade studies, and validate design approaches before prototyping

• Develop electrical architecture diagrams and interface specifications to communicate design intent and analyze system performance, signal integrity, and power distribution

• Design filtering, signal processing, and protection circuits to address real-world limitations such as noise, EMI/EMC compliance, thermal constraints, and component tolerances in dynamic robotic environments

• Lead cross-functional design integration across mechanical (actuators, enclosures, thermal), electrical (circuits, PCBs, motor controllers), and firmware (embedded control, safety systems) domains

• Identify system-level solutions that optimize across components rather than individual parts in isolation, finding creative trade-offs between electrical design, mechanical constraints, cost targets, and performance requirements

• Derive electrical requirements and specifications across subsystems to ensure integrated robotic systems meet objectives for functionality, reliability, safety, and human-robot interaction

• Conduct trade space studies to evaluate design alternatives, comparing performance, cost, manufacturability, supplier capability, and timeline (make vs. buy, OEM vs. ODM decisions)
• Lead electrical validation and testing activities including prototype bring-up, functional testing, EMI/EMC compliance testing, safety validation, and design verification against specifications

• Generate technical artifacts (schematics, test plans, trade studies, validation reports, design documentation) that influence product designs across hardware, firmware, and manufacturing teams

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related technical field
- Experience in motherboard design, PCB design including schematic capture, stackup and circuit board layout
- Experience with analog, digital, and high-speed circuit design
- Experience using common electronics test equipment (oscilloscopes, power supplies, function generators, etc)
- Experience identifying, maintaining, and troubleshooting Motor Controls including motor starters, Variable Frequency Drives, DC drives, and standard electrical components
- Experience in hardware design
- 3+ years of experience designing and debugging printed circuit boards (PCBs) for embedded systems
- Experience with embedded microcontrollers and processors (ARM Cortex, STM32, or similar)
- Proficiency with sensor integration for robotics applications (IMUs, encoders, force/torque sensors, vision systems, LiDAR)

Preferred qualifications

title: Talent Marketing Manager, Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM)
descriptionHtml:
We're reinventing how to attract and hire quality talent at scale. Come join us.

We're seeking a Talent Marketing Manager to own the marketing strategy for the Americas, driving activation management and integrated campaign planning across the region. This role is the single-threaded owner for how marketing support is prioritized, how campaigns are built and measured, and how the organization scales its impact through automation, data-driven decisioning, and cross-functional orchestration. You serve as the accountable owner for onboarding new internal clients in the Americas into the standard activation management process.

You help thousands of people get a job every year.
As a marketing strategist, you set the vision for how activation logic, campaign planning, override management, and performance optimization work together to drive fill rate outcomes at scale across US, Canada, Mexico, Brazil, and beyond. You force multiply through mechanisms, building systems that reduce manual effort and driving toward automated decisioning. You translate complex marketing performance data into executive-level strategy, owning the WBR narrative for senior leadership and influencing investment priorities across the AIM organization.

You shape organizational strategy and drive marketing impact at scale.

Your insights don't just inform decisions, they define them. You influence partner team roadmaps, align business managers and global risk teams on fill risk strategy, and represent both the activation and campaign planning functions in cross-functional planning. You identify gaps between teams and processes, hold partner teams accountable for improvements, and build scalable mechanisms that outlast your direct involvement.


Key job responsibilities
Activation Strategy & Risk Management: Own the strategic framework for weekly marketing activation logic across Americas fulfillment sites, including application need and paid application need assessments. Define the override governance model, ensuring decisions are logged and structured to accelerate automation development. Set the standard for how risk is identified, escalated, and resolved across the portfolio.

Integrated Campaign Planning & Execution: Own annual integrated campaign plans for the Americas, with focus on building and testing during low-volume periods and maintaining readiness for high-volume hiring events (Peak, Prime, Hot Sale). Lead working-backwards planning from hiring projections, site capacity, and historical performance data. Consult senior leadership on quarterly strategy, budget allocation, and major campaign pivots. Translate rolling 12-week labor order visibility into dynamic marketing adjustments, flagging risks and mitigation plans early.

Cross-Functional Orchestration: Drive campaign management across the Americas, leading true collaboration with Creative, Performance Marketing, Journey Orchestration, Talent Engagement, and Business stakeholders. Facilitate quarterly planning cycles, manage stakeholder expectations across business partners, country leads, and global teams, and bridge the gap between marketing capabilities and operational hiring realities. Lead integrated campaign reviews with senior leadership, presenting data-backed recommendations.

Performance Optimization & Marketing Strategy: Define the strategy for channel mix, spend efficiency, fill rate improvement, and labor order projection accuracy across the Americas portfolio. Partner with analytics teams to move beyond single-metric measurement to comprehensive campaign performance frameworks. Identify systemic opportunities to improve marketing effectiveness and hold partner teams accountable for execution.

Pacing & Spend Governance: Own pacing management, ensuring ramp-down and pause decisions are executed with precision and that insights are fed back into program management to improve paid marketing efficiency. Own the governance framework for spend decisions and escalation thresholds.

Automation & Process Improvement: Identify, develop, and drive adoption of mechanisms that improve activation efficiency, reduce manual override volume, and accelerate the path to automated decisioning. Own the automation of campaign planning processes, from discovery through recommendation to implementation. Eliminate redundant workflows and hold partner teams accountable for process improvements across both functions.

Executive Reporting & Stakeholder Influence: Own the weekly WBR deep dive for senior leadership, translating activation performance, campaign results, and fill risk into clear, strategic narratives. Maintain alignment with business managers, global risk teams, and cross-functional partners. Influence investment priorities and partner team roadmaps through data-driven business cases.


A day in the life
Your day begins with a review of overnight performance data, identifying anomalies, escalation triggers, and optimization opportunities. You finalize the weekly activation logic, making strategic override decisions and ensuring the log is structured to support automation development. Mid-morning, you walk down the hall to a cross-functional working session with Performance Marketing and Journey Orchestration, influencing channel investment decisions with data from the prior week's WBR. You grab a whiteboard with a Campaign Planner to work through a quarterly testing plan, thinking through risk signals and mitigation strategies for upcoming high-volume events. In the afternoon, you're reviewing the onboarding plan for a new internal client coming onto the activation process, ensuring intake requirements are met and the timeline is on track. You close the day finalizing the WBR narrative for senior leadership, sharpening the strategic framing and ensuring campaign performance is connected to hiring outcomes before it goes to Directors. This is an in-office role five days a week, and the pace, proximity, and real-time collaboration reflect that.

About the team
Workforce Staffing (WFS) hires thousands of Amazonians every year. The Attraction, Influence, and Marketing (AIM) team achieves high-volume hiring goals by delivering exceptional, multi-channel candidate experiences, engaging and hiring job seekers with maximum efficiency and precision. Leveraging paid digital advertising, owned channels, web experience, and local grassroots efforts, AIM delivers quality candidates at scale. Practicing transformational thinking empowered by leading-edge tech and tool development, this team constantly innovates new processes to increase marketing efficacy.

title: Systems Engineering Manager of Datacenter Controls, DCCD Controls Deployment and Service
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Systems Engineering Manager to help drive the execution and improvement of key service delivery processes throughout the organization and ensure that the correct metrics and KPIs are in place. This organization of IT professionals installs and maintains the technical infrastructure used by Data Center Engineering Operations Staff, specifically Operational Technology (NIST800-82). This team is experiencing rapid growth as we expand our global Data Center portfolio. In this role you will learn the high level technical designs of the environment including Networking, Industrial Controls (HVAC and Electrical), and Community Mechanisms- while providing coaching, mentoring and guidance for a diverse team of admins, engineers, analysts and PMs. Some travel to meet members of the geographically diverse team, learn about the business first hand and develop relationships with peer Managers and Operations leaders. You will regularly manage large, cross-functional projects and interact with software developers, executives, vendors and other support teams.

Key job responsibilities
Operational Excellence - As a manager you will be expected to drive operational excellence in everything we do. This includes creating processes, procedures, and automation to improve efficiency in our day-to-day tasks and projects. You will work closely on supporting our internal customers and ensuring that their needs and issues are being addressed.

Performance Management/Team Health - You will own all facets of performance and career management of assigned staff. Regular one-on-one meetings with all team members are required. You will be expected to provide both technical and ‘soft skill’ mentoring in order to maintain a well-rounded, world-class organization. This includes project management, quality audits, and coordination of training sessions with senior-level engineers as well as day-to-day oversight of the team including scheduling when needed.

Controls and Networking Technical Guidance - You will work with your Sr Engineers to understand the technical landscape and provide strategic guidance in supporting cross-functional and cross-organizational teams in leveraging Systems Engineering core competencies.

A day in the life
A day in the life of this role will involve a mix of meeting with our internal Engineering and Operations teams as well as other TPM's to implement solutions across our infrastructure. You will be expected to own outcomes and closing detected gaps across the teams, and producing effective reporting demonstrating the mechanistic closure of issues detected. Your day will be split between stakeholder engagement meetings, deep dives, and personal project time.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Manages a global team that deploys and support the critical IT infrastructure for the data centers Mechanical (HVAC) and Electrical controls systems. The team work closely with Controls Engineers to ensure that the data center control systems perform optimally.

- Bachelor's degree in a relevant field or equivalent work experience
- 10+ years of hands-on infrastructure, troubleshooting, systems administration, networking, DevOps or applications development experience

descriptionHtml:
Leo is an initiative to launch a constellation of Low Earth Orbit satellites that will provide low-latency, high-speed broadband connectivity to unserved and underserved communities around the world. We are the premier payload processing facility, providing exceptional value to our customers, defining industry excellence through continuous innovation, and inspiring others to follow our lead.

The Payload Processing Technology Manager will lead the deployment, operation, maintenance, and improvement of electrical ground support equipment utilized throughout the Payload Processing Facility located in Merritt Island, Florida as well as French Guiana. This individual will work closely with and manage engineering and manufacturing teams that integrate Kuiper satellites with dispenser and launch vehicle hardware.

The Payload Processing Technology Manager is a technical leader of the team, providing guidance on many aspects including but not limited to ground support equipment within the payload processing facilities, testing requirements, facility and equipment planning, integration and test application implementation and improvement, design for manufacturability, and project management.

The ideal candidate is comfortable in a highly technical setting and leads collaboration with other departments to reach the best solution to any problem and is able to technically challenge assumptions and requirements of these departments including avionics, networking, and harnessing.

Additionally, a Payload Processing Technology Manager is expected to set objectives for the team overall, not only identifying the right long term strategies but implementing them on their assemblies and responsibilities, leading by example first and then by instruction. They'll have extensive experience in space hardware integration and test as well as associated ground support equipment.


Key job responsibilities
• Lead a team of engineers and technicians to support multiple processing facilities and launch sites
• Maintain budget and staffing plans for the payload processing technology team
• Establish and maintain standards for the production and maintenance of electrical ground support hardware and associated software/networks
• Assist in planning new facilities for storage, processing, and launch preparation of satellites and other flight hardware
• Direct the maintenance, calibration, and upgrade of instrumentation racks, vehicle power supplies, harnesses, and miscellaneous ground support equipment
• Coordinate cable harness shop operations including work orders, procurement, new harness builds, and existing cable harness diagnosis and repair
• Interface with internal and external stakeholders to establish power and telecom to facilities and work cells
• Ensuring that all work scope is carried out in a safe manner by authoring/reviewing job hazard analyses and ensuring team training compliance
• Must be willing and able to perform extended travel up to 25% annually, either domestically or internationally as business needs demand
• Able to obtain and maintain a US Passport & must meet customs entry requirements to include but not limited to: Yellow Fever vaccine and other immunization requirements as recommended by the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention
• Able to pass Kennedy Space Center background checks


A day in the life
The Payload Processing Technology Manager will spend significant amounts of time collaborating with engineering, quality, and manufacturing to deliver and maintain support equipment required to test satellite/dispensers and perform hardware integration.
They will be the front line lead to deliver their value stream, implementing engineering best practices in a safe and repeatable manner, implementing efficiency improvements and reducing non-conformances.

We are a fast-paced, data-driven team, and work with leaders in multiple technology areas to deliver the best product for our customers. We hold each other to relentlessly high standards, and constantly look for ways to improve the product’s performance, quality and cost. We are excited about the technical challenges, which motivates us rather than discourages us.

We want individuals who are ready for this challenge and want to reach beyond what is possible today.

私たちの業務の流れには3つの主要な要素があります。
商品が保管され注文に備える「ファーストマイル」、注文品をお客様のエリアまで輸送する「ミドルマイル」、そして商品をお客様の玄関先までお届けする「ラストマイル」です。各拠点で運営方法に若干の違いはありますが、一貫して変わらないものが一つあります、それは顧客を第一に考える私たちのビジョンと献身的な姿勢です。

品をお届けすることでお客様のカスタマーエクスペリエンスを向上します。私たちと一緒に歴史をつくりましょう！

具体的にはマネージャーのサポートのもと、以下の業務に責任をもち遂行いただきます。
① 安全・品質・作業効率の向上
安全安心な作業環境の維持・向上のため、日々の安全活動、品質チェックに加え、標準作業手順書の作成や多岐にわたる問題解決・改善活動を行います。

③ 新規プロジェクトの導入・セール時など、オペレーション拡大時の準備
新しいサービスやシステムの導入に備え、現場での手順変更・導入方法を検討し円滑な導入に向けて準備を行います。また、新規入職者でもAmazonの標準作業に則った手順がスムーズに身につくためのトレーニング構築やマニュアルを作成します。
④ イレギュラーへの対応
作業で発生する様々な課題の原因を追求し問題解決を行います。また、再発防止策案の検討、実施を行います。

※社内公募により、マネージャーへのキャリアアップや他部署への異動機会もあります

title: Snr. Civil Engineer, Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

You’ll collaborate with a diverse team of people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standard of safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion. The Data Center Engineering (DCE) team is looking for a passionate, results-oriented, inventive Civil Engineer to drive design and construction in a client-side technical lead role for the delivery of our enterprise data center campus projects.

As a Civil Engineer, you will work as part of the wider DCE Team collaborating with our Real Estate, Design Services, Construction and other partner teams. You will be responsible for the successful delivery of design delivery ensuring we continue to meet and exceed our industry leading quality and performance requirements.

Utilizing your Civil Engineering expertise, you will assist in assessing site constraints, developing acceleration strategies and supporting overall campus planning, development and construction. This position ultimately plays a pivotal role for the delivery of Data Center projects.

The successful candidate will be strong leader who can prioritize well, communicate clearly with a history of delivering for their customers. The role requires creative engineering balanced with high quality and customer focus. You must be able to work as part of a large and dynamic team, including many internal stakeholders, customers as well as external stakeholders like design consultants, developers and general contractors.

Key job responsibilities
- Develop and communicate conceptual designs and create/maintain project documentation before, during, and after construction.
- Develop and maintain design standards, design prototypes, and template specifications related to site design.
- Review Due Diligence assessments to determine site constraints, risks and develop investigation scopes.
- Create, review, and release design consultant request for proposals.
- Manage our external civil design consultants through the design and construction process.
- Develop and review designs for grading, storm water, flood mitigation, utilities, and pavements.
- Deep understanding of interdependent civil design elements to develop optimised earthworks and utilities designs and minimise the construction schedule.
- Lead our internal modelling and documentation resources.
- Coordinate with internal and external Architecture, Structure and MEP design engineers.
- Effectively communicate design standards to internal and external project partners.
- Manage multiple fast paced projects simultaneously.
- Think outside of the box to find innovative solutions prior to and during the construction process to reduce costs without negative impacts on quality or reliability.
- Travel for site assessments, internal design meetings, construction review, and interfacing with authorities having jurisdiction. Anticipated travel is approximately 25%.

A day in the life
Given Amazon's global presence, 25% travel is required. This includes international travel to inspect and audit current and future data center sites. Collaboration with international teams is essential, and you may need to travel for workshops to develop schematic and detailed design documentation packages.

About the team
About AWS

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. title: Sr Content Strategist, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

We are seeking a Sr Content Strategist to help build Amazon Leo's global content engine from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity to define how a transformative new service tells its story—shaping content strategy that drives awareness, consideration, and brand affinity at a global scale and across B2B and B2C segments. You will own the strategy, the calendar, and the end-to-end content operation that brings Amazon Leo's mission to life for every audience we serve.

The right candidate will bring a blend of strategic thinking, creative excellence, and operational rigor. You will develop differentiated content strategies for distinct customer segments, oversee content creation across multiple formats and providers, and ensure brand and messaging consistency across every touchpoint. You will also pioneer how we optimize content for AI answer engines and leverage AI tools to scale content production and personalization. Success in this role requires a relentless focus on the customer, excellent writing and communication skills, comfort working in an ambiguous and fast-moving environment, and an ability to execute at scale and with the highest standards. title: Sr. Go-To-Market Specialist, Data, AWS, WWSO Data APJC
descriptionHtml:
Are you a customer-obsessed builder with a passion for helping customers achieve their full potential? Do you have the business savvy, deep data background, and technical sales skills necessary to help position AWS as the cloud provider of choice for customers across Asia Pacific, Japan and China? Do you love building new strategic and data-driven businesses, and helping customers turn their data into the foundation that powers AI in production? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) Data & AI team as a Sr. Go-To-Market (GTM) Specialist for Data.

This role owns the AWS data go-to-market across ASEAN with a primary focus on helping customers run agentic and AI workloads in production, working hand-in-hand with the AI team to turn AI pilots into production reality. Data is the context layer that turns generic AI into personalised, differentiated outcomes; every AI conversation is a data conversation, and this role sits at the centre of it. To run these workloads in production, customers need the right context layer with the right level of governance, which means getting the metadata right. It is truly about getting the right data to the right people and agents at the right time. That starts with strong foundations, helping customers build and modernise the underlying data estate (the data stores, pipelines, and data engineering) that the context layer is built on and doing it in a way that makes it simple for customers, removing complexity rather than adding it. You will span AWS's storage, analytics, and database portfolio, partnering with the AI team, account teams, and partners on some of ASEAN's largest customers and most strategic deals. You will also be the voice of ASEAN back to the service teams, carrying the needs of ASEAN customers to our data service teams to help reshape our service and roadmap strategy.

The Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) is part of AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) and acts as the force multiplier for AWS. We are the deep domain experts, in this case, in data — who are brought in to support customers and our sales teams when they need to unblock or accelerate a customer. We work backwards from our customers' most complex and business-critical problems to build and execute go-to-market plans that turn AWS ideas into multi-billion-dollar businesses. WWSO teams include business development, specialist, and technical solutions architecture. As part of WWSO, you'll provide expertise across the entire lifecycle of an AWS customer initiative, from developing ideas for new services to accelerating the adoption of established businesses. We pride ourselves on thinking big, delivering exceptional results for our customers, and working across AWS as #OneTeam.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the GTM strategy and execution for AWS Data (storage, analytics, database) across ASEAN, across all segments.
- Get customers ready to run agentic and AI workloads in production — partner with the AI team to build the context layer, governance, and metadata that gets the right data to the right people and agents at the right time.
- Help customers build and modernise the foundational data estate — data stores, pipelines, and data engineering beneath the context layer — making it easy by removing complexity.
- Serve as the ASEAN point of contact for all data motions — the connective tissue between the AI team, Specialists, Specialist SAs, Partners, and the area teams carrying data quota.
- Lead engagement on ASEAN's largest and most strategic deals with the AI team, account, commercial/deal, and partner teams, and design Scale Sales Motions using Field teams, partner channels, and funding levers to unblock deals.
- Be the voice of ASEAN to the data service teams — feed customer needs, adoption signals, and competitive gaps back to product leadership to reshape roadmap strategy.
- Engage at CxO/VP level and with developers and architects to build pipeline, secure lighthouse customers, drive revenue, and host executive briefings and workshops.

A day in the life
You are the person the field, partners, and customers come to for anything data in ASEAN. One day you're with the AI team in a CxO briefing making the case for the governed data foundation a customer needs to move an agentic workload into production; the next you're helping an account team stand up the right metadata and governance so agents can access the right data safely, unblocking a stalled deal with the right partner funding lever, or feeding ASEAN customer signal back to the service teams to shape the roadmap. You operate across the ASEAN areas and every segment, building the strategy and executing it, measuring success by the collective growth of the ASEAN data business.

About the team
The WWSO Data & AI team helps customers adopt our newest and most advantageous technologies. We are technology specialists. This role sits on the ASEAN Data GTM team, working as an integrated unit with the AI team, account teams, Specialist SAs, and partner teams to drive data adoption across ASEAN. We believe in a collaborative working model where BD, Sales Specialists, and Specialist SAs operate in concert, each bringing unique strengths to deliver customer outcomes. We value individuals who are not only strong strategists but also effective communicators who can bridge the gap between local market needs and global organizational priorities. If you thrive where you build the strategy AND execute it, where you influence across organizational boundaries, and where you measure success by the collective growth of the team, this is the role for you.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of Go-To-Market, Business Development, Sales, or Consulting experience
- Experience working with, presenting to, and negotiating with C-level executives, IT, lines of business, procurement, finance, legal and internal stakeholders for sizeable commercial/enterprise deals
- 5+ years of technology domain experience across data, analytics, data platform, storage, and/or database and large-scale data workloads.
- Experience helping customers build the foundational data estate for AI/ML, data stores, data pipelines/engineering, data readiness, governance, and metadata/cataloguing and getting data accessible to applications and agents.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience identifying, negotiating, and executing complex legal agreements
- Experience with C-level sales and strategic partnership building
- 5+ years of working with Data & AI related technologies, including, but not limited to, AI/ML (Artificial Intelligence/Machine Learning), GenAI (Generative AI), Analytics, Database, and/or Storage experience
- Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
- Experience leading and influencing cross-functional sales teams
- Experience working with technical and product stakeholders to define requirements, prioritize features, and influence product roadmaps
- Experience owning end-to-end GTM strategy for a technology domain across multiple geographies and segments.
