title: Software Development Engineer, AWS OpenSearch Service
descriptionHtml:
Imagine running search and analytics at any scale without thinking about clusters, capacity, or version upgrades. Where your queries return in milliseconds whether you're indexing a thousand documents or a hundred billion. Where the platform scales, heals, and secures itself so your team can focus on the questions, not the infrastructure.

That's what we build.

Amazon OpenSearch Service is the fully managed and Serverless AWS service that lets customers deploy, operate, and scale OpenSearch for log analytics, full-text search, application monitoring, observability, and AI-powered retrieval. We serve hundreds of thousands of customers running mission-critical workloads across every AWS region, and we are part of the AWS Database and Analytics organization.

Come join the OpenSearch Control Plane team. We are responsible for a service that:

- Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud-native OpenSearch clusters and collections, freeing customers from sizing, scaling, and patching decisions
- Guarantees high availability and durability for mission-critical search and observability workloads at the scale of the most demanding internet businesses
- Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of an OpenSearch cluster or collection — from creation through scale-up, scale-out, upgrade, replication, and fail-over

The OpenSearch control plane is not just any distributed system. It orchestrates a fleet of clusters across every AWS region, detects and recovers from node failures in seconds, and serves workloads that span petabytes of customer data. Most recently, we launched **OpenSearch Serverless NextGen** — delivering ultra-fast collection provisioning and true scale-to-zero capacity, so customers pay only for what they use and get a working environment in seconds rather than minutes. We are not done; this is one of many investments raising the bar for what customers can expect from a managed search service.

OpenSearch itself is a community-driven, Apache 2.0–licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases advancing core search, vector search, and analytics. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine — one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

We work in Java, Rust, Python, and Go. We contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene. We are customer-obsessed, operate with the entrepreneurial pace of a startup inside one of the world's largest cloud providers, and value strong intuition backed by metrics.

**Operations is core engineering on this team, not overhead.** Engineers operate what they build, and we treat customer-impacting incidents with the same engineering rigor we apply to feature work. Reliability and Static Stability is a forcing function for design, not a phase after launch.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, develop, and operate components of a large-scale distributed control plane — reason about failure modes, multi-tenant isolation, and blast-radius before writing code
- Look for opportunities to simplify — consolidate duplicate abstractions, remove dead code, reduce configuration sprawl, and challenge complexity that doesn't earn its keep
- Treat operations as core engineering — own the systems you build end-to-end, participate fully in incident response and RCAs, and drive operational improvements that reduce cost and maintenance burden
- Solve real problems in cluster orchestration, capacity provisioning, lifecycle workflows, multi-tenant infrastructure, query routing, and operational tooling
- Use AI coding assistants and GenAI tools effectively across the software development lifecycle — from design and prototyping through coding, testing, code review, debugging, and operations — applying engineering judgment to validate AI-generated output against Amazon's correctness, security, and operational bar
- Write robust, efficient, and maintainable code in Java, Rust, Python, or Go
- Partner with senior engineers to translate ambiguous requirements into concrete deliverables; prototype, test, and validate
- Continually challenge what exists and explore what should change to better serve customers

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Delivery Consultant - Data , Professional Services, AWSI Energy
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a Delivery Consultant specializing in Datae. You will be at the center of the most consequential shift in enterprise technology: making organizations truly AI-ready. Every agentic AI system, every foundation model grounded in enterprise knowledge, and every GenAI application that moves from prototype to production depends on the data layer beneath it - and that's what you build.

You will design and implement modern data platforms (lake, lakehouse, mesh), architect data pipelines that transform raw, fragmented data estates into governed, AI-ready assets; and design and implement enterprise RAG architectures, vector stores, semantic ontologies, and knowledge graph architectures that allow foundation models and AI agents to reason accurately, access data securely, and execute autonomously within regulated environments. You will work hands-on inside customer environments with complex data lineage, regulatory overlays (GxP, HIPAA, CDISC), and legacy systems, and ship production-grade data products that serve multiple downstream consumers, from ML model training to agentic orchestration layers.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using AWS services. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing and AI transformation initiatives.

This role requires approximately 50% co-location on site with customer, AWS and partner teams within the U.S.

221100

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement production-grade data pipelines, data lakes, lakehouses, and data mesh architectures within enterprise environments, integrating with legacy systems and existing data governance frameworks

- Build data products that serve multiple downstream applications and use cases — from AI/ML model training to agentic AI systems, ensuring data quality, lineage, and reliability at scale

- Operate with a high degree of autonomy within fast-moving delivery engagements, making judgment calls on data modeling, pipeline design, and architecture without waiting for perfect specifications or constant oversight

- Architect contextual knowledge layers, including ontologies and knowledge graphs leveraging AWS Context, Amazon Bedrock Knowledge Bases, and custom ontology extensions to equip AI agents with the vocabulary and guardrails to reason accurately and execute autonomously within regulated environments

- Collaborate across organizational boundaries to secure data access, understand source system context, and resolve data quality challenges with teams across customer IT, business, and partner organizations

- Deliver iteratively when requirements are ambiguous, translating incomplete business needs into well-architected data solutions that can evolve as customer understanding matures

- Apply AI-DLC (AI-accelerated Development Life Cycle) methodologies to data delivery to redesign data workflows to become AI-native for accelerated scale and pace

A day in the life
AWS Professional Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. descriptionHtml:
Prime Video is a first-stop entertainment destination offering customers a vast collection of premium programming in one app available across thousands of devices. Prime members can customize their viewing experience and find their favorite movies, series, documentaries, and live sports – including Amazon MGM Studios-produced series and movies; licensed fan favorites; and programming from Prime Video subscriptions such as Apple TV+, HBO Max, Peacock, Crunchyroll and MGM+. All customers, regardless of whether they have a Prime membership or not, can rent or buy titles via the Prime Video Store, and can enjoy even more content for free with ads.

Are you interested in shaping the future of entertainment? Prime Video's technology teams are creating best-in-class digital video experience. As a Prime Video team member, you’ll have end-to-end ownership of the product, user experience, design, and technology required to deliver state-of-the-art experiences for our customers. You’ll get to work on projects that are fast-paced, challenging, and varied. You’ll also be able to experiment with new possibilities, take risks, and collaborate with remarkable people.

We’ll look for you to bring your diverse perspectives, ideas, and skill-sets to make Prime Video even better for our customers. With global opportunities for talented technologists, you can decide where a career Prime Video Tech takes you!

Prime Video is pioneering the use of Generative AI to empower the next generation of creatives. Our mission is to make world-class media creation accessible, scalable and efficient.

We are seeking an Applied Scientist to advance the state of the art in Generative AI and to deliver these innovations as production-ready systems at Amazon scale. Your work will give creators unprecedented freedom and control while driving new efficiencies.

- Design multimodal GenAI workflows including visual-language model tooling, structured prompt orchestration, agentic pipelines

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience

- Experience in generative models (diffusion, flow, transformers)
- Hands-on experience with image/video synthesis and editing techniques

Preferred qualifications

- Publications in top-tier AI/ML/Graphics Conferences (CVPR, ICCV/ECCV, SIGGRAPH, NeurIPS, ICLR)
- Experience with controllable generation methods, including emerging approaches (familiarity with LoRA/ControlNet, parameter-efficient tuning, or test-time training a plus)

title: ML Kernel Performance Engineer, AWS Neuron, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon’s custom machine learning accelerators, Inferentia and Trainium.

The Acceleration Kernel Library team is at the forefront of maximizing performance for AWS's custom ML accelerators. Working at the hardware-software boundary, our engineers craft high-performance kernels for ML functions, ensuring every FLOP counts in delivering optimal performance for our customers' demanding workloads. We combine deep hardware knowledge with ML expertise to push the boundaries of what's possible in AI acceleration.

The AWS Neuron SDK, developed by the Annapurna Labs team at AWS, is the backbone for accelerating deep learning and GenAI workloads on Amazon's Inferentia and Trainium ML accelerators. This comprehensive toolkit includes an ML compiler, runtime, and application framework that seamlessly integrates with popular ML frameworks like PyTorch, enabling unparalleled ML inference and training performance.

As part of the broader Neuron Compiler organization, our team works across multiple technology layers - from frameworks and compilers to runtime and collectives. We not only optimize current performance but also contribute to future architecture designs, working closely with customers to enable their models and ensure optimal performance. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of machine learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures, where you'll help shape the future of AI acceleration technology

This is an opportunity to work on cutting-edge products at the intersection of machine-learning, high-performance computing, and distributed architectures. You will architect and implement business-critical features, publish cutting-edge research, and mentor a brilliant team of experienced engineers. We operate in spaces that are very large, yet our teams remain small and agile. There is no blueprint. We're inventing. We're experimenting. It is a very unique learning culture. The team works closely with customers on their model enablement, providing direct support and optimization expertise to ensure their machine learning workloads achieve optimal performance on AWS ML accelerators.

Our kernel engineers collaborate across compiler, runtime, framework, and hardware teams to optimize machine learning workloads for our global customer base. Working at the intersection of software, hardware, and machine learning systems, you'll bring expertise in low-level optimization, system architecture, and ML model acceleration. * Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models
* Analyze and optimize kernel-level performance across multiple generations of Neuron hardware
* Conduct detailed performance analysis using profiling tools to identify and resolve bottlenecks
* Implement compiler optimizations such as fusion, sharding, tiling, and scheduling

title: Data Scientist , Amazon Transportation Services (NEST)
descriptionHtml:
Have you ever placed an order on Amazon and wondered how it got to you so fast? Behind that speed is a massive transportation network generating billions of data points daily. We need someone who can turn that data into clarity.

Come join the Network Engineering, Scheduling and Technology (NEST) Science team within Amazon Transportation Services. We are looking for a Data Scientist who is equal parts data engineer, visualization architect, and analytical modeler. You will own the end-to-end build process for data-driven solutions: identifying business needs, developing simulation and optimization models, building computationally efficient analytical tools, and narrating results through compelling data storytelling. This is not a dashboard-building role. You will work at the intersection of large-scale data processing, advanced analytics (including simulation and optimization), and data visualization, building tools that allow stakeholders to explore millions of records interactively, uncover patterns in network performance, and make data-driven decisions with confidence.

The ideal candidate is a data wizard who thrives on wrangling massive datasets, building predictive and prescriptive models, architecting performant query and aggregation pipelines, and crafting visualizations that communicate complex findings with precision and clarity. You will own the full lifecycle, from problem identification and data extraction through modeling and simulation to production-grade analytical applications that narrate results back to stakeholders. You will collaborate closely with scientists, engineers, and product managers

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end analytical lifecycle: identify stakeholder needs, frame problems, build models, and narrate results through data tools and visualizations

- Design and build production-grade analytical tools, BI applications, and interactive data products that enable self-service exploration of very large transportation datasets (billions of records)

- Develop and enhance simulation and optimization models (discrete event simulation, agent-based modeling, mathematical optimization) applied to network planning and transportation operations

- Architect computationally efficient data pipelines and aggregation strategies that support responsive, real-time or near-real-time visualization at scale

- Develop advanced data storytelling artifacts that communicate complex network dynamics, trends, and anomalies to technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Build and maintain reusable visualization frameworks and libraries tailored to transportation network data (routing, scheduling, flow, capacity)

- Work with large-scale data platforms (Redshift, Spark, S3, Athena) to extract, transform, and model data for analytical consumption

- Develop code (Python, SQL, Scala) for data processing, statistical modeling, simulation, and building automated analytical workflows

- Collaborate with Applied Scientists, Research Scientists, Software Engineers, and Product Managers to integrate analytical tools into broader planning and decision-support systems

- Define and implement best practices for data visualization performance, including sampling strategies, level-of-detail rendering, and progressive loading for large datasets

- Communicate findings, methodology, and recommendations through compelling written and verbal presentations to leadership and business customers

About the team
The Network Engineering, Scheduling, and Technology (NEST) Science Team prototype, build, and productionize mathematical models that reduce transportation cost and improve customer experience in Amazon's Middle Mile network. Equipped with techniques from Operations Research, Machine Learning and Simulation, these models are used to govern scheduling and equipment selection of hundreds of thousands of truck movements, optimize network configurations, determine the transit times between nodes, and simulate network flow under uncertainty for informed decision making. Our core team consists of Applied, Data, and Research Scientists along with technical Product Managers that come from diverse backgrounds.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of data scientist experience
- 3+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- 3+ years of machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance experience
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
- Experience with big data: processing, filtering, and presenting large quantities (100K to Millions of rows) of data
- Bachelor's degree

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree
- Experience in a ML or data scientist role with a large technology company
- Experience with AWS services including S3, Redshift, Sagemaker, EMR, Kinesis, Lambda, and EC2
- Experience in building self-service analytical tools
- Proficiency in advanced visualization libraries and frameworks (D3.js, Deck.gl, Plotly, etc.)

title: Cloud Hardware Development Engineer, Storage , AWS Hardware Engineering, Hardware Engineering Services
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Nov 15, 2026

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we're the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we're looking for talented people who want to help.


You'll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You'll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you'll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.


Amazon Web Services (AWS) Hardware Engineering (HWEng) team creates compute and storage server designs for Amazon's innovative web services. Our designs are industry-leading in performance, frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the more than one million customers who use AWS today.


What you will do: As a Hardware Development Engineer III on the Storage Server Hardware Engineering team, you will own the architecture, validation, and production quality of our storage server platforms and AWS-specific storage hardware components. You will drive ODM engagement from design review through mass production, define test flow architecture and yield strategy, and own pass/fail criteria for storage server systems. You will partner with cross-functional teams (firmware, mechanical, thermal, supply chain) to deliver storage platforms from NPI through end-of-life.


This is a fast-paced, intellectually demanding role. You will operate as the technical owner for storage system hardware — setting the bar on signal integrity, power delivery, and storage subsystem architecture. You will have a direct impact on fleet reliability, cost, and performance at massive scale.


Key job responsibilities
Own storage server system architecture and hardware design decisions from concept through mass production and fleet deployment

Drive ODM oversight model: lead schematic reviews, layout reviews, and design quality gates for storage server platforms

Define and own test flow architecture, yield strategy, and pass/fail criteria for storage hardware validation and manufacturing

Lead NPI execution for new storage server platforms — coordinate EVT/DVT/PVT milestones, drive issue resolution, and ensure production readiness

Partner with firmware, mechanical, thermal, and supply chain teams to deliver integrated storage systems meeting performance, cost, and reliability targets

Own production quality and fleet reliability for storage server hardware — drive root cause analysis and corrective actions for field issues

Define and improve validation methodologies, design standards, and manufacturing processes for storage server hardware

Mentor and develop peer engineers; perform HDE technical assessments



A day in the life
You will start your day reviewing production yield data and field reliability metrics for your storage server platforms. You may join a design review with your ODM partner to evaluate a schematic change for a next-generation storage system, catching a signal integrity concern before it becomes a board spin. After lunch you might define pass/fail criteria for a new NVMe SSD qualification, then pivot to a cross-functional sync where you drive resolution of a thermal issue discovered during DVT. You'll close the day mentoring a junior engineer on failure analysis methodology for a fleet issue. You operate with high ownership and bias for action — finding paths forward through ambiguity and making trade-offs between short-term schedule pressure and long-term fleet quality.

About the team
The AWS Storage Server Hardware Engineering team designs and delivers the storage platforms that power Amazon S3, EBS, and other critical AWS storage services. We own our platforms cradle-to-grave: from architecture definition through NPI, manufacturing, fleet deployment, and end-of-life. Our engineers operate as technical owners — not hands-off program managers — with deep accountability for the quality and performance of the hardware we ship at massive scale.

- Experience developing test strategies and plans for complex hardware/software systems or systems of systems
- 5+ years of hardware design and validation experience with server, storage, or networking systems
- Experience with ODM/OEM engagement including schematic review, layout review, and production quality oversight
- Experience with storage subsystems (SSD/HDD interfaces, NVMe, SAS/SATA, PCIe) or high-speed serial interfaces
- Experience troubleshooting hardware issues using oscilloscopes, protocol analyzers, and JTAG debug tools

- Experience in Linux-based hardware debug and system-level integration testing

title: Finance Manager, NA Supply Chain Execution Finance
descriptionHtml:
The NA Supply Chain Execution Finance team is looking for a Finance Manager to serve as a strategic finance partner within the Supply Chain Execution space. This role will own end-to-end financial controllership for key volume planning processes, partnering closely with Network, Sortable, Non-Sortable, and IXD S&OP teams to optimize the flow of 40B+ units through Amazon's North American fulfillment network. Our inbound supply chain has evolved considerably in recent years — with FC-FC transfers reduced from 20% to 13%, over $300M in validated cost savings delivered in FY2025, and more innovation to come.

This Finance Manager will own the financial narrative for their domain — driving cost transparency, building scalable mechanisms, and delivering insights that influence VP-level decisions. You will operate with significant autonomy, manage ambiguity across multiple planning cycles, and influence outcomes across 4+ partner organizations without direct authority.

This is a perfect role for someone who knows how to lead fast, think strategically, and drive results across multiple stakeholder teams. Your experience in operations finance gives you the perspective to look around corners and proactively avoid problems. You know which details drive millions in impact and which ones don't add value. You can clearly communicate complex trade-offs to senior leadership and effectively influence partners using data-driven recommendations.

Finance is all about the numbers…unless you work at Amazon; it's knowing the numbers and so much more. We seek Finance Managers who combine analytical rigor with strategic business partnership — leaders who don't just report what happened, but shape what happens next. Do you view problems as treasures, and are you willing to dive deep to develop solutions that drive nine-figure impact? Will you challenge the status quo, build mechanisms that scale, and influence cross-functional partners without direct authority? At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires working with a dynamic network of Operations, Science and Tech, and Supply Chain partners. We are the trusted business advisors — employing every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and leaders make the best possible decisions. Come teach us a few things, and we'll teach you a few things as we navigate the most customer-centric company on Earth.

Key job responsibilities
1) Financial Controllership & Mechanism Ownership: Own end-to-end financial controllership for assigned planning systems (e.g., True North, F2P, WTPSS, Skippy), ensuring cost inputs are accurate, current, and driving optimal network outcomes

2) Strategic Business Partnership: Serve as the trusted finance advisor to S&OP business partners — translating operational decisions into financial impact, quantifying trade-offs, and recommending actions that optimize for cost and speed

3) Planning Cycle Leadership: Own metric inputs and financial narratives for quarterly and annual planning cycles (OP2, QXG, OP1/3YF), aligning cross-functional assumptions across SCOT, MTP, Capacity, and Operations teams

4) Cost Savings Identification & Delivery: Identify, validate, and track cost savings opportunities across the inbound and outbound network — building entitlement cases and holding organizations accountable to committed plans

5) Executive Communication: Deliver WBR/MBR insights, variance analyses, and strategic recommendations to Director and VP-level audiences. Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives.

6) Cross-Functional Influence: Drive alignment across 4+ partner organizations (S&OP, SCOT, NACF Operations, Network Design, Field Finance) without direct authority — using data, relationships, and mechanisms

7) Automation & Scalability: Identify opportunities to automate, standardize, or simplify finance processes — reducing manual effort and improving data accuracy and timeliness

A day in the life
Own the financial narrative for your domain within NA Supply Chain. Lead weekly and quarterly forecasting that optimizes for end-to-end costs across the network. Build cost models that quantify the impact of operational decisions — from inventory placement to transfer routing to capacity utilization. Present recommendations to Directors and VPs in WBR and MBR forums. Partner with upstream and downstream teams to root cause variances, quantify risks and opportunities, and drive corrective actions. Build mechanisms that create accountability and reduce plan-vs-actual variance.

About the team
The NA Supply Chain Execution Finance team is the financial backbone for US and Canada S&OP, providing controllership, strategic partnership, and technical expertise for 40B+ units annually flowing through Cross Docks, Distribution Centers, and Fulfillment Centers. We translate customer demand into executable fulfillment plans that enable inventory to flow at lower cost and faster speed.

We own critical planning systems (True North, Skippy, F2P, WTPSS) and influence five core levers: Volume, Outbound Cost, Ops Variable, Ops Fixed, and Freight Cost In. A 1% variance in our metrics represents $43-51M annually — the decisions we inform matter at scale.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, business, economics, or a related analytical field (e.g., engineering, math, computer science), or Bachelor's degree
- 5+ years of finance or a related analytical field experience

Preferred qualifications

- MBA, or CPA
- Knowledge of SQL/ETL
- 6+ years of identifying incomplete or inaccurate data, identifying the root cause and creating/implementing an escalation plan experience
- Experience working with large-scale data mining and reporting tools (examples: SQL, MS Access, Essbase, Cognos) and other financial systems (examples: Oracle, SAP, Lawson, JD Edwards)
- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience

descriptionHtml:
This position is part of the AWS Specialist and Partner Organization (ASP). Specialists own the end-to-end go-to-market strategy for their respective technology domains, providing the business and technical expertise to help our customers succeed. Partner teams own the strategy, recruiting, development, and growth of our key technology and consulting partners. Together they provide our customers with the expertise and scale needed to build innovative solutions for their most complex challenges.

Are you a customer-obsessed technical leader with a passion for building high-performing teams and driving business growth? Do you have a background in communication services (email, SMS, WhatsApp, RCS, multi-channel communications, and CPaaS) and experience leading Solutions Architects? Join the Worldwide Specialist Organization (WWSO) team as the Sr. Manager, Solutions Architecture for Communication Developer Services (CDS).

CDS includes Amazon Simple Email Service (SES) and AWS End User Messaging — cloud-based services that enable customers to reach their audiences across email, SMS, RCS, push notifications, and WhatsApp for marketing outreach, transactional communications, and customer engagement at scale. As messaging evolves toward conversational and agentic AI — where intelligent agents handle customer interactions, resolve issues, and orchestrate multi-step workflows autonomously across channels — CDS is at the forefront of that transformation. In this role you will lead a globally distributed team of Specialist SAs, set the technical bar for the portfolio, and own and lead key business and technical initiatives to grow the CDS business — from defining the technical go-to-market strategy to launching programs that accelerate adoption and revenue.

Beyond growing your team, you will create, own, and drive business initiatives end-to-end — this role blends people leadership with hands-on business ownership. You will leverage AI to identify patterns across customer engagements and build scalable solutions — playbooks, reference architectures, and automation — that help account teams and customers get to outcomes faster. You will partner closely with sales, business development, marketing, and product management to connect technical strategy to business results.

If you want to lead a world-class SA team while personally shaping the business trajectory of a high-growth portfolio, consider joining CDS — where we help customers realize the full potential of multi-channel communication on AWS.

Amazon Web Services is seeking a results-driven Account-Based Marketing (ABM) Manager to design and execute high-impact ABM programs for enterprise customers. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on execution to drive measurable business outcomes through targeted marketing initiatives.

The Account-Based Marketing Manager will own the ABM strategy and end-to-end execution of territory ABM programs, working backwards from customer needs to create data-driven, multi-channel campaigns that accelerate pipeline and revenue growth. This role requires strategic marketing expertise, strong project management skills, analytical capabilities, and the ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders.

We are looking for a marketer who is intellectually curious, analytically grounded and creatively agile; someone who can navigate ambiguity, challenge conventional approaches, and build scalable solutions while maintaining the personalization required for strategic account outreach.


Key job responsibilities
* Develop account-based marketing strategies for priority enterprise customers, translating business objectives, customer insights, account priorities, and market dynamics into actionable 1:1 and 1:few marketing plans.
* Serve as a strategic marketing partner to Sales, working closely with account teams and Sales leaders to understand customer priorities, identify growth opportunities, and determine where marketing can have the greatest impact.
* Build integrated customer engagement initiatives that connect account insights, messaging, content, executive engagement, digital marketing, events, and other channels into cohesive customer experiences.
* Bring creative agility to account challenges, identifying new approaches and developing differentiated programs that engage key decision makers, buying groups, and influencers.
* Own programs from strategy through execution, establishing objectives, developing plans, coordinating cross-functional resources, managing budgets and timelines, and ensuring high-quality delivery.
* Develop account-specific content and messaging that translates account insights, business priorities and AWS capabilities into relevant narratives and assets that engage key decision makers and buying groups.

* Identify opportunities to collaborate with AWS partners where joint engagement can strengthen customer value propositions, deepen relationships, or accelerate strategic opportunities.
* Measure business impact, establishing account-level objectives and evaluating engagement, account progression, opportunity acceleration, pipeline influence, revenue contribution, and program ROI.
* Build for scale, identifying successful approaches, codifying best practices, and creating repeatable frameworks that can be adopted across accounts and regions.
* Contribute to the evolution of ABM at AWS, sharing insights, experimentation, and best practices with the broader global ABM community.

title: Senior Business Developer, National Security & Defence, Asia Pacific, Global Government
descriptionHtml:
Are you a seasoned intelligence or defence professional who has successfully transitioned into the commercial cloud and technology sector? Do you combine deep operational experience in national security with the commercial acumen to drive cloud and AI adoption at national scale?

As an AWS Business Developer focused on National Security & Defence (NSD) in Asia Pacific, you will drive regional NSD business development by leveraging your firsthand understanding of intelligence and defence operations to earn trust with the most senior leaders in the region. You will take proven patterns and approaches from mature markets and support other nations across Asia Pacific to learn from and adopt them at pace. Asia Pacific nations face a rapidly evolving and increasingly complex security landscape and are investing urgently in cloud and AI capabilities to strengthen sovereignty, improve intelligence and operational readiness, and modernise defence forces. You will accelerate their cloud and AI journey by combining your deep domain credibility with commercial cloud expertise to transfer what works rather than starting from scratch in each country.

The ideal candidate will have served in or worked extensively with intelligence or defence organisations, giving them an innate understanding of how these communities operate — from intelligence cycles and collection-to-assessment workflows to defence capability development, operational planning, and force employment. Critically, they will have complemented this domain depth with significant commercial experience in cloud computing, understanding how hyperscale cloud platforms are architected, secured, operated, and adopted by the world's most security-conscious organisations. This combination of operational credibility and commercial cloud fluency is essential.

You must possess a deep understanding of the security considerations and geopolitical environment across the Asia Pacific region — including alliance structures, threat landscapes, regional security architectures, and the political dynamics that shape defence and intelligence investment decisions. You will bring the kind of background and gravitas that causes senior leadership across defence and intelligence agencies to listen, engage, and act. You are recognised as a leading voice and thought leader within the NSD community across Asia Pacific and Japan, with the relationships and reputation to open doors at the highest levels.

You will work cross-functionally with AWS country teams, solutions architects, and partners across the region to build pipeline, close opportunities, and deliver measurable outcomes for customers. You will articulate compelling value propositions for cloud and AI adoption, shape joint go-to-market strategies with partners, and package repeatable playbooks that help country teams accelerate NSD adoption locally.

With AWS, our customers benefit from the fastest pace of innovation, the broadest and deepest functionality, the most secure computing environment, and the most proven operational expertise. In this role, you will bring these capabilities to bear for national security and defence customers across Asia Pacific, helping them solve problems that matter at national scale.

You will be part of a small, focused team of NSD domain and technical experts driven by customer mission. Your week will move between engaging senior defence and national security leaders, working with AWS country teams to align domain expertise with local execution, shaping partner propositions, packaging repeatable playbooks and engagement models that help country teams accelerate NSD adoption locally, and identifying where cloud and AI can make a material difference to how nations defend sovereignty and protect citizens. This is a role for someone who has lived the mission, understands what these organisations need, thrives in ambiguity, builds trust quickly at the most senior levels, and turns opportunity into outcomes.

title: Senior Space & Radiation Effects Engineer, Amazon Leo
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

As a Senior Radiation Effects Engineer on the Amazon Leo team, you will be responsible for ensuring avionics and payload hardware performance across our satellite constellation through the challenging LEO radiation environment. You will perform analysis, design guidance, and testing at the component, board, unit, and subsystem levels — working with a vast array of satellite electronics to ensure radiation reliability.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
Amazon seeks a Senior Radiation Effects Engineer to be part of a small team focused on reliability against radiation effects.
• Candidate will define, collect, and analyze TID, heavy ion, and proton testing data to qualify components against space radiation and help build a database of electronic component test data
• Candidate will help to determine system-level impact of radiation-induced failures
• Candidate will be responsible for the qualification of a wide range of electronic components including microcontrollers, memory devices, FPGAs, and power management hardware
• Will work with an interdisciplinary team to offer guidance to electrical design engineers on the selection and proper utilization of radiation sensitive components
• Lead root-cause analysis of on-orbit radiation events. Develop tools and dashboards to organize and visualize on-orbit events.
• Develop processes for managing component and satellite hardware test results and documentation
• Develop testing and reporting standards for component and flight PCBA radiation tests
• Work with supply chain and component reliability teams to refine preferred components across programs
• Review PCN changes to ensure maintenance of radiation qualification status

About the team
At Amazon, we are working to build the world's most advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite constellation to deliver fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the globe. Project Kuiper (Amazon Leo) will provide connectivity for tens of millions of customers who lack reliable internet access. This is an ambitious, long-term program that combines Amazon's customer obsession with latest technology in aerospace engineering.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or a related field, or experience working in electrical engineering field
- 3+ years of experience in spaceflight avionics development, parts selection, and radiation test
- 3+ years System design and component qualification experience with radiation environments and radiation tolerant hardware
- Demonstrated understanding of the impact of SEE and TID effects on electronic systems.
- Experience with one or more standard radiation environment modeling tools, including but not limited to IRENE, OMERE, SIRE2, SPENVIS, OLTARIS, CREME96, SAPPHIRE, ESP, or PSYCHIC.

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree or above in electrical engineering, computer science, mathematics or physics
- PhD in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related technical field
- Experience in component selection and understanding of component reliability
- Experience with one or more radiation transport codes, including but not limited to NOVICE, FASTRAD, SHIELDOSE2, GEANT4, or MCNP.
- Experience with NASA, Defense or Commercial Space programs.
- Knowledge of any of the following: Python, LabView, AI-vibe coding.
- Experience collaborating with reliability team with vehicle-level reliability models.
- Knowledge of AWS tools such as S3 and DynamoDB.
- Proficiency with hardware blueprints/schematics and circuit functions based on designs.
- Proficiency with avionics hardware spanning integrated circuits, PCBA boards, sensors/transducers, functional troubleshooting, and defect detection

title: Software Dev Engineer, AWS Elastic Container Service
descriptionHtml:
AWS Elastic Container Service (ECS) is forming a new team in Seattle with a bold mission: dramatically reduce the time it takes for containerized workloads to become ready to run on Fargate. The vast majority of customer tasks are short-lived, making launch speed one of the most impactful levers for customer experience — and we're going after a step-function improvement.

As an SDE on the Workload Optimization team, you'll work at the intersection of container runtimes, operating systems, and networking to optimize the end-to-end launch path. This is deep systems work with direct, measurable customer impact at enormous scale.

Key job responsibilities
Build and optimize container startup and runtime systems using Linux kernel, containerd/runc, and Bottlerocket
Design and implement solutions across the container networking and instance preparation stack
Work on one of the highest-scale container orchestration platforms in the world
Join a founding team with greenfield ownership and the opportunity to shape technical direction from day one

About the team
Amazon Elastic Container Service (ECS) makes it easy for customers to run, scale, and secure containerized applications on AWS. ECS powers some of the most demanding workloads on the planet — from startups launching their first container to enterprises running millions of tasks across global infrastructure.

The Workload Optimization team is a brand-new team within ECS, based in Seattle, with a focused mission: fundamentally reduce the time it takes for a containerized workload to become ready to run on AWS Fargate. For the vast majority of Fargate customers, launch latency is one of the biggest factors in their end-to-end experience — and we believe a step-function improvement is achievable.

This is a greenfield team, which means you won't be inheriting legacy systems or processes — you'll be building from scratch. You'll work deep in the systems stack (Linux kernel, container runtimes, OS, networking) alongside a small, senior group of engineers who care deeply about performance, correctness, and customer impact at scale.

We value engineers who think from first principles, are comfortable with ambiguity, and are energized by hard problems that don't have obvious solutions. Our culture is direct, low-ceremony, and high-ownership — you'll have real influence over what we build and how we build it from day one.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

You'll drive independent research initiatives in areas such as perception, manipulation, science understanding, locomotion, manipulation, sim2real transfer, multi-modal foundation models and multi-task robot learning, designing novel frameworks that bridge the gap between state-of-the-art research and real-world deployment at Amazon scale.

In this role, you'll balance innovative technical exploration with practical implementation, collaborating with platform teams to ensure your models and algorithms perform robustly in dynamic real-world environments. You'll have access to Amazon's vast computational resources, enabling you to tackle ambitious problems in areas like very large multi-modal robotic foundation models and efficient, promptable model architectures that can scale across diverse robotic applications.


Key job responsibilities
- Drive independent research initiatives across the robotics stack, including robotics foundation models, focusing on breakthrough approaches in perception, and manipulation, for example open-vocabulary panoptic scene understanding, scaling up multi-modal LLMs, sim2real/real2sim techniques, end-to-end vision-language-action models, efficient model inference, video tokenization
- Design and implement novel deep learning architectures that push the boundaries of what robots can understand and accomplish
- Lead full-stack robotics projects from conceptualization through deployment, taking a system-level approach that integrates hardware considerations with algorithmic development, ensuring robust performance in production environments
- Collaborate with platform and hardware teams to ensure seamless integration across the entire robotics stack, optimizing and scaling models for real-world applications
- Contribute to the team's technical strategy and help shape our approach to next-generation robotics challenges

A day in the life
- Design and implement novel foundation model architectures and innovative systems and algorithms, leveraging our extensive infrastructure to prototype and evaluate at scale
- Collaborate with our world-class research team to solve complex technical challenges
- Lead technical initiatives from conception to deployment, working closely with robotics engineers to integrate your solutions into production systems
- Participate in technical discussions and brainstorming sessions with team leaders and fellow scientists
- Leverage our massive compute cluster and extensive robotics infrastructure to rapidly prototype and validate new ideas
- Transform theoretical insights into practical solutions that can handle the complexities of real-world robotics applications

About the team
At Frontier AI & Robotics, we're not just advancing robotics – we're reimagining it from the ground up. Our team is building the future of intelligent robotics through innovative foundation models and end-to-end learned systems. We tackle some of the most challenging problems in AI and robotics, from developing sophisticated perception systems to creating adaptive manipulation strategies that work in complex, real-world scenarios.

What sets us apart is our unique combination of ambitious research vision and practical impact. We leverage Amazon's massive computational infrastructure and rich real-world datasets to train and deploy state-of-the-art foundation models. Our work spans the full spectrum of robotics intelligence – from multimodal perception using images, videos, and sensor data, to sophisticated manipulation strategies that can handle diverse real-world scenarios. We're building systems that don't just work in the lab, but scale to meet the demands of Amazon's global operations.

Join us if you're excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotics, working with world-class researchers, and seeing your innovations deployed at unprecedented scale.

Basic qualifications

- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in Java, C++, Python, or a related language
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
- Experience building machine learning models or developing algorithms for business application
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience developing and implementing deep learning models
- Track record of solving complex technical problems

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- First-author publications at major or top-tier ML/Robotics/AI conferences
- Experience with foundation models or large language models
- Background in Robotics, computer vision, or related fields
- Experience with sim2real transfer or multi-task learning
- Familiarity with distributed training systems
- Track record of deploying ML models in production environments

- Extensive programming skills in Python and PyTorch/JAX

title: Senior Project Manager, EMEA Construction (Power & Water)
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure is building and operating water systems that are industry-leading examples of efficiency, resilience, and sustainable design. As a Senior Construction Manager for Water Infrastructure, you will autonomously lead the delivery of water supply, treatment, and wastewater projects at scale across EMEA - from concept through commissioning and handover to operations.

You will provide oversight across all disciplines - civil, mechanical, process, controls, and environmental - ensuring our water systems meet demanding performance, cost, and schedule targets. You will navigate complex regulatory and permitting landscapes (including EIA, permitting, and local water authority approvals) while driving construction safety and quality standards on site.

That ownership creates unique opportunities to integrate water infrastructure with power and mechanical systems in ways traditional utilities cannot. You will work at that intersection, collaborating with electrical, mechanical, and commissioning teams to deliver some of the most sophisticated utility infrastructure in the world.

We are a diverse, fast-paced team of engineers and managers who solve complex problems daily for our customers. If you thrive on technical challenge and operational ownership, this role is for you.

- This will include the ownership of the project scope, timeline, and budget.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor’s degree Construction Management or an equivalent engineering science, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering.

title: Art Director, Brand & Content, Amazon Design Excellence
descriptionHtml:

In this role, you'll be responsible for the day-to-day creative production that makes Amazon's design community look and feel cohesive, polished, and distinctive at every touchpoint.

You'll work across digital, print, motion, experiential, and environmental design, and you'll be the person ensuring that Amazon Design's web presence is visually sharp, well-structured, and consistently on-brand. This means rolling up your sleeves on layout, typography, asset production, and visual QA just as often as you're developing a creative concept.

The ideal candidate has strong conceptual thinking and a wide range of craft skills, but what really sets them apart is the ability to move fast, manage multiple projects in parallel, and consistently deliver high-quality production assets across formats and channels without losing the thread on brand coherence.

Key job responsibilities
Brand & Visual Identity

• Build and maintain scalable design systems, component libraries, and production templates that reduce turnaround time and improve consistency across deliverables.

• Coordinate content capture (photography, video, written recaps) during events for post-event storytelling across digital channels.

Marketing & Communications
• Create visual assets for internal and external campaigns across email, social, digital platforms, and the Amazon Design website.
• Produce year-in-review and milestone storytelling pieces with visual narratives that amplify the design community's impact.

- Have an online portfolio demonstrating strong visual design skills and advertising experience across a range of media and platforms, along with work that reflects your design process

- Experience designing and prototyping with tools such as Figma, Adobe Creative Cloud, or similar

title: Sr. Product Manager- Technical, WW Ops Finance S&A
descriptionHtml:
As a Senior Product Manager-Technical in WW Ops Finance Standardization & Automation, you will lead the vision, roadmap and execution for a combined charter spanning both data management/governance and data consumption by finance routines. We don't build data — we manage and govern it. Data management and governance is the critical function that ensures a trustworthy, reliable supply of data: the oxygen for the entire Amazon Stores Finance organization.

You will own the products that govern how finance data is standardized, certified, and made trustworthy (data platforms, metrics, governance) AND the products that let finance routines consume that governed data at scale — including reporting and financial bridging (variance analysis, carve-outs, plan-vs-actual composition). Applying AI to data management and governance is an exciting frontier for this role: you'll tackle the hard problem of extracting semantic meaning from a multitude of data ecosystems that often lack proper documentation, and translating that into use-case-specific, trustworthy datasets and metrics — a frontier with significant room to invent and evolve. You will partner with other Product Managers, Finance partners, Business Intelligence (BI) Managers, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Engineers (BIEs), and Technical Program/Product Managers (TPMs) to understand inputs from multiple internal and external sources and develop a product vision and strategy that connects the governed data layer directly to the finance routines that depend on it.

We have a strong vision and are iterating rapidly with incremental value to our customers — this role carries a highly visible charter and strategic significance, spanning the full arc from data governance to finance-routine consumption. This comes with a lot of opportunities to develop/launch a new suite of technical product capabilities to govern our data ecosystem and the services built on top of it, and to grow as a product leader.


About you
You’re an accountable, hands-on product leader with a strong focus on problem solving with a positive attitude, who lets nothing stand in the way. You know how to clarify the path forward and prioritize work while dealing with ambiguity and limited data points. You know how to influence others. You’re a natural collaborator equally comfortable talking business process with operation leaders, tech with developers, user experience with designers, positioning with product marketers, numbers with finance and marketing, and strategy with executive leadership. You stay the course on your vision, but remain flexible in how you achieve it, keeping overall success and incremental value to your customers in mind.


Key job responsibilities
The critical functions for this leader are as follows: Own one or more products spanning Data Management/Governance and Finance Reporting & Bridging Services:
- Be the ultimate owner of the product vision, strategy and execution across both the data governance layer (standardization, certification, metrics, metadata) and the consumption layer (reporting, financial bridging, and routine-level data delivery).
- Champion the application of AI to data management and governance — extracting semantic meaning and lineage from sprawling, often-undocumented data ecosystems, and translating that into trustworthy, use-case-specific datasets and metrics finance teams can rely on. - Create and manage a unified roadmap, prioritization framework, entitlement model, and success metrics that connect data governance directly to finance-routine outcomes (e.g., faster bridge delivery, self-service reporting, reduced manual reconciliation).
- Define how finance routines (WBR, MBR, MEC, planning) consume governed data — including bridging/carve-out logic, drill-down grain, and dimension inheritance — in partnership with the data governance roadmap. - Recruit customers to be part of advisors, share roadmap with customer stakeholders and partners across both data producer/steward and finance-routine consumer audiences.
- Design and implement new processes to delight Finance customers at scale, from data producers and stewards through finance analysts to leadership consumers. - Implement and manage a Product/Program Management framework that ensures completeness of requirements and communication with stakeholders through scalable mechanisms such as business reviews, news flashes, and dashboards.



A day in the life
As a Product Leader in S&A, you are empowered to make data-driven decisions, articulate your vision and sell your features for implementation. You are expected to articulate your point of view with crisp communication, demonstrate ability to synthesize the inputs from your partners and stakeholders, and achieve alignment in harmonious way. You will proactively manage product backlog and work closely with your tech team and TPMs to ensure deliveries that deliver both value and take the product towards S&A North Star vision.

About the team
WW Ops Finance S&A Data Platforms team is tasked with defining the data governance strategy for Amazon Stores Finance and implementing it through scalable platforms and products. We don't build data — we manage and govern it, ensuring a trustworthy, reliable supply of data that is the oxygen for the entire Stores Finance organization. Our products span both how finance data is governed and how it is consumed by finance routines, supporting automation and standardization of planning, reporting, and financial bridging (variance analysis, carve-outs, and plan-vs-actual composition). A defining frontier for this team is applying AI to data management and governance itself — understanding semantic meaning across a multitude of data ecosystems that often lack proper documentation, and evolving that into governed, use-case-specific datasets and metrics. We build features and products that span the full data stack, from Medallion-architecture governance through to the finance-facing reporting and bridging services built on top of it.

- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- Bachelor's degree
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product
- Experience contributing to engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of end to end product delivery experience
- Experience in building and driving adoption of new tools

title: Sr Technical Program Manager, Proactive Security (Level 6)
descriptionHtml:
Cryptographically relevant quantum computers could break the classical cryptography that protects the confidentiality and integrity of Amazon customers' data. As the industry accelerates its post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness timelines, Specialized Business Security (SBS) must reason about and migrate an unusually diverse portfolio: devices already in customers' homes, future devices, protected content on third-party devices, and customer traffic across satellite and ground infrastructure. As Technical Program Manager for the SBS-wide PQProgram, you will own the cross-cutting PQC problems shared across teams and turn a fast-evolving, ambiguous space into clear tracked plans, and measurable readiness outcomes.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end PQC journey for shared crypto problems: code signing, PKI infrastructure, Crypto Bill of Materials (CBOM), and PQC migration of backend services.
- Coordinate PQC work across Amazon organizations, importing and exporting reusable techniques and artifacts so related hardware and software efforts build on each other rather than in isolation.
- Enumerate PQC readiness across device-relevant industry standards (Matter, Bluetooth, OAuth 2.0, DRM), clarify each standard's trajectory, and drive informed next steps with product and security teams.
- Define program strategy, objectives, and success metrics; align stakeholders; and drive delivery across engineering teams while navigating crypto trade-offs, including device form-factor constraints (limited RAM/ROM/CPU).
- Run recurring program business reviews, proactively identify and mitigate risk, and write and present narratives to senior leadership.

A day in the life
You review PQProgram metrics, then facilitate a design discussion on PQC migration for a constrained device, weighing algorithm options against RAM/ROM/CPU limits. You join a cross-organization working session to reuse a PQC approach already solved elsewhere in Amazon, draft a section of an upcoming leadership review, and update the standards tracker. Some days you drive execution on a well-defined problem; others you convert genuine ambiguity into a plan the org can follow.

About the team
SBS Core secures a diverse set of Amazon businesses, working backwards from what products need to be secure. The SBS-wide PQProgram coordinates and executes the post-quantum cryptography work shared across these businesses. We value clear thinking, learning quickly in an evolving field, and taking ownership of hard, ambiguous problems that grow more important as the quantum timeline accelerates.

Basic qualifications

- 7+ years of working directly with engineering teams experience
- 5+ years of technical product or program management experience
- 3+ years of software development experience
- 5+ years of technical program management working directly with software engineering teams experience
- Experience managing programs across cross functional teams, building processes and coordinating release schedules

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management experience
- Experience managing projects across cross functional teams, building sustainable processes and coordinating release schedules
- Experience defining KPI's/SLA's used to drive multi-million dollar businesses and reporting to senior leadership
- Familiarity with PQC migration guidance and timelines (e.g., CNSA 2.0, NIST PQC).

• Support the integration and optimisation of security data sources within SIEM platforms

• Contribute to continuous improvement of SOC processes and automation initiatives including authoring SOC SOP’s and runbooks.

• Apply frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK and NIST in concert with the ISM and PSPF to guide security operations.

• Perform on-call duties as required, out of business hours.




A day in the life
A typical day for a Security Engineer may involve

Responding to new detections: Monitor security alerts in real-time, investigate suspicious activities by analysing logs and network traffic, determine if incidents are legitimate threats or false positives, and coordinate immediate response actions including containment and remediation when threats are confirmed.

Write security detections: Develop and implement custom detection rules based on emerging threat intelligence, tune existing security signatures to reduce false positives while maintaining coverage, and create automated alerts for specific attack patterns or indicators of compromise relevant to the organization's environment.

Threat hunt: Proactively search through network logs, endpoint data, and system activities for signs of advanced persistent threats that may have evaded automated detection systems, using threat intelligence feeds and behavioural analysis to identify potential security breaches before they cause significant damage.

Work with service teams on security issues: Collaborate with IT, network, and application teams to remediate identified vulnerabilities, coordinate security patches and system hardening efforts, provide security guidance during incident response, and ensure proper implementation of security controls across all infrastructure components.

Generate metrics and dashboards: Create and maintain security performance indicators including incident response times, threat detection rates, and system availability metrics, develop executive-level reports summarizing security posture and trends, and build real-time dashboards for continuous monitoring of security operations effectiveness.

We value diversity of thought, creativity, and a strong Bias for Action and Earn Trust. We believe that there are no "perfect" security solutions and we develop and iterate using a continuous improvement process.

title: Program Manager III, Transportation Financial Systems (TFS)
descriptionHtml:
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) team is looking for a talented and highly motivated Sr. Program Manager who enjoy solving challenging and complex business problems at Amazon scale.

Imagine being a part of a team where every single team member is a critical voice in the decision-making process, has a meaningful impact on product features, and has the ability to re-define the customer experience. Welcome to Transportation Financial Systems (TFS), where we are building multiple financial automation products and functionalities to meet Amazon’s ever-growing finance and accounting customer requirements. You will be in a well-funded, highly technical, and highly visible business critical tech platform team.

We are a technology team focused on building a suite of products for transportation financial systems and beyond that enable Amazon business units (BUs) to add new offerings at scale. Our products abstract complexities from the world of accounting, invoicing, audit, payment, taxation, and allocation at the required level of fidelity and insights to build generic solutions scalable to multiple businesses and geographies. We ensure that financial functions are complete, accurate, timely and compliant with worldwide regulatory and tax requirements. Our software systems include services that handle thousands or requests per second and make decisions to pay billions of dollars a year and ensure that transportation's liabilities and revenues are correctly accounted. Our current team comprises of ~200+ engineering organization and Program management team of 10+ TPMs and Program Managers with great growth and lateral opportunity.

We are looking for a high caliber Senior Program Manager (Sr. PM) who enjoy working on challenging, high impact business problems. The Sr. PM will manage business onboarding to our systems and services, prioritize opportunities in tech systems /process flows and support the functional systems to deliver to defined goals. Successful candidates will be analytical, highly-organized, accustomed to working with technical teams, able to bridge the gap between business and tech, clear communicators, and interested in getting deep into the details of our business. This Program Manager is a high visible role as s/he will front end with Senior Leaders across Amazon Organization.

Key job responsibilities
As a Sr. PM on the team, you would be responsible for understanding the functional flow of TFS onboarded businesses and key TFS capabilities, required to enable transport finance processes (account payables and receivables) and identifying opportunities to refine both. The Sr. PM will manage the auditing, invoicing, payments products and process with a team of SMEs in TFS and partner teams, identify short term solutions and work with Product/SDM on long term solutions to customer problems. The Sr. PM will evaluate self-serve opportunities to reduce overhead load on TFS, document dashboard or tool requirements and present to TFS Tech team to build consensus for solutions to self-serve on commonly occurring issues. The program manager will work closely with Product/SDM to define the road map. Key responsibilities -

- Define and manage cross-functional program strategy, including mission, vision, objectives, and measurable success criteria, while driving teams across organizations to deliver on key milestones.
- Analyze data to identify trends, drive improvements, and inform resource allocation decisions — regularly reviewing metrics and proactively seeking new mechanisms for visibility into program health.
- Lead stakeholder alignment through clear written narratives and verbal communication, presenting program updates, trade-offs, and recommendations to senior leadership.
- Identify and mitigate risks proactively, reduce exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or ineffective cross-team collaboration, and solve ambiguous problems with sound judgment.
- Streamline processes and eliminate unnecessary dependencies, partnering with engineering and business teams to prioritize initiatives that improve efficiency and customer outcomes.

A day in the life
TFS has over 200+ engineers, and 20+ product & program managers. Each Program Manager is responsible for delivering large to medium programs; working closely with business teams and product, building transformation roadmaps to deliver long term benefits for our customers.

About the team
Transportation Financial Systems (TFS) platform owns the technology components that perform the financial activities for Amazon’s transportation business. TFS systems are used across all Amazon’s transportation programs and retail expansion to new geographies. The platform provide financial document creation & management, expense auditing, accounting, payments and cost allocation functions. Our new generation products are highly scalable and operate at finer level granularity to reconcile every dollar in transportation financial accounts with zero manual entries or corrections. The goal is to develop global product suite for all freight modes touching every single package movement across Amazon. Our mission is to abstract logistics complexities from financial world and financial complexities from logistics world. You will be part of one of the largest tech and program team with ~200 engineering organization with great growth and lateral opportunity.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program or project management experience
- Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
- Experience owning program strategy, end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
- Experience owning program strategy, end-to-end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership
