title: Operations Manager
descriptionHtml:
External job description
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Operations Manager. In this role, you will lead and develop a team of salaried and hourly talent. You will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. To achieve this, managers are expected to provide their team with the tools needed for success while driving improvements in productivity and efficiency through data-driven decisions and analytical problem-solving. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Our fulfillment network launches new Operations sites every year, providing various opportunities for your professional growth. We hire Operations Managers based on location preference and the business’ current openings.

Key job responsibilities
Key Responsibilities and Job Elements:

- Support, mentor, and motivate your salaried and hourly workforce

- Lead large-scope projects with site and regional impact

- Build and execute productivity plans through forecast reviews, determining productivity requirements, and partnering with other Leaders to load balance

- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises

- Collaborate with all support teams including Safety, Engineering, Loss Prevention, Quality Assurance, Human Resources to develop plans to meet business objectives

- Lift up to 49 pounds and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach

- Stand/walk for up to 12 hours during shifts

- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud

- Work in an environment that is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments)

- Continuously climb and descend stairs (applies to sites with stairs)

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of employee and performance management experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent, or 2+ years of Amazon (blue badge/FTE) experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience

descriptionHtml:

We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. The team drives design, engineering, implementation, operations, reliability, and sustainability of these next-generation networks and works on innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand.

Our ideal candidate is hands-on, autonomous, detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills, strong project management and time management skills, and has a successful track record of engineering, delivering, and optimizing durable solutions. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, collaborative environment; with geographically diverse teams is essential. This is a fantastic opportunity to work with some of the best engineers in the industry and help shape the direction of one of the largest and fastest growing cloud networks in the world.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
As a Senior Network Development Engineer in AWS Networking, you will own our current and newly developing IP networks end to end, from design and engineering through implementation, operations escalation, scaling, technology refresh, and technical documentation.
• Lead the design of highly available, hyper-scale networks, services, and deployment procedures, and work with internal customers to take them from concept to production and beyond.
• Design ahead of customer and technology needs. This includes writing and defending High Level Design (HLD) and Low Level Design (LLD) documents, building and testing solutions, and supporting the teams that deploy and operate them.
• Define and influence strategy and technology roadmaps within and outside the team.
• Work with leadership to choose projects that support the team's mission, and lead the project teams that deliver them.
• Partner with network engineers and software developers to automate deployment and operations, improving quality and velocity.
• Drive operational excellence projects that improve network performance and reliability.
• Troubleshoot complex problems, and review and implement changes on the network.
• Hire, mentor, and coach engineers.
Physical and Other Requirements
• Willing to support an off-hours operations escalation pager rotation.
• Experience working with customers during problem resolution and working well under pressure.
• Able to sit at a computer during scheduled work hours, with appropriate breaks, while staying alert and paying close attention to detail.
• Able to travel to data center and network sites and to Amazon and customer offices as needed.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Diverse Experiences
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

- 8+ years of major internet routing protocols experience
- 5+ years of working in a Linux/Unix environment experience

title: EHS Specialist
descriptionHtml:

You'll facilitate new approaches to safety, combining technology with human-centered solutions to create an environment where safety and productivity thrive together. title: Program Manager, Central Operations Standardization and Cost out Team
descriptionHtml:
Central Operations (Ops) JP is looking for an experienced Program Manager with a strong record of achieving results, to own and execute the Metrics & KPI strategy for the Central Operations Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team. The COSC team is dedicated to driving operational excellence across Central Operations by establishing robust mechanisms, delivering data-driven insights, and accelerating high-impact programs.

You will own the end-to-end definition, automation, and reporting of CO's controllable P0 metrics and KPIs across all business domains — connecting them directly to AMZL goals. You will solve this by building a clear, CO-controllable metrics framework, automating data pipelines, and evolving reporting from reactive dashboards into a proactive, AI-powered insight engine that predicts trends and alerts teams before issues escalate.

You will work cross-functionally and across geographies with stakeholders at senior levels to understand, implement, and improve metrics programs and data products. This role offers the opportunity to partner closely with multiple functions and teams including program management, delivery station operations, last mile tech, planning, routing, network optimization, finance, analytics, and more in Amazon Logistics (AMZL). Such exposure and collaboration with a variety of teams allow opportunities for further career growth within Amazon and beyond.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

Key job responsibilities
- Lead CO to define CO controllable P0 metrics and KPIs across all functions (Intraweek Planning, Scheduling, Routing, System Configuration, SSD, AMXL, etc.) while connecting them to AMZL-level goals

- Lead data automation and pipeline health initiatives: clarify metric logic and data sources, improve data extraction speed and cost efficiency (ETL vs. Cradle), and resolve upstream data pipeline dependencies
- Design and deliver visualization and reporting for DBR, WBR, MBR/QBR cadences, ensuring leadership has timely, accurate, and actionable insights
- Build a call-out automation knowledge base that captures historical fluctuation patterns and provides automatic deep-dive analysis for red metrics
- Develop a projection capability leveraging AI and historical data to forecast coming-week trends and alert teams to potential fluctuations — especially for PEAK readiness
- Establish a program-to-metric auditing mechanism in partnership with the CO Program Office to validate whether programs improve their target metrics and by how much
- Design and execute the CO Delivery Station satisfaction survey on a quarterly basis, generating reports that help CO understand DS sentiment on process, product, and mechanism quality


A day in the life
You lead meetings with domain function heads to align on metric definitions and review data pipeline health. You coordinate with tech teams to resolve upstream data issues and unblock automation work. You deep-dive into a red metric call-out, building the root-cause analysis and preparing the narrative for the weekly domain WBR. You challenge the status quo by proposing a new AI-driven projection model that could give teams a week's advance warning of volume fluctuations. You plan and organize to ensure seamless execution of quarterly DS satisfaction surveys. You will continuously find new problems to solve and be required to partner with teams across Japan and the globe to deliver for our customers. You take business trips within and outside Japan on a need basis to build your skills, network, and to gain insights from other regions and bring and export best practices to and from Japan.

About the team
About Central Ops JP team:
The Central Ops JP team is a back office team remotely supporting AMZL, SSD, AMXL, and Quick Commerce operations across Japan. Our four pillars are standardization, optimization, centralization, and innovation. We offer a variety of services such as route plan, scheduling, volume adjustment, on-road management, system configuration, and risk mitigation. We remove the gemba's burden so they can focus on what matters most under the roof for station associates and on the road for our drivers. We are a diverse and inclusive team offering great opportunities for career growth.

About COSC team:
The Standardization and Cost Out (COSC) team exists to drive operational excellence across Central Operations by establishing robust mechanisms, delivering data-driven insights, and accelerating high-impact programs. COSC operates across three pillars — Metrics & KPI, Cost Out, and Program Standardization & Tech — serving as the backbone that ensures CO's 50+ program managers perform with a high bar, CO's impact is measured and registered in financial reports, and CO's operations are guided by clear, controllable metrics connected to AMZL goals.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of program or project management experience
- 3+ years of working cross functionally with tech and non-tech teams experience
- Experience in analyzing data to drive decisions
- 3+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
- Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
- Bachelor's degree
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
- Speak, write, and read fluently in Japanese

title: Safety Design and Engineering Continuous Improvement Manager, WHS Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.



Key job responsibilities
- Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.
- Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.
- Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.
- Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.
- Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.

A day in the life
You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing — helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial engineering.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience in English language communication skills (B2/C1), both written and verbal.
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Preferred qualifications are not required to apply for a position at Amazon. If you have all the basic qualifications above, we'd love to hear from you.

- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- CMSE (or equivalent Machinery Safety certification), or experience working for/with a Notified or Approved Body for Machinery Safety.
- NEBOSH certificate (or equivalent safety certification).

title: Lead Associate, Amazon Now
descriptionHtml:

Join our dedicated team and contribute to a dynamic culture based on customer obsession, trust, respect, integrity, continuous learning, and fun. title: Sr. HR Manager, NACF
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. Through the combination of employee engagement and technology, PXT empowers Amazonians whose dedication and creativity consistently deliver exceptional customer experiences.

The Senior HR Manager is part of the (NACF) senior leadership team, partnering with leaders at multiple levels to develop strategies, set goals, and deliver business results. You'll own the end-to-end employee experience at the site(s), championing a culture of safety, inclusion, and service. This role requires balancing automation with human insight—leveraging technology, AI, and real-time data to enhance decision-making and support transformational initiatives. You'll lead a high-performing HR team, implementing strategies across employee engagement, talent management, and organizational effectiveness. Success demands strategic thinking, attention to detail, and the ability to drive scalable solutions across sites and regions.

The Senior HR Manager is a strategic, high-judgment leader responsible for delivering operational excellence and scalable PXT impact across the most complex sites. They translate enterprise people strategies into site execution, strengthen leadership capability, and drive systemic improvements in culture, performance, and risk.

You will be expected to work onsite at an Amazon facility, ensuring personal connection and hands-on leadership where needed.

Key job responsibilities
- Own and create sustainable HR strategies that drive improvements in attrition, attendance, and engagement while setting clear vision for the HR team. Model, train, and coach behavioral expectations and hold operations and HR teams accountable for timely resolution of concerns and maintaining service excellence.

- Work closely with Business Leader(s) as a strategic partner on all people-related decisions, providing leadership coaching and constructive feedback to enhance their capabilities while collaborating on strategies for equitable hiring, retention, development, and performance optimization to build strong, engaged teams.

- Establish effective partnerships with specialized HR functions, including centers of excellence and shared services (e.g., compensation, staffing, recruiting). Challenge status quo and leverage technology to drive improved performance and employee experiences, scaling solutions across the site, region and beyond.

- Collaborate with site and regional leadership teams to harmonize site-specific priorities in alignment with broader organizational goals, with particular focus on diversity & inclusion, employee experience, and talent management initiatives. Use data-driven insights to inform strategy and measure impact.

- Lead, champion, and ensure follow-through on organizational and operational change initiatives. Remove barriers that impede change adoption, balance automation with human judgment, and respond resourcefully to new demands, priorities, challenges or obstacles. Demonstrate high judgment in decision-making while maintaining strong risk management and compliance standards.

- Drive adoption and optimization of HR technology solutions to enhance efficiency, data accuracy, and employee experience. Lead the HR team in developing digital fluency, leveraging analytics for decision-making, and utilizing AI to streamline processes while maintaining a human-centered approach.

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic partnership and hands-on people management. You'll navigate multiple priorities, from leadership development to employee engagement initiatives. Balancing immediate needs with long-term objectives, you'll respond to time-sensitive matters while driving strategic workforce planning. Using cutting-edge AI-powered analytics, you'll derive real-time insights to tackle challenges in attrition, attendance, and engagement. You'll collaborate closely with business leaders, guiding them through critical decisions and change management processes. Your expertise will be crucial in analyzing key performance indicators and implementing data-driven solutions. From the production floor to strategy meetings, you'll keep a pulse on workplace culture while steering organizational initiatives. You'll develop and empower your team to leverage innovative HR technologies, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiencies. In this fast-paced environment, you'll have numerous opportunities to innovate and create meaningful impact across your site(s) and broader organization.



About the team
Amazon’s Fulfillment Centers (FCs) within North American Customer Fulfillment (NACF) are fast-paced environments that utilize robotics, scanning machines, and computer systems that track and allow the delivery of millions of items (and smiles) to households daily.

NACF PXT is a talent cultivator where Amazonians gain a depth of experience and expertise nurtured to grow, flourish and thrive in other business lines across Amazon. title: Applied Scientist - Perception (SLAM/VIO), Fauna
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking an Applied Scientist to develop and optimize Visual Inertial Odometry (VIO) and sensor fusion systems for our intelligent robots. In this role, you will design, implement, and deploy state estimation and tracking algorithms that enable robots to understand their position and motion in real time, even in challenging and dynamic environments.

You will own the full pipeline from algorithm development through embedded deployment, ensuring that perception systems run efficiently on resource-constrained robotic hardware. You will also leverage modern machine learning approaches to push the boundaries of classical perception methods, combining learned representations with geometric techniques to achieve robust, real-time performance.

This is a deeply hands-on role. You will work directly with sensors, hardware, and real-world data, while prototyping, testing, and iterating in physical environments. The ideal candidate has strong foundations in VIO and sensor fusion, practical experience optimizing algorithms for embedded platforms, and familiarity with how modern deep learning is transforming perception.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and implement Visual Inertial Odometry algorithms for robust real-time state estimation on robotic platforms like Sprout
- Develop multi-sensor fusion pipelines integrating cameras, IMUs, and other sensing modalities for accurate pose tracking
- Optimize perception and tracking algorithms for deployment on embedded hardware (e.g., ARM, GPU-accelerated edge devices) under strict latency and power constraints
- Apply modern ML-based perception techniques (learned features, depth estimation, neural odometry) to complement and improve classical geometric approaches
- Build and maintain calibration, evaluation, and benchmarking infrastructure for perception systems
- Collaborate with hardware, controls, and navigation teams to integrate perception outputs into the robot’s autonomy stack
- Lead technical projects from research prototyping through production deployment

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of building models for business application experience
- PhD, or Master's degree and 4+ years of CS, CE, ML or related field experience
- Experience in patents or publications at top-tier peer-reviewed conferences or journals
- Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
- Experience in any of the following areas: algorithms and data structures, parsing, numerical optimization, data mining, parallel and distributed computing, high-performance computing
- Hands-on experience developing and deploying Visual Inertial Odometry or visual-inertial SLAM systems
- Strong understanding of multi-sensor fusion (cameras, IMUs, odometry) and state estimation (EKF, factor graphs)
- Experience optimizing perception algorithms for embedded or resource-constrained hardware
- Demonstrated hands-on experience with real sensor data, calibration, and physical robot platforms
- Familiarity with modern ML approaches to perception (learned feature extraction, depth prediction, end-to-end odometry)

Preferred qualifications

- Experience using Unix/Linux
- Experience in professional software development
- Publication record at major robotics or computer vision conferences (e.g., ICRA, IROS, RSS, CVPR, ECCV)
- Experience with real-time systems programming and performance profiling on ARM/GPU platforms
- Experience with state estimation on legged robots
- Experience with stereo vision systems, camera-IMU calibration, time synchronization, and sensor characterization
- Track record of shipping VIO or SLAM systems to production on physical robots at scale
- Experience with NVIDIA Jetson, Qualcomm RB5, or similar embedded AI platforms
- Familiarity with ROS/ROS2
- Experience integrating learned perception modules (e.g., neural depth, feature matching networks) into geometric estimation pipelines
- History of technical leadership and cross-functional collaboration

We are looking for a Senior Software Development Engineer who thrives at the forefront of technology, science, and security to join Artificial Intelligence Security (AISec), working with teams across Amazon to accelerate delivery of spectacular, safe, secure, models, agents, and applications.

You dive deep into of details of business, operations, and engineering. You are a deeply-technical, detail-oriented leader who can build and grow organizations and other leaders. Our team culture encourages innovation and we expect builders and managers deeply own vision, strategy, and execution. You will have the opportunity to engage with technologies that are actively being developed. In addition to engineering teams, you will work directly with infrastructure and partner service teams.

You are proactive in removing roadblocks, pave the way for innovation, and can handle multiple competing priorities in a fast-paced environment. You will be a positive influencer across diverse teams, be able to effectively rally support for your initiatives,
and be able to help deeply technical teams create simple solutions to meet your program goals.
You are able to handle business escalations with a data-driven approach.

In Amazon Security, we’re growing rapidly and we need leaders that can grow and scale their
organizations at a rapid pace. You’ll also need strong judgment. Our leaders demonstrate ownership and autonomy so they need to be right a lot. You will have to be obsessed with delivering the most customer-centric experience for security engineering on the planet. Finally, you’ll need to be able to invent and simplify which is what we do every day on Amazon service teams.

Key job responsibilities
Your responsibilities include:
· Building a massively scalable global security service that is core to all Amazon services.
· Owning the definition of best practices for the software development lifecycle used by junior engineers, including its design, implementation, testing, and operational characteristics.
· Working as part of cross-functional teams to develop secure solutions for our customers.
· Owning the technology stack for one of the most secure and reliable services in all of Amazon.

A day in the life
• Serve as a technical lead on our most demanding, cross-functional projects.
• Ensure the quality of architecture and design of systems.
• Functionally decompose complex problems into simple, straight-forward solutions.
• Fully and completely understand system interdependencies and limitations.
• Possess expert knowledge in performance, scalability, enterprise system architecture, and engineering best practices.
• Leverage knowledge of internal and industry prior art in design decisions.
• Effectively research and benchmark Amazon technology against other competing systems in the industry.

About the team
Diverse Experiences
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. title: Principal Product Manager – Technical, AWS Security
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. We are building a set of AI-native security products that change how AWS prevents, finds, and responds to security risk. One product evaluates code as builders write it and fixes issues automatically. Another finds and remediates vulnerabilities across the AWS fleet, from host and container operating systems to third-party software. A third automates investigation and triage for security operations teams.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager – Technical to own the product strategy across this suite. The products solve the same basic problem at different points in the security lifecycle: work out what is affected, judge how serious it is, and act on it. Nobody owns the product decisions that cut across them today. You will decide which capabilities should be shared and which should stay product-specific, what each product promises its customers, and where to build new, extend what exists, or retire overlap.

Your customers are technical. Software builders want security that doesn't slow them down. Security engineers need coverage they can trust. Security operations teams need investigation and response that scales. You will represent all three, decide which need wins when they conflict, and drive the engineering, science, and program teams to deliver the right products. The strategy that ties the suite together has not been defined yet, and you will be trusted to define it with complete independence.

Key job responsibilities
- Define a multi-year vision and long-term roadmap for a suite of security products, and drive teams to deliver it

- Decide where products converge on shared capabilities and where they stay separate; make the invent, extend, or retire calls

- Serve as the voice of the customer for software builders, security engineers, and security operations teams, grounded in customer research and data

- Write PR/FAQs, decision narratives, and investment proposals that make the case for the suite's direction to senior leadership

- Build the measurement, intake, and reporting mechanisms that keep each product aligned with its customers over the long term

- Partner with technical program managers who own multi-team delivery, and with engineering and science leaders on architecture and priorities

The position's responsibilities include scaling support of several data center locations and day to day assistance with capacity management. You will work closely with internal customers and external vendors to facilitate smooth project execution as directed by Network Leadership and Technical Project Managers.

You will leverage your experience supporting large scale, enterprise class networks as well as network implementation and troubleshooting. As a Network Deploy Technician, you will work in a fast paced, collaborative environment with regular peer and customer interaction. In addition to providing management and support of AWS’ vast network infrastructure, Network Deploy Technicians establish and follow best practices and refine operational procedures.

All physical requirements are expected with reasonable accommodations:
• Regularly lift and/or move up to 40 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 41+ pounds
• Ability to work in an environment that operates 24/7 with an ability to participate in primary responder rotation and provide after-hours support as needed
• Working in cramped and/or elevated and/or noisy environments
• Bending, lifting, stretching, reaching, standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
• Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation

You will be responsible for having a reliable personal vehicle and valid driver's license to travel within the regional work area, as company transportation will not be provided.

Key job responsibilities
• Managing work and priorities through ticketing system and workflows to complete customer requests and projects
• Collaborating with various stakeholders to remove project obstacles
• Troubleshooting networking, routing and interconnectivity issues, including patch panels and patch cords
• Specifying Power and Cooling requirements and ensuring Hardware Racking/Stacking completed for new equipment
• Participating in the migration, basic configuration and rollout of new or upgraded hardware
• Traveling within and outside of regional work area and international is required 60% of the time. This position also is 100% onsite.

A day in the life
1. Providing the first level networking devices to serve our customer racks entails various tasks (the name of the game is efficiency): You will track network rack intake and delivery; work with various onsite teams to request for rack space, power, and cooling for network racks. And then partner with network engineers to ensure all configurations are ready. You'll also be working on link and device troubleshooting within a certain Service-Level Agreement
2. There is also console builds (and room builds) that are really exciting. You'll be exposed to more teams whose goal is to provide more space and capacity for customer racks.
3. Work with ID-Scaling peers to build higher-level networking devices.

- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience in computer networking

Preferred qualifications

- Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
- Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies

You will own the 13-to-103-week server-material Demand Plan of Record (POR) and the 0-to-10-year data-center capacity POR. title: Software Development Engineer, Elastic Block Store
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to build the data platform that shows how a cloud storage service used by millions of AWS customers is behaving? As a Software Development Engineer on Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS), you will design, build and operate a self-service telemetry platform that processes petabytes of data every day across every AWS Region. Engineers across EBS and AWS rely on it for both operational and analytical needs, from automated production decisions and real-time monitoring to compliance reporting, customer insights and capacity forecasting. You will own large-scale distributed systems end to end, make them more efficient at scale, and help shape how engineers and AI-powered tools access data. If you are curious about distributed systems, data platforms and cloud storage, we would like to hear from you.

Key job responsibilities
- Design, build and operate distributed systems that transform, store, query and export petabyte-scale telemetry data
- Improve cost efficiency by evolving the platform architecture, adopting new languages and technologies, and building mechanisms that keep cost under control as usage grows
- Build programmatic and AI-ready interfaces that give engineers and automated tools secure, access-controlled access to data
- Raise operational quality through monitoring, alarming, data-quality validation and automated recovery
- Partner with software engineers, data engineers and product managers across EBS to turn specific use cases into reusable platform features

A day in the life
Your day might start with a short team sync, followed by focused time on the project you lead, such as designing a new storage layout or optimizing the efficiency of the transform or query engines. Along the way, you join design brainstorms and reviews, review teammates' code and get feedback on your own, and may meet with an EBS team that wants to bring new data onto the platform to help them shape the solution. You also join an on-call rotation, typically one week about every eight weeks. When you get paged, you have runbooks and your teammates to support you, and after each page we review the steps together to prevent it from happening again or automate the response.

About the team
Our team owns the telemetry and analytics platform that EBS relies on for operational and business insight, and our vision is to be the single observability platform for EBS. Our customers are EBS engineering, data engineering and product teams, along with other AWS teams that build on EBS data. Over the next few years, we are focused on making the platform more efficient, unifying how data is transformed and queried, and making data accessible to AI-powered tools. We stay on top of new technologies and actively use AI-driven development in our daily work. We invest in fault tolerance and automation so operational load stays low, which keeps our team sustainable, frees most of our time for delivering new features, and supports a healthy work-life balance. We have a mix of experience levels and tenures, and we invest in your growth through projects that expand your scope, designs with impact across EBS, and mentorship from senior engineers.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Cloudscape
locations: East Palo Alto, CA, United States
descriptionHtml:
AWS ships over 280 services and more than 50 off-console applications. Every one carries a full surface area — APIs, SDK, CLI, console, documentation, infrastructure-as-code support, identity integration, logging, monitoring, pricing, and regional availability. Producing and maintaining these interfaces consumes enormous engineering capacity, and the quality customers experience is uneven.

Managed Interfaces changes the model: when customer needs change, AWS responds in weeks, not months. Every interface a customer touches is generated from one source of truth — the service's API model — and stays consistent as the service evolves. Builders launch new services with near-zero effort on undifferentiated engineering, and user testing starts at the beginning of a project, when changes are cheap.

You will own the program management for this effort, coordinating three workstreams: agentic capabilities for builders, the managed console experience, and the agents that keep documentation and downstream channels current. This is a cross-organizational role that turns a multi-year north star into shippable, measurable proof points.

Key job responsibilities
Drive the program end-to-end. Own the roadmap, milestones, and dependencies across all three workstreams, translating the 2027 north star into quarterly deliverables and committed proof points.

Coordinate across teams. Align the UX platform, launch orchestration, console generation, the context layer, and 200+ service teams whose consoles move to the managed path. Resolve cross-team dependencies and sequencing conflicts before they become blockers.

Manage the proof-point scoreboard. Define, track, and report the metrics that demonstrate progress: services registered to the context layer, consoles converted to managed, undifferentiated effort reduced per feature, automated quality improvements shipped per month, task-completion times, and accessibility violations trending to zero.

Communicate up and across. Produce clear status, risk, and decision documents for senior leadership; run operational reviews; and keep stakeholders aligned on scope, trade-offs, and timelines.



Manage risk. Surface technical and organizational risks early — adoption friction, capability gaps for off-console applications, source-of-truth consistency — and drive mitigation.

A day in the life
A single integrated roadmap across the three workstreams with clear ownership and dependencies.

A live scoreboard tracking the committed proof points, reviewed on a regular operating cadence.

The first managed-console conversions in production, moving from one prototype toward a repeatable path.

An adoption plan for moving the standard console path to managed by default, with onboarding support for service teams.

About the team
The Cloudscape team builds the design system that powers the AWS Management Console - one of the most-used enterprise interfaces in the world. We're a multidisciplinary team of 35+ spanning UX design, front-end engineering, research, and program management. We ship 114+ components, maintain comprehensive design guidance, and build AI-powered tools that help teams build faster. Our work directly impacts millions of AWS customers and hundreds of service teams.

descriptionHtml:
Global BMS Technical Services (GBTS) is Amazon's centralized Building Management System (BMS) technical support organization. GBTS operates within the Global Energy, Sustainability & Automation (GESA) division, which is part of OPS - GEMS (Global Engineering, Materials & Sustainability). OPS - GEMS is the enterprise responsible for driving engineering excellence, materials innovation, and sustainability initiatives across Amazon's global operations infrastructure.

OPS - GEMS leads the design, deployment, integration, and lifecycle management of building automation platforms, energy infrastructure, and sustainability technologies across Amazon's worldwide operations network. This includes HVAC sequence of operations, environmental controls, energy metering, power distribution, and carbon reduction strategies.

Within this mission, GBTS serves as the frontline technical arm. We ensure that every facility's BMS operates at peak performance while advancing Amazon's Climate Pledge commitment.

GBTS is a destination for engineers and technical professionals who excel in high-impact, operationally demanding environments. We operate at the intersection of building science, automation engineering, and sustainability, tackling complex technical challenges at scale.

We foster an open and inclusive culture that values diverse perspectives and technical expertise. Our strength lies in deep cross-functional collaboration: controls engineers partnering with energy analysts, sustainability specialists aligning with program managers, and field technicians providing critical insights that shape platform architecture. We are committed to operational excellence, uphold the highest standards of safety and quality, and are driven by the understanding that the systems we design, build, and maintain directly enable Amazon to deliver on its commitment to customers and the planet.

Join us and be part of the team that powers, optimizes, and sustains Amazon's global operations infrastructure, ensuring every facility runs smarter, safer, and more sustainably.

Key job responsibilities
We are seeking an experienced Senior Building Management System (BMS) Specialist to join an existing team that supports post-project activities across one of the largest BMS portfolios in the world. This role requires a dynamic individual with a strong technical foundation in BMS programming, HVAC controls, commissioning, and troubleshooting. The successful candidate will maintain, enhance, and optimize our global services, ensuring seamless BMS functionality and delivering unparalleled customer experiences.

2. Collaborate closely with GRBD&E, D&C, Sustainability, RME, and other stakeholders to understand customer requirements, business objectives, and operational needs
3. Design, implement, and manage BMS standard operating procedures, policies, and processes that are scalable across the globe
4. Maintain and optimize BMS technologies, IoT platforms, and data analytics tools

9. Provide strategic insights and recommendations to management on BMS trends, improvements, issues, root causes, team skillsets, industry best practices, and emerging technologies
10. Take ownership of BMS initiatives, develop technical documentation, manage timelines, and coordinate with stakeholders
11. Lead training sessions and development programs to continuously enhance the capabilities and technical skills of field RME teams and BMS Specialists

title: Delivery Consultant - Migrations, AWS Professional Services
descriptionHtml:
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.

Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in leading large-scale portfolio assessment and application disposition for enterprise data centre exit programmes spanning multiple countries and regulatory jurisdictions. You'll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure through discovery tooling and application owner interviews, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS — assigning R-strategies (Rehost, Replatform, Refactor, Retire, Retain, Relocate) and designing wave plans that respect dependency groupings, capacity constraints, and regulatory frozen zones. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on migration best practices, risk mitigation, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the end-to-end migration assessment process, ensuring adherence to AWS well-architected principles, optimizing wave sequencing, and managing risks throughout the programme lifecycle.

The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. • Build and maintain dependency maps using applications, resolving conflicting data between tooling output and application owner interviews
• Design wave plans: group applications by dependency, balance capacity, respect regulatory frozen zones, and coordinate across geographies
• Run Tech Bridge sessions with customer application owners to validate disposition decisions and unblock migration paths
• Feed wave planning into AWS Transform, ensuring move groups are sized, sequenced, and ready for factory execution
• Proactively identify and escalate risks to wave timelines — then propose and drive mitigations before they become blockers

title: Network Development Manager, Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) Networking
descriptionHtml:
Application deadline: Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis

Amazon's network is a key differentiator for AWS, enabling the global operation of thousands of applications across hundreds of thousands of servers worldwide. Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) extends that platform to the U.S. Government's most sensitive workloads, delivering AWS inside air-gapped, classified regions where the bar for reliability, security, and operational rigor is at its highest.

We are looking for a Network Development Manager to hire, manage, and develop a team of Network Development Engineers responsible for the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network. You will own capacity management and forecast planning, implementation, automation, change control, process management, and continuous improvement across the classified partitions. You will represent networking to service teams, infrastructure partners, and government stakeholders, ensuring we meet their needs for innovation, delivery, and safe operations in an environment where the margin for error is small and much of the tooling and telemetry commercial teams rely on has to be built.

At Amazon, we ask our technical leaders to be strong engineers who dive deep and help their engineers make sound decisions and deliver quality solutions. You will maintain a solid technical understanding of routing, switching, optical transport, and network automation, and ensure the right expertise exists on the team. You will also be a thoughtful people manager who mentors your engineers and builds an environment of mutual trust and respect, which matters even more in ADC where teams are smaller, more isolated, and carry a heavier operational load per person. The ideal candidate has a track record of driving operations and continuous improvement for large-scale, mission-critical networks, a passion for operational excellence, and the judgment to safely implement change, measure performance, and respond to events so the network always operates as intended.

The candidate selected must obtain and maintain a security clearance at the TS/SCI with polygraph level. Upon start, the selected candidate will be sponsored for a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the end-to-end operational health of the ADC network across the classified partitions: availability, performance, change control, and continuous improvement.
- Hire, develop, and retain a team of Network Development Engineers; own onboarding, career growth, 1:1s, and mentoring.
- Run a sustainable on-call rotation that honors SLAs without burning out a small classified-region team.
- Ensure network changes are designed, reviewed, and executed safely at scale under ADC's access and change-control constraints.
- Drive incidents and availability risks to resolution, and own Correction of Error (COE) follow-through so problems do not recur.
- Manage operations with data, metrics, and dashboards; build the monitoring, automation, and tooling ADC has historically lacked.
- Define and deliver team goals, align resources, and report status and risk to leadership.
- Close parity gaps with commercial AWS and contribute an ADC lens to standard planning (OP1/OP2).
- Represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government stakeholders so dependencies and deliverables are met.

A day in the life
You lead a team of Network Development Engineers operating AWS's network inside classified regions. A typical day mixes 1:1s and career coaching with reviewing network changes, walking through an incident or COE with an engineer, and unblocking cross-team dependencies. You spend time on the metrics that show where the network and the team need attention, and on the tooling, automation, and monitoring ADC is still building. You balance day-to-day operations against longer-term parity and capacity goals, and you represent networking to service, infrastructure, and government partners. You also participate in a management on-call escalation rotation.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related field
- 4+ years of managing teams experience
- 5+ years of engineering experience
- 8+ years of technology role experience
- Experience with network operations either as a manager or individual contributor

Preferred qualifications

- Experience contributing to the creation and implementation of high-quality, high-volume recruiting plans
- Experience contributing to the definition and implementation of automation opportunities within an operations environment
- Experience representing your team or technical area to senior management

title: Sr. Innovation & Design Engineer, Worldwide Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Amazon has created one of the most sophisticated supply chains in the world. From the introduction of Amazon Prime, to the use of drones for package delivery, Amazon has consistently driven change from the front of the pack.

Amazon is now searching for a handful of innovative and solutions oriented engineers to be a part of our global initiative of developing and delivering next generation of world-class fulfillment and transportation systems. If the idea of using ground-breaking technologies to develop intermodal logistics systems on an unprecedented scale has your attention, then keep reading.

As a Senior Innovation and Design Engineer, you will be able to work with some of the most talented engineers in the design and development of physical distribution systems around the globe. A successful candidate will have an established background in developing high-performance physical systems, a strong technical problem solving ability, excellent project management skills, and an internal motivation to achieve results in a fast-paced and often ambiguous environment. Amazon’s culture encourages innovation and expects engineers and managers alike to take a high level of ownership in solving complex problems.

Come help us make history.


Key job responsibilities
- Invent, design, and implement engineering solutions to complex material flow/transformation and human/machine efficiency problems throughout the global Amazon supply chain.
- Lead and coordinate design and innovation efforts to develop optimal solutions for the transportation network through equipment specification, material flow, process design, site layout, and intellectual property considerations.
- Collaboration with internal teams and external vendors to generate high quality, cost effective solutions in very short periods of time.
- Simultaneously manage multiple projects and tasks while effectively influencing, negotiating, and communicating with internal and external business partners, contractors and vendors.
- Provide technical leadership for large-scale engineering projects.

A day in the life
Amazon offers a full range of benefits that support you and eligible family members, including domestic partners and their children. Benefits can vary by location, the number of regularly scheduled hours you work, length of employment, and job status such as seasonal or temporary employment. The benefits that generally apply to regular, full-time employees include:

1. Medical, Dental, and Vision Coverage
2. Maternity and Parental Leave Options
3. Paid Time Off (PTO)
4. 401(k) Plan

If you are not sure that every qualification on the list above describes you exactly, we'd still love to hear from you! At Amazon, we value people with unique backgrounds, experiences, and skillsets. If you’re passionate about this role and want to make an impact on a global scale, please apply!

About the team
Our team shapes the future of Amazon's fulfillment network from its earliest stages. Within Worldwide Design and Engineering, you'll lead critical design input discussions that influence billions in infrastructure investment and define how Amazon serves customers globally. This role demands strategic thinking at both macro levels (understanding network-wide ripple effects) and micro levels (mastering operational intricacies). You'll earn trust across senior stakeholders, dive deep into complex data to drive high-stakes decisions, and own outcomes that transform how Amazon operates. We're seeking an exceptional leader who thrives on ambiguity, evaluates sophisticated trade-offs, and delivers impact at scale. Your work here will define Amazon's operational capabilities for years to come.

Basic qualifications

-5+ years of design & innovation, research & development work experience
-Bachelor's degree in Engineering or a foreign equivalent
-Experience with design & innovation and research & development
-Experience in management of engineering design projects
-Experience using business or technical software like MS Excel, MS Project, and CAD software

Preferred qualifications

-Master's degree in Engineering (any domain), Operations, Business Administration, or a related field
-Knowledge of concepts like system architecture, optimization, system dynamics, system analysis, statistical analysis, reliability analysis, electronic system design, and decision making
-Experience with complex automated material handling equipment, packaging technologies, and systems and high-speed manufacturing

title: Sr HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Im Streben danach, der beste Arbeitgeber der Welt zu sein, treiben unsere globalen Human-Resources-Teams – bekannt als People eXperience and Technology (PXT) – den Unternehmenserfolg voran, indem sie eine sichere, inklusive und innovative Unternehmenskultur fördern. Der/Die Senior HR Business Partner:in ist verantwortlich für operative Exzellenz und organisatorische Gesundheit durch PXT-Führung an den zugewiesenen Standorten. Als erfahrene HR-Führungskraft agierst du als Individual Contributor und arbeitest direkt mit Field Leaders, Standortleitungsteams und General Managers zusammen. Du bringst dabei die Seniorität und Glaubwürdigkeit mit, die für strategische Diskussionen zu komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen erforderlich sind. Du trägst die Gesamtverantwortung für das End-to-End-Mitarbeitererlebnis an deinen Standorten und verantwortest Feedback-Mechanismen, Anerkennungsprogramme sowie Umgebungsstandards, die Vertrauen, Engagement und Leistung nachhaltig prägen. Diese Rolle erfordert die Balance zwischen taktischer Exzellenz und strategischem Weitblick – unter Nutzung von Technologie und menschlichem Urteilsvermögen, um qualitativ hochwertige Mitarbeitererlebnisse zu schaffen und gleichzeitig eine proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung voranzutreiben.
Du wirst vor Ort an einem Amazon-Standort arbeiten und mehrere Standorte innerhalb deiner Region (Campus) betreuen, mit regelmäßiger Mobilität zwischen den zugewiesenen Standorten.

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement

Förderung einer offenen Zwei-Wege-Kommunikation durch Voice of the Associate-Programme, Rundtischgespräche und GEMBA-Walks mit zeitnaher Lösung von Anliegen und Stärkung der Beziehungen zwischen Mitarbeitenden und Führungskräften. Umsetzung von Engagement-Strategien und Anerkennungsprogrammen, die die Mitarbeiterzufriedenheit messbar steigern. Schaffung eines inklusiven Umfelds, in dem sich Mitarbeitende sicher fühlen, ihre Meinung zu äußern und authentisch aufzutreten – durch die Etablierung von Employee Resource Groups und die Sicherstellung gerechter Talentpraktiken. Regelmäßige und sichtbare Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche, um Vertrauen auf allen Ebenen aufzubauen und Anliegen frühzeitig zu erkennen, bevor sie eskalieren.



Operational Excellence & Site Standards

Bewertung der Arbeitsbedingungen durch regelmäßige Standortbegehungen und Etablierung von Routinen zur Einhaltung der Standards gemäß den Amazon-Vorgaben. Zusammenarbeit mit Standortleitungen und Safety-Teams zur konsequenten Umsetzung von Sicherheitsstandards und -programmen. Leitung strategischer Community-Initiativen in Zusammenarbeit mit den Teams für Public Policy und Public Relations. Proaktive Risikoidentifikation und -minderung durch die Einrichtung von Frühwarnsystemen, Nutzung von Datenerkenntnissen und fundierte Entscheidungen, die den Richtliniengeist mit den Geschäftsanforderungen in Einklang bringen. Umsetzung zentraler PXT-Prozesse nach strengen Standards sowie Durchführung von Inspektionen und Audits zur Sicherstellung der Compliance. Effektive Koordination mit Shared Services und funktionsübergreifenden Partnern zur Gewährleistung einer nahtlosen Serviceerbringung.



Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology

Führende Nutzung von Analysen und KI-Tools zur Aufdeckung verborgener Muster, Antizipation aufkommender Risiken und Förderung datenbasierter Entscheidungsfindung. Umwandlung von Erkenntnissen in überzeugende Narrative, die Senior Stakeholder beeinflussen und messbare Verbesserungen im Mitarbeitererlebnis und in der Unternehmensleistung vorantreiben. Strategische Förderung der Nutzung von HR-Technologielösungen und Self-Service-Tools für Effizienz und Exzellenz – unter Nutzung von Automatisierung bei gleichzeitiger Beibehaltung eines persönlichen Service für sensible Anliegen, die menschliches Urteilsvermögen und Empathie erfordern.



Strategic PXT Leadership

Regelmäßige Partnerschaft mit Standortleitungen und General Managers zur Balance zwischen operativen Anforderungen und Amazons Werten sowie Personalstrategie – mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen bei komplexen organisatorischen Herausforderungen. Hinterfragen des Status quo und Förderung von Innovationen in HR-Praktiken bei gleichzeitiger Sicherstellung einer nachhaltigen Umsetzung. Coaching von Business Leaders zu effektivem Personalmanagement, einschließlich Leistungsfeedback, Teamentwicklung und komplexen Mitarbeiterbeziehungsthemen. Unterstützung bei der Umsetzung von Veränderungen durch Verstärkung von Botschaften, Abbau von Widerständen und Unterstützung von Führungskräften bei der Übertragung von Veränderungen in lokale Routinen. Festlegung klarer Ziele für die Kulturtransformation und Umsetzung umfassender Strategien zur systematischen Stärkung der Organisationsgesundheit, Talentkompetenzen und Führungseffektivität.



PXT Leadership & Organizational Health

Mitwirkung bei PXT-Personalentscheidungen, Ressourcenallokation und Dienstplanung zur Sicherstellung angemessener Abdeckung und Kompetenz. Beteiligung an Nachfolgeplanung und Beförderungsentscheidungen sowie Identifikation von High-Potential-Talenten und Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten. Durchführung von Talentbewertungen für PXT-Teammitglieder mit Beiträgen zu Leistung, Potenzial und Entwicklungsbedarf. Unterstützung der Entwicklungsplanung und Beitrag zum Aufbau von Nachfolgekapazitäten für kritische Positionen. Beiträge zum Performance Management des PXT-Teams sowie Förderung einer positiven Teamkultur und Anerkennungspraktiken.

A day in the life
Dein Arbeitsalltag verbindet strategisches Denken mit praxisnaher Umsetzung auf Standortebene. Du nutzt fortgeschrittene Analysen und KI-gestützte Tools, um Trends zu erkennen und Lösungen zu entwickeln, die das Arbeitsplatzerlebnis verbessern. Vom Coaching von Senior Leaders bei komplexen Personalherausforderungen bis hin zur Förderung von HR-Prozessexzellenz arbeitest du eng mit Field Leaders und General Managers an zukunftsorientierten Strategien zusammen. Du pflegst eine starke Präsenz auf der Betriebsfläche durch Standortbegehungen, Mitarbeiter-Feedback-Runden und strategische Initiativen und navigierst dabei komplexe organisatorische Herausforderungen mit fundiertem Urteilsvermögen. Darüber hinaus trägst du zur organisatorischen Gesundheit des PXT-Teams durch Talentbewertungen, Nachfolgeplanung und Performance Management bei. Der Erfolg in dieser Rolle hängt von deiner Fähigkeit ab, Veränderungsinitiativen zu leiten, in unklaren Situationen fundierte Entscheidungen zu treffen und eine Unternehmenskultur zu schaffen, in der sich Mitarbeitende wertgeschätzt und gestärkt fühlen.

About the team
Unsere HR-Abteilung bei Amazon spielt bei der Betreuung unserer Mitarbeitenden eine wesentliche Rolle. Oberste Priorität des sogenannten People Experience und Technology Solutions Team (PXT-Team) ist es, unseren Kolleg:innen ein großartiges Amazon-Erlebnis anzubieten und uns dabei zu helfen, eines der innovativsten, kundenorientiertesten und agilsten Unternehmen der Welt zu bleiben.
Wir arbeiten proaktiv und wenden einen holistischen Ansatz für das People Management an. „Customer Obsession“ – Die oberste Priorität haben immer unsere Kund:innen. Unser Team konzentriert sich darauf, Fragen in Bezug auf das Engagement der Mitarbeitenden zu lösen und dafür zu sorgen, dass nichts unser makelloses Mitarbeiter- und Kundenerlebnis beeinträchtigt. Unsere Aufgabe besteht darin, auf den allerhöchsten Standards zu bestehen und den Fortschritt in allen Strategie- und Zielbereichen von Amazon zu fördern.

- Knowledge of local labor law
- Experience as a human resource generalist
- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources Management or a related field
- Experience with specific knowledge of human resource theory, functions and practice, performance appraisal systems and staff development
- Experience supporting hourly employee client group
- Experience with MS Office tools and HR Information Systems

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Human Resources Management
- Experience assessing management and executive talent
- Experience developing and administering HR compensation plans
- Experience in human resources with companies supporting 250-500 or more associates

title: Safety Engineering & Continuous Improvement Manager, WHS Design & Engineering
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, safety is our top priority. We are looking for a WHS Risk Engineer to own machinery safety across multiple sites. In this role you will lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments, apply the EU Machinery Directive and harmonised standards, and influence engineering and operations leaders to build safe-by-design into our equipment and processes. You'll turn machinery-safety findings into consistent standards that protect our people across the network.


Key job responsibilities
Lead machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites.

Apply and interpret the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC) and associated harmonised standards.

Identify machinery and MHE risks and drive the implementation of effective control measures.

Engage and influence functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards and change.

Use data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements across sites.



A day in the life
You work across several sites, moving between machinery inspections, risk assessments and working sessions with engineering and operations leaders. You dig into how equipment and MHE is designed, installed and used, spot risks that others miss, and drive agreement on the control measures needed. You use data to see patterns across sites and to prioritise where safety effort has the biggest impact. A large part of your day is influencing — helping functional leaders understand machinery risk and building buy-in to the Health & Safety standards and changes you recommend.

About the team
The Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) team plays a crucial role in keeping our people mentally and physically well at work. Our team works with managers, associates and local governments across our sites, ensuring compliance with Amazon's policies and legal regulations, and guaranteeing the safety of our work environments. The team offers a variety of opportunities, from Safety Technicians to Programme Managers. Regardless of your role, you'll contribute to the development and implementation of the safety strategy across the entire network.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in English-language communication skills, both written and verbal
- A Bachelor's degree, or equivalent level of qualification in-line with the European Qualifications Framework (EQF) in electrical, mechanical, civil or industrial engineering.
- Practical understanding and application of WHS risk assessment and safety standards.
- Experience conducting machinery safety inspections and risk assessments across multiple sites, applying the EU Machinery Directive (2006/42/EC).
- Experience engaging and influencing functional leaders to build buy-in to Health & Safety standards.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with Lean, 5S or Kaizen methodologies and continuous improvement.
- Experience using data and metrics to identify gaps and drive improvements.
- CMSE (or equivalent Machinery Safety certification), or experience working for/with a Notified or Approved Body for Machinery Safety.
- NEBOSH certificate (or equivalent safety certification).

title: Transportation Associate
descriptionHtml:
Are you ready to help Amazon deliver world class service in its transportation operations? Transportation Associates will perform trailer moves in the trailer yard, coordinate yard activities (such as checking in trailers, traffic flow, internal communications with operations, etc.), conduct yard audits, complete applicable driver training programs (Hostler, Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) School, etc.), and operate multiple vehicle types based on business need (including but not limited to hostlers and day cabs) to support Amazon’s transportation network. Benefits of being a Transportation Associate include the opportunity to work outside and understand the new and exciting world of transportation operations.
As a Transportation Associate you will:
• Make safety a priority by adhering to company rules and regulations. You will follow and enforce safety measures and policies to all who operate vehicles on behalf of Amazon and those who enter the yard, including vendors and senior team members
• Perform various functions within the yard, support site operations teams, internal transportation field teams, and external carriers, as needed, to ensure all trailers arrive and depart on time with zero defects and to maintain workflow for buildings.
• Be professionally trained to operate Commercial Motor Vehicles (CMVs) on non-public roads or in yard to move trailers to/from dock and parking locations.
• Learn Department of Transportation (DOT) regulations and comply with company policies, procedures of those DOT regulations (size, weight, route designations, parking, trailer designations, violation and incident reporting requirements, break periods, etc.)
• Complete driver vehicle inspection reports on equipment and notify managers of any maintenance or delivery issues encountered.
• Follow hostler and delivery schedules, track and report working hours and breaks at appropriate times in compliance with Amazon policy and federal and state regulations, adhere to yard safety policies, obey all applicable traffic laws, and drive in accordance with weather/road conditions.
• Support the business on an as needed basis by serving as a peer trainer and/or working at nearby site locations within the area
• Drive, maneuver, and load/unload a truck using approved equipment (pallet jack, etc.).
What else does the team have to offer? We’re glad you asked!
• Opportunity to work outside and drive different commercial motor vehicles in the yard and over the road
• Exposure to different Amazon site types including NACF, NASC, Air, AMZL & AMXL.
• Long-term growth potential via comprehensive training in transportation with Amazon.
• Dependent on business need, you may have the opportunity to earn your Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) paid for by Amazon.

Join ATS! ATS is one of the fastest growing business lines within Amazon over the past 5 Years with continued growth to come!

If requested due to business need, Transportation Associates must obtain their Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) and Driver Qualification File (DQF) and utilize it as a condition of the role, paid for by Amazon. If Associate is requested to become CDL and DQF certified to drive Over-the-Road for Amazon, this position becomes regulated by the Department of Transportation (DOT) and follows regulations issued by the DOT’s Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA). Candidate must hold a valid driver’s license for the state in which they reside and be eligible to drive in accordance with DOT requirements. For Department of Labor/Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration roles (roles for which you receive a CDL), English proficiency is required per federal regulation.
The timing of this requirement is dependent on business need. Continuing in the position with CDL and DQF certification is contingent upon the successful completion of a DOT-regulated pre-employment background screening, a DOT physical and Amazon’s pre-employment drug test.
Basic qualifications
• Hold a valid and active driver’s license
• High School or equivalent diploma
• Candidates must be 21 years or older with the ability to understand and adhere to all job requirement and safety guidelines in English.
• Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, reach and ascend/descend stairs
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
• Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

Preferred qualifications
• Excellent written and verbal communication and interpersonal skills with diverse audiences
• Experience building strong, collaborative relationships with colleagues and outside vendors
• A valid Class A Commercial Driver’s License (CDL)
• Completion of Career Choice Commercial Driver’s License (CDL) Course


Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent diploma

descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

As a Data Center Project Engineer, you will be a part of a creative, diverse team tasked with solving fascinating problems constructing Amazon Data Centers. Our data centers are industry examples of energy efficient, cost-effective designs. You will work alongside partner teams such as Operations, Networking, Controls, Security, and Commissioning to build Data Centers that directly support our Customers.

A Data Center Project Engineer, will support the teams that build some of the most interesting electrical and mechanical systems in the world. You will be on the construction site, daily interacting with the construction managers and stakeholders, and be directly responsible for supporting the fast, high-quality delivery of our data center construction. You will be part of the onsite Construction Management team and will own the communication coordination with our vendors, information workflow, and coordination of document management including requests for information (RFI), change orders, report, and schedule updates.

- Establishing communication and coordination across a data center region’s general contractors, stakeholders, and internal teams. Example includes sending out region wide changes to construction trailer setup, COVID-19 testing procedures, or location to access documents.

- Onboarding new vendors for badging and orientation.

- Updating project management software with milestone dates, correspondence, and documents.

- Monitor delivery of owner furnished material to site.

- Compiling and storing construction data from vendors.

- Managing checklist including various checklists including substantial completion checks, safety, and quality.
