descriptionHtml:
Amazon Ads is dedicated to driving measurable outcomes for advertisers through ad solutions—including sponsored, display, video, and audio ads that leverage Amazon's innovations and insights to find, attract, and engage intended audiences throughout their daily journeys. With flexible pricing and industry-leading technology, these solutions help advertisers build awareness, increase consideration, and drive conversions. We start with the customer and work backwards in everything we do, including advertising.
By joining our innovative team at ART19 you will help transform the future of podcast advertising. You'll be at the forefront of connecting leading advertisers with an expanding podcast audience, developing strategic partnerships that drive revenue and create unique audio solutions. This is an exciting opportunity to join a fast-growing company in an emerging media space, in a role with broad scope and the potential to make real impact. If you're interested in joining a rapidly growing team working to build a unique, world-class advertising group with a relentless focus on the customer, you've come to the right place.
Amazon Ads is seeking an Account Executive to join ART19's newly formed Advertising Sales organization. This position will drive net-new business with a prospecting-first mindset, focusing on delivering advertising revenue through strategic partnerships including agencies, and related organizations by helping them leverage Amazon Ads solutions to reach their intended audiences. As the first point of contact with prospective advertisers, you'll research and qualify leads, nurture new client relationships, deliver compelling pitch presentations (internal and external), and drive advertising investment.
Working closely with the Head of Revenue and Amazon Ads team members, you'll help establish Amazon's Podcast Audience Network as a preferred solution for advertisers in Amazon’s suite of audio products. As a critical member of the Revenue Team, you'll use data to make decisions that drive scale, operational efficiency, and customer-driven innovation in a growth environment.
The ideal candidate will bring previous experience in a similar role within a rapidly scaling national sales organization, ideally at a media company, with experience consulting with Fortune 500 advertisers and their agencies. You'll combine your established digital audio background, consultative approach, and deep understanding of the podcasting landscape to serve as a strategic partner driving client success and achieving business goals.


Key job responsibilities
• Build strategic partnerships with podcast advertisers and agencies to drive network revenue growth
• Owns key client and agency relationships and builds accounts by establishing trust and ensuring the delivery of high-quality work
• Continually develop quality and quantity of opportunities needed to achieve revenue KPI's, providing regular pipeline activity/updates
• Manages client projects from beginning to end and works with internal teams on timelines, internal and external communication, resources, and deliverables; delivers project timelines to clients and proactively keeps documentation and project management software updated
• Cultivates and seeks new opportunities within current clients and agencies; prospects new clients and assists in the creation and delivery of pitches

• Be a true hunter, hungry to uncover opportunity and connect it with a value adding solution.
• Develop consultative joint business plans. Thoughtfully respond to RFPs with effective solutions and tailored recommendations.
• Generate and maintain a robust pipeline of opportunities.
• Leverage existing industry relationships to identify new business and revenue opportunities for Amazon Ads.
• Anticipate and identify advertising customer needs. Align with internal stakeholders to overcome roadblocks and deliver bar-raising solutions.
• Provide superior customer service while maintaining compliance with advertising policies.
• Work cross-functionally with internal teams to ensure successful campaign set up, optimization, reporting and execution (e.g. SGTM, MET, LCS).


A day in the life
Your day will be dynamic and collaborative, working closely with the Head of Revenue and enablement teams to craft personalized strategies for podcast advertising partnerships. You'll dive deep into understanding partner challenges, translate complex technical concepts, and develop creative solutions that drive meaningful business outcomes. Working directly with both advertisers and internal teams, you'll help identify business opportunities and create customized solutions that deliver measurable results. This role combines strategic thinking with hands-on partnership development in the rapidly evolving podcast advertising space.

About the team
Come build the future of audio with us! What unites all Amazonians is that we are all striving to support our customers with solutions—whoever that customer may be. Together ART19 and Amazon are building audio innovation; one idea, product, and service at a time. We start with our customer, which are publishers, and work backwards in everything we do, including audio technology and the role it plays in their success. ART19 believes in Audiotonomy—a philosophy that publishers and creators deserve full control of their audio experiences, to better serve their listeners.

descriptionHtml:
The Japan Amazon Logistics (AMZL) team is seeking a Automation Engineer to drive the strategy, development, and scalable deployment of Amazon Robotics Systems and Material Handling Equipment automation across our Japanese Delivery Station Network. The successful candidate will be a senior member of the Japanese Amazon Logistics Innovation Engineering team and will own the end-to-end automation roadmap — from concept development and business case justification through pilot execution, production deployment, and continuous improvement. This role requires a technically deep, strategically minded engineer who can influence cross-functional stakeholders, mentor junior engineers, and deliver complex automation programs that raise the bar on safety, quality, productivity, and cost efficiency.

You will serve as a subject matter expert for robotics and automation within AMZL JP, partnering with Process Engineering, Operations, Facilities, RME (Reliability & Maintenance Engineering), Finance, and Design Engineering teams. You will define technical standards, drive vendor strategy, and represent AMZL JP in WW and EU forums to align on technology roadmaps and best practices. This role will be based in Tokyo, Japan and involves frequent domestic travel.

Key job responsibilities
Own the automation strategy and multi-year roadmap for AMZL JP Delivery Stations, identifying high-impact process paths for automation based on labor analysis, cost modeling, safety risk assessment, and operational performance data

Lead end-to-end automation programs — from concept through design, pilot, validation, and full-scale deployment — ensuring projects are delivered on time, within budget, and meet defined success criteria for productivity, quality, safety, and cost

Define scalable deployment playbooks and turnkey installation approaches that field teams can execute independently for production rollouts across the JP network

title: Manutentore Elettro/Meccanico, RME
descriptionHtml:
Il team Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) è fondamentale ad Amazon per monitorare tutte le attività operative: è grazie a questo team che viene garantito il corretto funzionamento di macchinari critici. In qualità di RME Technician, ti occuperai della manutenzione di una vasta gamma di macchinari e postazioni di lavoro, assicurando sempre il rispetto delle normative di salute e sicurezza. Aiuterai a tutelare la sicurezza dei colleghi, prevenendo fermi macchina. Il nostro team di RME ottimizza la disponibilità e la qualità dei nostri macchinari e migliora l’ambiente operativo nel complesso.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica e Trasporti. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3.

La retribuzione lorda per questa posizione è indicata di seguito. La retribuzione indicata corrisponde a un impiego a tempo pieno. Per un impiego a tempo parziale, la retribuzione sarà adeguata proporzionalmente.

Il team di recruiting condividerà lo stipendio finale, in base ai requisiti specifici del ruolo e a eventuali integrazioni retributive applicabili in conformità al CCNL e al livello di inquadramento.

Roma - 38,900€ lordi annui.


Key job responsibilities
Interventi di manutenzione preventiva e a guasto su un’ampia gamma di macchinari in sede.

Eseguire riparazioni di emergenza e diagnosi dei guasti nei magazzini di distribuzione.

Utilizzo di strumenti all’avanguardia per massimizzare l’efficacia dei macchinari.

Conformità a tutte le normative e prassi in materia di salute e sicurezza.

Favorire lo sviluppo e l’avanzamento di chi partecipa ai programmi di apprendistato nelle nostre sedi.

Sovraintendere a progetti di miglioramento continuo e implementare procedure chiave in una gamma di sedi europee.


A day in the life
I nostri RME Technician operano sul campo, in modo da intervenire prontamente nell’eventualità di problemi ai macchinari. A intervalli prestabiliti, eseguirai una serie di interventi di manutenzione preventiva sui macchinari delle nostre sedi, per assicurarne il corretto funzionamento. In qualità di RME Technician, interverrai prontamente in caso di guasti, investigandone le cause e implementando soluzioni in maniera tempestiva. Inoltre, indicherai possibili miglioramenti a lungo termine da apportare per scongiurare problematiche in futuro.
Affiancando i colleghi senior, ti occuperai della manutenzione ordinaria, come la tinteggiatura o l’idraulica, con il supporto di professionisti esterni se necessario. Il tuo lavoro sarà organizzato su diversi turni, per assicurare assistenza 24 ore su 24, in modo da consentire ad Amazon di effettuare le consegne con la velocità che ci contraddistingue.

About the team
La nostra forza è focalizzarci sul pensiero creativo e sul miglioraci continuamente per assicurare che milioni di prodotti arrivino nelle mani dei nostri consumatori. Il nostro obiettivo è semplice: regalare ai clienti l’esperienza di consegna più fluida possibile e lanciare soluzioni globali per la consegna nei nostri nuovi business, come Amazon Fresh, Prime Now e Amazon Restaurants.
La nostra attività si articola su due livelli. Da un lato c’è chi opera in sede e gestisce milioni di prodotti, facendoli arrivare ai team responsabili della consegna. Il nostro team è orientato alle persone e sempre pronto a darsi una mano, soprattutto considerato che molti dei nostri colleghi svolgono il turno notturno. Ci concentriamo principalmente sulle attività operative, con turni articolati sulle 24 ore, 7 giorni alla settimana, nella maggior parte delle nostre sedi.

title: HR Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
In pursuit of being Earth's Best Employer, our global Human Resources teams, known as People eXperience and Technology (PXT), drive business success by fostering a safe, inclusive, and innovative culture. The HR Business Partner is responsible for operational excellence and organizational health at assigned site(s), serving as an individual contributor partnering directly with Field Leaders and site(s) leadership teams. You will strengthen culture and deliver business results by translating organizational priorities into actionable plans, executing business goals through data-driven decision making, and partnering with campus leaders to improve the employee experience. This role is accountable for the end-to-end employee experience, owning site(s)-level feedback mechanisms, recognition programs, and environment standards that shape trust, engagement, and performance. 

You will be expected to work onsite(s) at an Amazon facility, supporting multiple site(s)s within your region (campus) with regular mobility across assigned locations. 

Key job responsibilities
Employee Experience & Engagement 
- Foster two-way communication between employees and leaders through feedback mechanisms like Voice of the Associate, roundtables, and GEMBA walks .
- Execute and monitor employee engagement strategies and recognition programs, including budget planning and employee appreciation activities.
- Build an environment where employees feel safe and included, establishing Employee Resource Groups and ensuring equitable talent practices.
- Maintain meaningful floor presence across the site(s), gathering insights and identifying early signs of disengagement 

Operational Excellence & Site(s) Standards 
- Conduct regular site(s) walks to assess workplace conditions and maintain facility standards in alignment with Amazon standards .
- Partner with site(s) leaders and safety teams to ensure consistent execution of safety programs .
- Lead community initiatives at your site(s), partnering across your node and with Public Policy and Public Relations teams .
- Improve site(s) effectiveness by identifying systemic patterns, addressing root causes, and ensuring consistent, fair application of policies 

Data-Driven Decision Making & Technology 
- Use data analytics to identify emerging trends, predict challenges, and implement proactive solutions.
- Drive adoption of HR technology solutions, AI, and self-service tools while maintaining high-touch service delivery in critical moments.

Strategic PXT Leadership 
- Partner with site(s) leadership to balance operational needs with Amazon's values and people priorities .
- Coach Business Leaders on effective people management practices, including performance feedback, team development, and employee relations matters.
- Support change implementation by reinforcing messaging, addressing resistance, and helping leaders translate change into local routines.
- Execute core PXT processes while building trust and influence through sound business acumen 

A day in the life
Your day will be a dynamic blend of strategic thinking and data-driven decision-making. You'll leverage advanced analytics and AI-enabled tools to identify trends, anticipate business needs, and develop solutions that enhance workplace experience. From coaching leadership teams on workforce management to driving HR process excellence, you'll collaborate with Field leaders on operational objectives and team effectiveness. You'll maintain strong floor presence, building partnerships across all levels while contributing to meaningful workplace improvements through site(s) walks, employee feedback sessions, and strategic initiatives. 

Success comes from your ability to navigate organizational dynamics, lead change initiatives, and make high-judgment decisions in ambiguous situations. Through business acumen, data-driven insights, and strategic partnerships, you'll help create a workplace culture where employees feel valued and empowered.

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in a call center, distribution center, or manufacturing environment

descriptionHtml:
Als Nachwuchsführungskraft wirst du in unserem 11-wöchigen internen Onboarding Programm auf deine neue Aufgabe als Führungskraft vorbereitet.
Nach dieser umfangreichen Einarbeitung übernimmst du Führungsverantwortung für dein eigenes Team und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Kunden Ihre Waren pünktlich und in guter Qualität erhalten. In dieser Position bist du wichtiger Teil unseres globalen Unternehmens und arbeitest Hand in Hand mit deinen Mitarbeitenden vor Ort. Zudem arbeitest du standortübergreifend an Themen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Prozessoptimierung, Nachhaltigkeit und technischem Fortschritt.

Key job responsibilities
- Sicherstellung der Einhaltung der Arbeitssicherheitsvorschriften und des Umweltschutzes
- Ableitung von Handlungsempfehlungen und konkreten Maßnahmen zur Prozessverbesserung auf Basis von Kennzahlen wie Arbeitssicherheit, Produktivität und Qualität
- Leitung und Weiterbildung eines Teams (bis zu 100 Mitarbeitende)
- Planung und Steuerung der innerbetrieblichen Prozesse
- Teilnahme in übergeordneten Projekten zur Optimierung der Kundenzufriedenheit
- Effektives Ressourcen- und Workflowmanagement
- Zusammenarbeit mit den vor- und nachgelagerten Abteilungen vor Ort

A day in the life
Du arbeitest in einer unserer Schichten (Früh-, Spät- oder Nachtschicht). Dabei ist das Einhalten der Sicherheitsstandards an deinem gesamten Standort für dich höchste Priorität. Als Schichtleitung führst du routinemäßig Teammeetings durch und führst Feedbackgespräche mit deinen Mitarbeitenden und deinen Stakeholdern. Mit Hilfe von Datenauswertungen nimmst Du Einfluss auf die Produktivität und die Qualität deines Standortes. Als wichtiges Mitglied des Teams vor Ort arbeitest Du mit anderen Abteilungen, sowie externen Stakeholdern zusammen und sorgst dafür, dass wir die Anforderungen unserer Kundschaft, ebenso wie unsere eigenen Vorgaben jederzeit erfüllen. Durch die Analyse von Daten mit Führungskräften und die Besprechung der betrieblichen Vor- und Nachteile von technischen Verbesserungen mit den Fachabteilungen trägst du zu „best in class“ Lösungen bei.

About the team
Amazon Logistik (AMZL) ist für die Auslieferung von Millionen von Produkten unserer Kunden und Kundinnen direkt an die Haustür verantwortlich. Die „Last-Mile-Logistik“ liefert unsere Pakete in Partnerschaft mit Drittanbietern und realisiert zahlreiche Initiativen zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung, um Millionen von Kunden zufrieden zu stellen.
Unser Ziel ist es, das Liefererlebnis für unsere Kund:innen so reibungslos wie möglich zu machen und globale Lieferlösungen für unsere neuesten Angebote einzuführen, darunter Amazon Fresh, Prime Now und Amazon Restaurants.
Unsere Arbeit lässt sich in zwei Sparten unterteilen. „Under the Roof“ betrifft alles was innerhalb unserer Logistikstandorte passiert und „On the Road“ alles was in den Liefergebieten auf der Straße stattfindet. Unsere Mitarbeitenden bereiten die Pakete in entsprechenden Schichten (Nacht, Früh, Spät) auf den täglichen Versand an unsere Lieferteams vor und kümmern sich um Retouren, die nicht ausgeliefert werden konnten.
Jedes Jahr setzen wir neue Maßstäbe in puncto Kundenerlebnis und bieten neue, innovative Lieferdienste an. Wir suchen nach neuen Möglichkeiten, um branchenweite Logistikherausforderungen zu überwinden, sowie nach neuen Ideen, um unseren CO2-Fußabdruck zu reduzieren. Ein Fuhrpark innovativer Fahrzeuge (einschließlich E-Fahrzeugen) und modernste Technologie unterstützen uns dabei.

title: Cleared Engineering Operations Technician, ADC InfraOps DCEO, ADC InfraOps DCEO
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The Data Center Engineering Operations Technician (EOT) are Amazon’s front line responders for hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting and operation. This equipment includes, but is not limited to, stand-by diesel generators, switchboards/switchgears, UPSs, PDUs, AHUs, pumps, motors, VFDs, and building automation systems. They provide 24/7 shift coverage which could include 12 hour shifts, rotating shifts, 3, 4, or 5 day work weeks.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US citizen and currently possess and maintain an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility.

Key job responsibilities
- Operate and maintain mechanical and electrical, mechanical, emergency generator, and fire/life safety equipment within the data center
- Troubleshoot of facility and rack-level events within internal SLAs
- Perform limited maintenance tasks to including filter changes, HVAC PMs, rack power installs, rack PDU, and rack ATS replacements
- Provide support to Data Center Operations technicians
- Perform root cause analysis of equipment failures
- Ensure all safety procedures are adhered to while performing work
- Work a 12 hour shift (rotating 3 and 4 day work weeks days or nights)
- Take daily operational readings of all mechanical and electrical equipment through routine rounds/log taking (temperatures, voltages, currents, etc.)
- Utilize internal CMMS to manage building workflows and spare part inventory
- Supervise contractors who perform servicing or preventive maintenance
- Respond to off hour emergency calls per on call rotation for any one of the region’s sites
- Fully comply with all physical security procedures and policies
- Drive innovation while reducing operational costs in the facilities
- Manipulate small wires and objects
Perform the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
- Walk job sites in uneven terrain
- Work at heights and from ladders
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds; and participate in group lifts for 40 pounds or more
- Bend or twist the body into unusual positions while working
- Push or pull heavy objects into position
- Work in noisy environments

A day in the life
After an initial training period, you will support data center infrastructure operations on a shift schedule supporting our 24/7 staffing model. You will get information from your peer technicians who are ending shift, review the maintenance schedule for any tasks due that day, and then perform routine physical checks of our critical systems. After these rounds are complete, you and your shift partner will perform preventative maintenance, troubleshoot technical issues, take repair actions, and perform facility maintenance. You will also author technical procedures, work orders, and work on advanced qualifications and projects as your career progresses at AWS!

title: Area Manager II
descriptionHtml:
Our WW Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly workforce and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key role in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

title: Shift Area Manager, Last Mile Operations
descriptionHtml:
When you join Amazon as an Area Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.
Amazon is looking for high-potential leaders, who are ready to own their impact in Amazon Operations as an entry-level manager working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. You will have your leadership capacity stretched to its full potential, As a front-line leader, you will have an opportunity to truly invest in others and develop a people-focused leadership style, while mastering the tools, processes, and operations that have created the most customer-centric company on Earth. If you want to be involved in continuing to define the future of online retail, and are dynamic and an organized self-starter, join our team in Amazon Operations.
Job Specifics:
- This role is fully onsite and requires flexibility to work and rotate shifts: weekends, holidays, and/or overnight shifts, and Ability to work overtime both in peak season and as needed.

Key job responsibilities
- Promote a culture of safety and wellbeing
- Analyze and implement corrective actions to make sure quality and productivity are at consistently high levels, and business objectives are met across all shifts
- Support and lead a team and handle administrative work alongside building and supporting a strong team culture
- Analyze performance and suggest process improvements to optimize work and improve customer service
- Promote best practice and continuous process improvements across your team in areas like health and safety and productivity
- Collaborate with other managers to standardize shift processes


A day in the life
You’ll work shifts and be based at one of our operational sites. Your main focus will be to maintain safety standards within your team and across your site. You’ll also monitor and maintain process efficiency. Your days will always include prioritizing routine team management and daily operational tasks, alongside other tasks like individual escalations, process improvement work and wide-scale operational contingency planning.

Being a key part of the operations team involves working with colleagues in other teams and external partners to make sure we stay on track to meet our customer demands and targets. This will involve analyzing data and performance metrics with leaders in your business area, as well as discussing the operational pros and cons of technical improvements with engineers.

About the team
Amazon Logistics, or AMZL, handles ‘last mile’ delivery duties in partnership with third-party distribution businesses. We utilise creative thinking and continuous improvement initiatives to get millions of physical products into the hands of our customers. Our goal is to make our customers’ delivery experience as smooth as possible and roll out global delivery solutions for our newest concepts, like Amazon Fresh, Prime Now and Amazon Restaurants.

There are two sides to what we do. Our ‘under the roof’ associates process millions of products for dispatch to our delivery teams. Our team is people-focused and supportive, particularly as lots of our people work through the night. We focus mostly on operations, with 24/7 shifts in most of our locations.

Meanwhile, our ‘on the road’ people work with Amazon Flex - a network of delivery contractors. Every year, we continually raise the bar for customer experience with new, innovative delivery services. We look for new ways to overcome industry wide logistics challenges and new ideas to reduce our carbon footprint.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- 2+ years of performance metrics, process improvement or lean techniques experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Knowledge of Microsoft Excel at an advanced level, including: pivot tables, macros, index/match, vlookup, VBA, data links, etc.

Preferred qualifications

- Speak, write, and read fluently in English

title: Machine Learning Performance Engineer, Annapurna Labs
descriptionHtml:
The Annapurna Labs team at Amazon Web Services (AWS) builds AWS Neuron, the software development kit used to accelerate deep learning and generative AI workloads on Amazon's custom machine learning accelerators — Inferentia and Trainium. These chips power workloads for thousands of AWS customers, from large language model training runs to real-time inference serving billions of daily predictions.

We are building the first Neuron performance engineering team in Tel Aviv. As a Machine Learning Performance Engineer, you'll help shape the direction of this team from the ground up — profiling and optimizing workloads across the full ML software stack, writing high-performance kernels, and improving the Neuron SDK that external developers depend on. You'll work at the boundary between software and hardware, collaborating directly with compiler, runtime, and chip design engineers to close performance gaps customers care about.

The team is new and small, which means broad scope, direct ownership, and real influence over the technical direction we take. If you enjoy digging into performance bottlenecks and turning analysis into measurable wins, this role is for you.

Key job responsibilities
Design and implement high-performance compute kernels for ML operations, leveraging the Neuron architecture and programming models.
Profile ML workloads end-to-end to identify bottlenecks — memory, compute, or communication — and drive optimizations through to a measured improvement.
Enhance the programming model and tooling that kernel and model developers rely on, improving usability and debugging workflows.
Identify and drive optimization opportunities across the Neuron software stack (compiler, runtime, frameworks).
Document software designs, operational runbooks, and performance findings so the broader team can build on your work.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing profiling data from a customer's large diffusion model training job, tracing a utilization gap back to a specific kernel. After a design discussion with compiler engineers about a new operator fusion strategy, you spend the afternoon writing and benchmarking a kernel prototype. Later, you review a teammate's pull request for a runtime optimization and share your findings in a short write-up for the broader Neuron organization. Your work directly translates into faster model execution and lower cost for AWS customers running ML workloads at scale.

About the team
The Neuron Performance Engineering team in Tel Aviv is part of Annapurna Labs within AWS. Our mission is to make sure every ML workload running on Inferentia and Trainium chips reaches its full performance potential. We partner closely with compiler, framework, and hardware teams across Annapurna Labs, and we work directly with AWS customers to understand their models and unblock their adoption.

We are a newly formed group which is part of the larger Neuron organization. If you want to shape a team's technical culture from its earliest days while working on problems that matter to the future of AI infrastructure, we'd love to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- Knowledge of Python and/or C++ programming
- Knowledge of computer architecture, operating systems, and parallel computing
- Experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, and/or JAX

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience optimizing performance for LLM, Vision, or other deep-learning models
- Experience with kernel writing or parallel programming (CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, Pallas, Mojo, SIMD, MPI)
- Experience with compiler optimization or hardware-software co-design

title: Data Center IT Support Manager, Rack Lifecycle Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

We are looking for a hands-on, operationally focused Rack Lifecycle Team Manager to join our Infrastructure Operations team, owning the day-to-day execution of rack lifecycle operations within data center sites. This role is responsible for the full continuum of rack operations — from demand intake and rack landing, through Late Binding cabling, rack installation and handoff, to end-of-life decommissioning — at the site level.

You will lead a team of data center technicians, translating organizational capacity goals into executed deliverables on the floor. As a tactical leader, you are the single accountable owner for ensuring every rack needed for customer capacity lands on time, is cabled and installed to standard, has no install blockers at handoff, and is decommissioned safely and compliantly at end-of-life.

Your work directly supports AWS's ability to deliver infrastructure capacity to customers reliably and at the lowest possible cost, while maintaining the highest standards of safety, security, and environmental compliance.


Key job responsibilities
Rack Delivery & Installation
- Lead planning and execution of network deployments including rack installs, structured cabling, fiber trunks, and MMR/CFA builds to meet committed customer capacity dates
- Coordinate site readiness, RSPC readiness (Rack Space Power Cooling); ensure racks are landed, cabled, and ready for cabling patching and install per standards
- Proactively identify and drive resolution of blockers across permits, site access, facilities, power, cross-connects, and vendor dependencies
- Drive cross-team coordination with DCO, DCEO, LOG, security, CDP, Supply chain, Transport and GND during deployment waves, running escalation touchpoints and daily stand-ups as needed
- Ensuring rack installations are as per MOP/SOP and documenting the handovers for later refences and improvements

Cabling Infrastructure (Late Binding)
- Own scope for fiber/copper cabling, patching schedules, and labeling standards for the site
- Validate OTDR/power testing and as-built documentation; ensure cabling meets quality standards and capacity requirements before handoff
- Maintain cabling infrastructure governance including CMDB accuracy and port map integrity post-installation
- Identify systemic cabling quality gaps and implement corrective actions to improve cycle times and first-pass quality

Supply Chain & Logistics
- Track rack, cable, optics, and network BOM from PO to site; monitor lead times, logistics, customs clearance, and site inventory levels
- Flag supply chain risks to schedule early and coordinate with procurement, logistics, and vendor partners on mitigation plans
- Ensure material availability aligns with deployment timelines; maintain site-level inventory accuracy

Stakeholder Management & Blocker Removal
- Serve as the single point of contact for internal customers, DC Ops, facilities, transport, and vendors for site-level rack lifecycle activities
- Run daily and weekly war rooms during deployment waves; provide timely status updates and escalate blockers to senior leadership as needed
- Build effective working relationships with cross-functional partners to ensure alignment and uninterrupted delivery execution

Rack Decommissioning (Decom)
- Own the site-level decommission pipeline for EOL racks; coordinate with Capacity Planning, Network Operations, and DCLM/ALM teams to schedule graceful shutdowns with zero service impact
- Lead physical decommission activities — device wipe, media destruction, cable removal, power disconnect, asset de-tagging, and rack removal — ensuring full MOP and EHS compliance
- Track and recover reusable assets (optics, cables, PDUs, hardware); coordinate RMA, liquidation, or secure disposal per AWS Reverse Logistics and Environmental policies
- Validate that reclaimed power, cooling, and U-space is accurately returned to the available pool; drive re-use to defer new builds and improve TCO
- Ensure data hygiene post-decom including DCIM/CMDB updates, IPAM releases, port map reconciliation, and circuit/cross-connect documentation

Governance, Metrics & Reporting
- Track and report on site-level KPIs including: racks landed vs. plan, Late Binding cabling completion %, capacity ready dates, received vs. installed cycle time, decom backlog vs. flightpath goal, and shipment achievement %
- Define and enforce site-level policies, SOPs, and governance frameworks aligned with AWS standards and industry best practices across all rack lifecycle phases
- Provide accurate, data-driven reporting on delivery performance, blockers, and improvement initiatives to the Cluster Manager and senior leadership
- Champion adoption of tooling (e.g., Boost, MARS, ALM/DCLM) to reduce manual effort, improve data accuracy, and accelerate delivery cycle times

Handover & Documentation
- Ensure clean, documented handoffs to Data Center Operations teams with updated CMDB/DCIM records, port maps, test results, and completed workflow sign-offs — with zero blockers at handoff
- Maintain accurate and current records in DCIM/CMDB, IPAM, and related systems throughout all lifecycle phases
- Ensure all as-built documentation, cabling records, and workflow completions are captured and auditable
Team Leadership & Operations Management
- Lead, coach, and develop a team of data center technicians; manage staffing, scheduling, and day-to-day workforce planning for the site
- Conduct regular team meetings, drive performance accountability, and ensure appropriate training and skill development across all lifecycle functions
- Translate organizational goals into actionable team objectives; manage sprint planning, team output quality, and SLA compliance
- Participate in recruiting, onboarding, and performance management; make staffing recommendations in partnership with manager and HR
- Foster a high-performance, inclusive, and safety-first team culture

A day in the life
As the Rack Lifecycle Team Manager for your site, no two days are the same.
You might start your morning reviewing the site's daily rack landing dashboard, checking in with your technicians on an active cabling wave, and triaging a supply chain delay flagged overnight. By midday, you could be on the data center floor coordinating a rack placement with facilities, validating a power sign-off checklist before a network device install, or running a decom stand-up to confirm MOP readiness for an EOL rack removal. In the afternoon, you might be updating CMDB records following a completed handoff, reviewing your team's KPI performance ahead of a weekly operations review, or coaching a technician on structured cabling standards.

Your role is tactical and hands-on — you execute with your team, remove blockers in real time, and hold the line on quality and schedule at the site level.

About the team
Why AWS
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship and Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of direct people management, including managing managers or senior individual contributors experience
- 3+ years of data center engineering or operations experience

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center, critical environment, computer hardware repair, infrastructure cabling, network deployment, or data center operations experience, or experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)
- 2+ years of network cabling, fiber optics, and test equipment including VFL, power meter, and OTDR experience, or experience related IT
- Experience measuring key operational metrics (e.g., order cycle time, ship estimate accuracy, on-time and complete shipment, inventory record defect rate)
- Experience managing and negotiating contracts and vendor relationships
- - Industry standard certification (CompTIA, CCENT, or Network+), or experience working in a colocation data center facility

title: Site Operations Leader, OMHS
descriptionHtml:
As a Site Operations Leader within the OneMHS Installation & Deployment (I&D) team, you will serve as the central engineering coordinator for large-scale material handling equipment (MHE) installation projects in greenfield and brownfield Amazon fulfillment environments. You will work directly alongside installation teams on active construction sites, owning the project schedule and coordinating all on-site project teams, sub-team leaders, and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver complex MHE systems from equipment receipt through commissioning.

You will independently manage the project schedule, procurement workflows, equipment logistics, and budget administration for MHE installation projects ranging from $50M to $100M+ in scope. Working directly with mechanical installation leads, electrical installation leads, controls engineers, commissioning teams, and external MHE vendors, you will be the single-threaded owner for site-level coordination — ensuring all teams are aligned, resources are sequenced correctly, and the project stays on track.

This is a field-based engineering role embedded within active construction sites. You will operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment where you proactively identify schedule risks, resolve inter-team dependencies, and drive continuous improvement in how Amazon deploys MHE systems at scale.


Key job responsibilities
Project Coordination & Schedule Management
• Own and maintain the project schedule for MHE installation across assigned greenfield and brownfield sites
• Coordinate daily activities across all on-site project teams including mechanical installation, electrical installation, controls integration, and commissioning
• Serve as the central point of coordination between sub-team leaders, ensuring work sequences are properly phased and resource conflicts are resolved
• Lead daily site coordination meetings to align all installation teams on priorities, constraints, and upcoming milestones
• Track critical path items across all sub-teams and proactively identify and mitigate schedule risks
• Manage inter-team dependencies — ensuring predecessor work is complete before successor teams mobilize
• Coordinate site access timelines, aligning MHE first access dates with installation and commissioning schedules
• Create and maintain integrated project schedules coordinating engineering, supply chain, construction, and commissioning timelines
• Monitor and report KPIs for schedule adherence, budget performance, and installation progress
Site Logistics & Material Coordination
• Coordinate MHE equipment storage, sequencing, and shipment logistics between manufacturers, third-party storage facilities, and installation sites
• Manage equipment inventory tracking across active construction sites to ensure installation teams have materials staged and ready
• Engineer receiving and staging plans for MHE components including unloading coordination, inventory verification, and sequenced material placement
• Develop and maintain receiving instructions and standard operating procedures for installation crews
• Deploy and manage construction monitoring systems for progress documentation
• Coordinate asset tracking technology deployments to maintain visibility of MHE components through the installation lifecycle
• Ensure compliance with Amazon safety standards and construction site safety requirements during all installation activities
Procurement & Financial Management
• Own procurement workflows including purchase order creation, change order controls, and invoice management via Coupa
• Manage project budgets, tracking spend against approved allocations
• Develop and track financial reporting for assigned projects, providing regular budget status updates to leadership
• Coordinate with Global Procurement Organization (GPO) on vendor work allocation decisions and procurement strategies
• Create financial justification documents for equipment purchases and technology investments
• Support development of procurement and logistics strategies for large-scale multi-site deployments
Vendor Coordination & Management
• Serve as primary operational point of contact for MHE vendors on assigned sites
• Coordinate vendor equipment delivery schedules, milestone tracking, and change request alignment
• Lead vendor schedule review meetings and drive resolution of schedule conflicts between vendor and internal installation teams
• Manage vendor work allocation processes, ensuring clear scope definitions between self-perform and contracted work
• Support cross-vendor coordination for integrated installation projects involving multiple equipment suppliers
• Track and manage vendor change requests, ensuring proper documentation and financial alignment
Technical Documentation & Standards
• Develop and maintain cross-vendor work instructions for MHE installation activities
• Create and manage engineering documentation including receiving instructions, site logistics plans, and installation SOPs
• Support development of installation training materials and engineering standards documentation
• Contribute to drawing standards and layout reviews for MHE installation projects
• Participate in design reviews supporting execution between internal teams and outside vendors
• Maintain project documentation in alignment with I&D engineering team standards and best practices
Reporting & Stakeholder Communication
• Communicate project schedule status, risks, and team coordination updates to engineering leadership
• Participate in Daily Business Reviews (DBRs) providing installation progress updates on safety, job plans, and team readiness
• Support Weekly Business Reviews (WBRs) with MHE vendor partners covering risks, schedules, commercials, and capacity
• Contribute to Monthly Business Reviews (MBRs) with project-level metrics and milestones
• Provide technical input to leadership for data-driven decision-making
• Produce regular status summaries covering team progress, schedule variance, and resource utilization
• Identify and escalate inter-team conflicts, resource constraints, and schedule risks in a timely manner
• Support achievement of safety, timeline, cost, and quality metrics across assigned sites


A day in the life
A typical day for a Site Operations Leader begins with the daily site coordination meeting,
aligning mechanical, electrical, and controls teams on priorities and resolving any
sequencing conflicts. From there, you're walking the active construction site - verifying
material staging, checking that equipment deliveries match the schedule, and
troubleshooting any gaps holding up installation crews. Mid-day often involves vendor
schedule reviews, Coupa procurement actions, and updating the project schedule with
progress from each sub-team. You close out by flagging risks in the DBR, coordinating nextday
material needs, and ensuring every team has what they need to stay on track.

About the team
OneMHS (One Material Handling Systems) is Amazon's in-house program for designing,
procuring, and installing material handling equipment across its fulfillment network. Rather
than relying solely on external integrators, OneMHS brings the full lifecycle of MHE
deployment under Amazon's direct control - from final engineering and equipment
procurement through mechanical and electrical installation, controls integration, and
commissioning. The program supports both greenfield builds and brownfield retrofits,
deploying conveyor systems, sorters, induction systems, and robotic work cells at scale.
OneMHS enables Amazon to deliver faster, more cost-effective installations while
maintaining higher quality and safety standards.

Team is able to hire anywhere in the USA.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of directly managing and responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 5+ years of Reliability Program Manager experience
- 5+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- 5+ years of maintenance or engineering experience
- 2+ years of commercial CO2 refrigeration applications experience
- 5+ years of directly managing and being responsible for multiple large projects experience
- 3+ years of in material handling equipment (MHE) or automation environments experience, or experience in reliability/maintenance environments
- 3+ years of leading cross-functional teams across engineering, operations, and field execution through launch readiness and go-live phases experience
- Refrigeration Trade School certificate
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical or Mechanical Engineering, Engineering Technology, Reliability Engineering, or 2+ years of Amazon RME (BB/3P) Full Time Exempt experience
- Experience and strong technical background in relevant fields of automated or non-automated material handling equipment
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- Master's degree in engineering, mechanical, operations, supply chain, business administration, or equivalent STEM field
- Master's degree or above in Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Operations, Supply Chain, or Business Administration, or Master's degree or above in STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering, and Mathematics)

descriptionHtml:
日本の紙書籍の流通は、既存物流網に対する新たな制約やコスト増、読者の嗜好の多様化、経済状況や購買行動の変化といった、新たな課題に次々と直面しています。こうしためまぐるしく変化するビジネス環境の中であっても、Amazon 書籍事業部の Strategic Supply Chain Management チームは、社内外のステークホルダーと協力し、「読みたい本が、読みたいときに手に入る」というミッションの実現に向けて日々奮闘しています。

当チームは、社内の様々なチームに加え、出版社・取次会社・倉庫・物流会社といった社外のステークホルダーと協働し、紙書籍の在庫・物流に関する戦略立案と実行を担っています。そのうち、今回募集する Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、出版社の在庫管理を専門に支援するチームに所属し、アサインされた出版社（1人あたり3〜4社）に寄り添いながら、在庫・物流を中心としたサプライチェーン上の課題を特定し、解決策の設計から実行までを一気通貫で担うコンサルタント職です。社内の多様なチームと協業し、お客様の購買体験と出版社のビジネスの双方を改善します。なお、本ポジションは原則として電子書籍を業務スコープに含みません。

この職種の魅力:

在庫、需要予測、物流のデータを自ら分析し、改善施策を企画から実行までオーナーシップを持って進められます
欠品の削減、発売日のお届け、配送スピードなど、お客様が実感できる成果に直結します
日本の出版流通という業界構造そのものに向き合い、出版社の意思決定層と直接議論する機会があります
前例のない課題に、自分の分析と行動で最初に取り組めます
変化を脅威ではなく機会ととらえ、自ら課題を見つけて動けるリーダーをお待ちしています。

Japan's print book supply chain meets new challenges one after another: new constraints and rising costs across the existing logistics network, broadening reader preferences, and shifts in the economy and in how people buy. Even in this fast-changing environment, the Strategic Supply Chain Management team in Amazon's Books organization works with stakeholders inside and outside Amazon, every day, to deliver on one mission: readers get the book they want, when they want it.

Our team sets and executes the strategy for print book inventory and logistics. We work across Amazon and with external stakeholders including publishers, distributors, warehouses, and transportation providers. As an Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will join a team dedicated to supporting publishers' inventory management. You will work closely with an assigned group of publishers (three to four per role), identify supply chain problems centered on inventory and logistics, and own the solution end to end, from design through execution. You will collaborate with teams across Amazon to improve both the customer buying experience and our publishers' business. As a rule, this position does not include eBooks in its scope.

Why you will love this role:

You analyze inventory, forecasting, and logistics data yourself, and own improvement initiatives from idea through execution.
Your work connects directly to outcomes customers feel: fewer out-of-stock titles, delivery on release day, and faster shipping speed.
You engage with the structure of Japan's book distribution industry, and discuss decisions directly with publisher leadership.
You are first to take on problems with no precedent, where your own analysis and action move the result.
We are looking for a customer-focused, driven, and analytical leader who sees change as an opportunity rather than a threat, and who finds and acts on problems without being asked.

Key job responsibilities
Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager は、担当する出版社（1人あたり3〜4社）の在庫戦略にオーナーシップを持ち、商品セレクションの拡充、欠品の削減、サプライチェーンの効率化を通じて、お客様にとって最良の購買体験と事業の収益性の双方を高めます。担当出版社の在庫計画と運用管理のすべての側面を担うことが、この職種の業務の基盤です。加えて、そこで得た知見や経験をもとに、チーム全体が追う欠品率などの指標の改善、重要プロジェクト、事業部全体を横断する取り組みにも携わります。

主な職務内容:

担当出版社の需要予測、発注、在庫水準の計画を立案し、欠品の削減と在庫回転率の改善を主導します
出版社のサプライチェーン上の課題を特定し、改善施策を設計から実行まで一気通貫で担います
納品リードタイム、受注対応、在庫情報の連携など、出版社側のオペレーション改善を支援します
効率的で拡張性のあるサプライチェーンを構築し、固定費・変動費の削減に貢献します
Amazon 社内の購買・発注の仕組みとシステムを理解し、活用および改善提案を行います
データ分析、自動化、継続的な改善により、業務の精度とスピードを高めます
当チームでは、担当範囲の線引きにとらわれず、チームの成果のために必要なことへ自ら手を伸ばすことを期待しています。Amazon のリーダーは「それは私の仕事ではありません」とは決して口にしません。チームおよびプログラムの状況に応じて、担当出版社の枠を越えた指標の改善、重要プロジェクト、上記以外の業務を、一時的または継続的に担当することがあります。自ら職務範囲を広げていける方にとって、成長の機会が多い環境です。

As an Associate Strategic Supply Chain Manager, you will own the inventory strategy for an assigned group of publishers (three to four per role). You will grow selection, reduce out-of-stock titles, and drive supply chain efficiency, so that customers get a best-in-class buying experience and the business grows revenue and margin. Covering all aspects of inventory planning and operational management for your publishers is the foundation of this job. Building on what you learn there, you will also help improve the metrics the whole team owns, such as out-of-stock rate, and take part in key projects and in initiatives that run across the Books organization.

Key job responsibilities:

Build demand forecasting, ordering, and inventory level plans for your publishers, and drive improvement in out-of-stock rate and inventory turns.
Identify supply chain problems at your publishers, and own improvement initiatives from design through execution.
Support your publishers in improving their operations, including delivery lead time, order confirmation, and inventory data exchange.
Build efficient and scalable supply chain operations that reduce fixed and variable costs.
Understand and apply Amazon's internal buying and ordering systems and processes, and propose improvements to them.
Raise the accuracy and speed of your work through data analysis, automation, and Kaizen.
On this team, we expect you to look past the boundaries of your assigned scope and reach for whatever the team's results require. Leaders at Amazon never say "that's not my job." Depending on team and program circumstances, you may take on metric improvements beyond your assigned publishers, key projects, or work outside the scope described above, either temporarily or on an ongoing basis. For someone who wants to widen their own remit, this is an environment with a lot of room to grow.

At Amazon, you'll work alongside the latest AI and GenAI tools that are increasingly woven into how teams operate: from AI-powered capabilities that accelerate decision-making, to Generative AI that helps you focus on work that truly matters. You'll have opportunities and resources to develop AI fluency at your own pace, with continuous learning built into the culture.

A day in the life
日々の業務は担当出版社との対話と、その背後にあるデータの分析を往復しながら進みます。直接のクライアントは担当出版社ですが、最終的なお客様は本を待っている読者です。業務の中心は担当出版社ですが、週の一部は、チーム全体が追う指標の改善や、事業部を横断する取り組みに充てることもあります。

出版社側のカウンターパートは、在庫・物流・営業の担当部門です。Amazon 社内では、同じく出版社を担当するチームメンバーや、Strategic Supply Chain Management チームの各メンバーと最も密に協働します。書籍事業部内では、アカウントマネージャー、売上向上コンサルタント、商品企画担当、マーケティング部門などの各チームと連携します。さらに、フルフィルメントセンター、輸送、需要予測やシステムの関連チーム、ファイナンス、および他国の同職種のチームとも日常的に関わります。

解決する課題は、欠品の発生原因の特定と解消、新刊の発売日に向けた在庫確保、需要予測の精度改善、納品プロセスに潜む非効率の解消などです。

一日・一週間の業務の例:

担当出版社の指標（欠品率、在庫水準、納品実績）を確認し、異常値の原因を特定します
データを抽出して深く掘り下げ、課題を定量化した上で仮説を立てます
仮説に基づきアクションプランとスケジュールを設計し、出版社や社内ステークホルダー向けの資料を作成してレビューを受けます
担当出版社からの問い合わせに対応し、在庫や納品に関する判断を日次で行います
Amazon 社内システム上で、需要予測や発注、在庫に関する設定と実行を行います
出版社との定例ミーティングで改善の進捗を共有し、次に取り組むことを合意します
担当出版社の枠を越え、チーム全体が追う指標の改善に向けた分析や施策の検討に取り組みます
事業部を横断するプロジェクトや、チーム内の業務プロセスの改善・自動化に参加します

Your days move back and forth between conversations with your publishers and analysis of the data behind them. Your direct clients are the publishers you are assigned to, and your ultimate customers are the readers waiting for their books. Your publishers are the center of the work, though part of your week may also go to improving the metrics the whole team owns and to initiatives that run across the Books organization.

At your publishers, your counterparts are the teams responsible for inventory, logistics, and sales. Inside Amazon, you work most closely with the other members who cover publishers and with the members of the Strategic Supply Chain Management team. Within the Books organization, you work with account managers, sales growth consultants, merchandising and product planning, and Marketing. You also engage day to day with our fulfillment centers, Transportation, forecasting and technology teams, Finance, and your counterparts in other countries.

The problems you solve include finding and removing the causes of out-of-stock titles, securing inventory ahead of new release dates, improving forecast accuracy, and taking inefficiency out of the delivery process.

A typical day or week:

Review metrics for your publishers, including out-of-stock rate, inventory levels, and delivery performance, and identify the cause of anything that looks off.
Extract data and run a deep dive analysis to quantify the problem and form a hypothesis.
Design an action plan and schedule from that hypothesis, draft the materials for your publishers and internal stakeholders, and take them through review.
Respond to inquiries from your publishers, and make day-to-day decisions on inventory and delivery.
Configure and run demand forecasting, ordering, and inventory settings in Amazon's internal systems.
Share progress in regular meetings with your publishers, and agree on what to tackle next.
Work on analysis and initiatives that improve the metrics the whole team owns, beyond your own publishers.
Take part in projects that run across the Books organization, and in improving and automating how the team works.

About the team
書籍事業部について

読書は健全な社会にとって必須であるという信念のもと、読者がより手軽に本を読み、読書からより多くを得られるようにすることが私たちの使命です。

本ポジションが所属する Strategic Supply Chain Management チームのミッションは、お客様が読みたい書籍を、読みたいタイミングでお届けすることです。そのために、適切な商品を、適切な数量で、適切な場所に、適切なタイミングで揃えることに取り組んでいます。

日本の紙書籍のサプライチェーンは、いま転換点にあります。従来の延長線上の改善では解決できない構造的な課題が増えており、業界全体で大きな変革が必要だという認識が共有されつつあります。それは同時に、お客様のための改善に取り組む機会が豊富にあることを意味します。特に、AI モデルなどの技術を活用してサプライチェーンや在庫管理の業務を自動化し、お客様への提供価値を高める余地が大きく残されています。

当チームの働き方には3つの特徴があります。1人が担当出版社のオーナーとして意思決定を任されること、議論の土台を感覚ではなくデータに置くこと、そして担当や職種の境界を越えて互いに助け合うことです。

紙書籍という、当たり前に存在するように見えて実は大きな課題を抱えるビジネスを、持続可能なかたちで続けていくために、前向きな姿勢と強いオーナーシップ、そしてチームワークをもって取り組んでいます。

About the Books organization

We believe reading is essential for a healthy society. Our mission is to inspire readers by making it easy to read more and to get more out of reading.

The mission of the Strategic Supply Chain Management team, where this role sits, is to deliver the books our customers want, at the time they want them: the right products, in the right quantities, in the right place, at the right time.

Japan's print book supply chain is at a turning point. Structural problems are growing that incremental improvement alone will not solve, and a shared view is forming across the industry that significant change is needed. That also means there is no shortage of opportunity to improve things for customers. In particular, much room remains to use technology such as AI models to automate work across supply chain and inventory management, and to raise what we deliver to customers.

Three things define how our team works. Each of us owns the decisions for our own publishers. We put data, not instinct, at the base of our discussions. And we help each other across the boundaries of assignments and job families.

This is work that takes a business most people assume will always be there, but which in fact faces real structural challenges, and turns it into something sustainable. We are looking for someone who will take that on with a positive outlook, strong ownership, and teamwork.

Basic qualifications

・工学、ビジネス、または関連分野における学士号
・2年以上の社会人経験
・日本語が母国語、もしくは、JPLTN1 / N2 ビジネスレベルの英語
・基礎的なOffice操作 (Excelによる分析、Powerpointによるスライド作成、Wordによるドキュメント作成）
・KPIなどのメトリック作成・改善の経験、および、生データからインサイトを抽出する分析力

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business or related field
- 2+ years of professional non-internship experience.
- Native Japanese or JPLT N1/N2 and business level English required
- Basic capability for MS Office (analysis using Excel, slide creation using Powerpoint, document creation using Word)
- Experience with reporting technologies and analytics. Capable of turning raw data into information and insights

Preferred qualifications

・4年以上の社会人経験
・事業会社における経営企画/サプライチェーン関連の業務経験又はコンサルティング会社におけるアナリスト/コンサルタント経験
・出版業界における経営企画/サプライチェーン関連又は営業に関連する経験
・優れた意思決定力、書面および口頭でのコミュニケーション力、実践的で常識的なアプローチに基づく実行力
・優れた分析能力と問題解決能力。 大規模で複雑なデータを処理する能力と、統計学またはその他の分析手法に精通している
・優先順位付け、スケジュール管理、時間管理、期限の遵守などの優れた実行力
・カイゼン、リーン生産方式、シックスシグマなどのプロセス改善の経験

- 4+ years of professional non-internship experience.
- Job experience for business planning/supply chain-related field or analyst/consultant experience at a consulting firm
- Job experience for business planning/supply chain-related field or sales experience in the publishing industry
- Possess excellent business judgment, strong written and oral communication skills, and a practical, common sense approach to getting things done.
- Strong analytical abilities and problem solving skills. Ability to work with large, complex data sets and familiarity with statistics or other analytical techniques.
- Strong organizational skills including prioritizing, scheduling, time management and meeting deadlines.
- Experience with improvement techniques such as Kaizen, Lean Manufacturing or Six Sigma.

title: Principal, Executive Recruiter, Global Specialty Recruiting
descriptionHtml:
Few companies on earth move at Amazon's scale and speed, and few searches carry the weight of the ones you'll own here. Amazon is constantly reinventing itself, and the leaders who steer that reinvention don't come from a résumé database; they have to be found, understood, and won. That's where you come in.

We're looking for a Principal Executive Recruiter to help the business scale by identifying and landing exceptional leaders across a broad portfolio of executive roles -- both technical and non-technical. You'll own Director- and Vice President-level searches end to end, partnering directly with Amazon's most senior executives to shape the teams that will define the next decade of the business. There is no greater reward in search than watching a leader you placed go on to have a significant, lasting impact -- and here, that impact is felt by hundreds of millions of customers.

Key job responsibilities
The Principal Executive Recruiter owns Amazon's most complex, confidential, and consequential Director- and Vice President-level searches across a diverse portfolio of technical and non-technical roles. This leader operates as a strategic advisor to senior executives, a recognized authority on the external talent market, and a force multiplier who raises the bar for how Amazon identifies and attracts leadership talent. Responsibilities include:

* Serving as a trusted talent advisor to VP and SVP hiring leaders — shaping role definition, influencing org design and leadership bar, and guiding go/no-go and selection decisions on the highest-stakes searches.
* Setting the search strategy and market point of view for ambiguous, first-of-their-kind, or business-critical mandates where no clear talent pool exists.
* Developing deep, differentiated market intelligence on industries, competitors, and leadership talent — and translating it into insights that shape Amazon's hiring and org strategy.
* Building and sustaining long-term relationships with senior leaders in the external market, creating durable talent networks that Amazon can draw on over time.
* Personally engaging, assessing, and winning the most senior and hardest-to-reach candidates, representing Amazon credibly at the executive level.
* Raising the bar on the craft of executive search — introducing new approaches, assessment frameworks, and mechanisms that improve quality, speed, and judgment across the recruiting team.
* Mentoring and elevating other recruiters, and acting as an escalation point and thought leader on complex searches, offers, and negotiations.
* Partnering with executive leadership as a true strategic partner — providing candid counsel on talent, market realities, and the tradeoffs behind critical hiring decisions.

About the team
You will join Amazon's Executive Recruiting organization — a tight-knit team of seasoned search professionals who operate as trusted advisors to the company's most senior leaders. We function like a best-in-class retained search firm, but with the unique advantage of being on the inside: we know the business deeply, we live the Leadership Principles, and we are personally invested in the long-term success of every leader we hire.

Basic qualifications

- 10+ years of progressive corporate or search firm recruiting at executive level experience
- 5+ years of advising and influencing executive leadership experience
- 5+ years of advising and influencing leadership experience
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent

Preferred qualifications

- Demonstrated ability to work in team environments as both leader and collaborative member
- Data-driven approach to talent acquisition with ability to provide market intelligence and competitive insights

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

title: Sr. Prototyping Solutions Architect, AWS Specialists and Partner Prototyping Team
descriptionHtml:
Do you have a builder's mentality where "show me" means more than "tell me"? Are you passionate about technology, understand cloud architectures and platforms, and quick to pick up emerging technologies? Are you adept at working with customers to experiment with innovative approaches and validate the technical feasibility of solutions?

Core to Amazon's DNA is its methodology around executing experiments and prototypes to find the quickest way to prove new ideas, technologies, and business models in a real-world environment. This experimentation fuels Amazon's innovation.

Our team does horizon exploration. We take emerging technology, including our own inventions, build working prototypes with customers and partners, and demonstrate what becomes possible before the rest of the market gets there. Prototyping is how we do the work. Pushing the technology horizon is why we do it.

The role of the Prototyping Solutions Architect will apply these methods to assemble and build prototypes with leading customers around the world. You'll work closely with AWS Sales Teams and AWS Service Developers to partner with customers to solve hard problems. Engagements run in short build cycles, typically four to six weeks, and are designed to be innovative and evaluative, demonstrating the art of the possible on AWS while proving a credible path to production. AWS is seeking a senior technical professional with real world expertise and experience to join the AWS Specialist Prototyping team to support our rapidly growing and dynamic business.

Key job responsibilities
+ Work with AWS Prototyping engagement managers, solutions architects, customers, and partners to qualify and scope strategic prototyping use cases

+ Architect, design, develop and build working prototypes with customers

+ Extract best-practice knowledge, reference architectures, and patterns from engagements to promote re-use with the worldwide AWS community

+ Share insights and lessons learned with AWS Service teams to contribute to the continual improvement of AWS services based on Customer need

+ Develop and present detailed technical demonstrations and talks to Business and Technical leaders on 1:1 and 1:many/conference type situations

+ Position requires travel - generally around 25%

About the team
The mission of AWS Prototyping is to accelerate customer adoption of AWS, expedite their path to production, and catalyze a culture of innovation.

Prototyping at AWS helps customers envision complex uses of AWS Services by building working prototypes of specific customer use cases, tailored to their data, devices and systems. Prototyping engagements are designed to be innovative and evaluative, demonstrating "the art of the possible" on AWS.

You will build across the areas where we are placing our biggest bets. These shift as the technology does, but today they include:

- Physical AI and autonomous robotics. World models, vision-language-action (VLA) models, cloud-based and agentic VLA, real-to-sim and sim-to-real pipelines, and agentic control of physical systems.

- Autonomous scientific discovery. Self-driving labs and instrument intelligence, where agents plan, run, and interpret experiments across fleets of scientific instruments.

- Agentic developer intelligence. Multi-agent systems, code agents, and automated research workflows that change how software and science get built.

- Scaling what we learn. Turning one-off prototypes into reusable patterns and assets the broader field can pick up and run with.


You will not just apply these techniques. You will help prove or disprove new bets in the open, with real customer problems and working code.

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Basic qualifications

- 6+ years of design, implementation, or consulting in applications and infrastructures experience
- 6+ years of specific technology domain areas (e.g. software development, cloud computing, systems engineering, infrastructure, security, networking, data & analytics) experience
- Experience with presentations and speaking with executives, IT, management, and developers
- Experience architecting/operating solutions built on any cloud service provider like Azure, AWS, GCP, OCI, etc.
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, a related field, or equivalent experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience presenting to both technical and non-technical executive audiences
- Experience writing technical articles, speaking at technology conferences, and contributing to open source
- Experience building prototypes, proofs of concept, or minimum viable products under tight timelines.
- Hands-on depth in one or more emerging technology areas such as AI and machine learning, data, IoT and edge, or robotics.
- Comfortable learning new services and tools quickly, and willing to travel approximately 25%.

title: Graduate Area/Shift Manager - Veneto
descriptionHtml:
When you join Amazon as an Area/Shift Manager, you’ll gain experience leading a large and diverse team to make sure your area of the business keeps pace with demand. In this hands-on role, you’ll learn about the complexity of operations at a global business and what it takes to make everything run seamlessly. While you implement your team’s approach to drive productivity, you’ll also work closely with your colleagues to address challenges, which means no two days will be the same.

Key job responsibilities
