title: Software Development Manager, AWS Vulnerability Management - Automated Remediation, AWS Vulnerability Management
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon Web Services (AWS), Security is our highest priority. The AWS Security team is responsible for the security of services offered by AWS. The AWS Vulnerability Management team is responsible for driving innovative enhancements that raise the bar for how Amazon Builders discover, prioritize, and remediate vulnerabilities across their resources, systems, and data. At AWS' scale, we must invent new security capabilities that let Builders move fast while vulnerabilities are resolved quickly, with minimal manual effort.

The successful candidate loves working with engineering and business teams across the AWS Security organization to understand their needs, and partners with software and security engineers to design and build the automation that makes remediation effortless for Builders. You are passionate about eliminating manual toil and you want to solve real security problems at scale. You think in terms of capabilities that detect, decide, and act, so that the work in front of a Builder shrinks to a single click or disappears entirely.

As a Software Development Manager you will own the capabilities that power touchless remediation for Amazon Builders: the strategy, the goals, the requirements, and the mechanisms that deliver them. You will own the systems that apply AI and automated response actions at machine speed, closing the gap between detection and resolution so that Builders can remediate in minutes rather than days or weeks. You will partner with Engineering, TPMs, and cross-functional teams to equip Builders across the organization with automation that reduces their security work to the smallest possible action. You will own the delivery of industry-leading capabilities that combine descriptive and predictive analytics with security engineering, automating the complex work behind remediation and producing insights for our Builders and our customers.

One of the central challenges you will own is continuing to transform vulnerability remediation so that time to remediation drops to minutes. You will push the boundaries of what automation can do, building capabilities that generate ready-to-ship fixes, safely apply automated response actions at machine speed, and progressively expand the scope of findings that can be resolved with little or no manual effort, all while holding the safety, correctness, and trust bar that Amazon's scale demands. Builders stay accountable for their resources, but the capabilities you own make resolving a finding fast, safe, and nearly effortless.

You will need a deeply analytical and systems architecture mindset with the ability to tackle complex and ambiguous challenges and effectively influence stakeholders across the AWS Security organization. This is a high-impact and high-visibility role that requires not only strategic vision and inventing on behalf of customers, but also strong execution, technical depth, analytical rigor, and excellent communication.

Key job responsibilities
Own and build a best-in-class engineering team that delivers excellent results through rapid iterations

Own the design and development of state-of-the-art capabilities for touchless remediation, applying AI and automated response actions at machine speed

Own the capabilities that bring time to remediation down to minutes, continuing to transform remediation into safe, automated mechanisms Builders can trust

Own engineering and operational excellence through metrics and continuous learning

Own the long-term strategy for your programs and translate it into a roadmap and action plan

Report on the status of development, quality, operations, and system performance to management

Mentor and grow high-performing SDEs and security engineers to take on increasingly higher responsibilities

A day in the life
A high-severity vulnerability surfaces across thousands of Builder-owned resources, and the capabilities your team owns go to work before anyone opens a ticket. You watch the automation detect, decide, and act: generating validated fixes, applying automated response actions at machine speed, and resolving findings in minutes. By the time your coffee is cold, most of them are already closed, and you are digging into the handful that need a human eye.

Later you are working with an AWS engineering team that wants to bring a new class of findings into automated remediation. You have already mapped how a fix could go wrong at scale, so you set the safety and correctness bar the automation has to clear before it can act on a Builder's behalf. In the afternoon you throw a simulated failure at the detection-to-remediation automation, find the gap it misses, prove it, and hand a validated design to an SDE to close it.

About the team
Amazon Security values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of engineering team management experience
- 5+ years of Software Engineer, Software Developer, or related occupational experience
- 8+ years of providing technical leadership and project management for all aspects of the software development lifecycle experience
- Knowledge of engineering practices and patterns for the full software/hardware/networks development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, certification, and livesite operations
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in communicating with users, other technical teams, and senior leadership to collect requirements, describe software product features, technical designs, and product strategy
- 2+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
- 1+ years of developing large-scale, multi-tiered distributed software systems using service-oriented architecture experience

title: Delivery Station Customer Service Associate
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company. To achieve this goal, we strive to exceed expectations by innovating and providing best-in-class customer support as we expand our logistics products and services including improving how we fulfill and deliver customer orders. We’re making history and the good news is that we’ve only just begun. At Amazon you get to work with smart, passionate people who are building new products and services every day on behalf of our customers.

As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will help improve the customer experience by providing in station real-time, hands-on support to ensure our customers receive their packages on time, as promised. The role will also help connect
customers with experts who can provide them the most accurate and up-to-date information about their packages. The work is beyond fulfilling and delivering customer orders; it’s making sure we put smiles on customer’s faces.

Key job responsibilities
As a Delivery Station Customer Service Associate, you will be responsible for:
• Communicating with customers directly in-person, in addition to communicating via phone and email
• Empathizing with and prioritizing customer needs
• Upholding company values and respecting every customer
• Resolving issues and setting appropriate expectations with customers
• Clearly understanding and responding appropriately to the issues that customers present
• Consistently composing grammatically correct, concise, and accurate written responses to customer issues
• Approaching problems logically and with good judgment to ensure the appropriate customer outcome
• Making quick and effective decisions on behalf of the customer
• Working a flexible Full-Time (40+ hours per week) schedule

Performing the following tasks, with or without reasonable accommodation:
• Carry, lift, push and pull up to 49 pounds
• Frequently push, pull, squat, bend and reach
• Stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours
• Work in an environment where the noise level varies and can be loud (hearing protection will be provided)
• Work in an environment where the temperature may vary due to outside weather conditions and is not controlled

A day in the life
You’ll be based at one of our last-mile delivery warehouses, where Amazon’s leading logistics system operates. As orders are dispatched and
delivered, you’ll be in contact with our warehouse, associates, delivery partners and customers when they need guidance. Where a customer needs to reschedule a delivery, you’ll be informing our delivery partners. Where you notice a delivery issue, you’ll get to work resolving it straight away, so that our customers get a great experience every time without having to contact Amazon.

Operating at the heart of Amazon’s logistics, you’ll develop logistical and customer expertise that sets Amazon apart. You’ll connect with our
customers every day, using your in-depth understanding of our supply chain and local knowledge of delivery connections and warehouses.

About the team
Our mission is to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, and few departments have as direct an impact on that mission as our Customer Service team. We're an inclusive team who empower and look after our people, so they have the time and energy to focus on our customers’ happiness. Our goal is to reduce customer effort every way we can, helping them get the best results quickly and efficiently. We support our self-service channels to offer expert insights into our customers’ most complex issues.
Within Customer Service, there are opportunities in process improvement, customer experience, data analysis and customer retention. The CS team is always looking for ways to make Amazon’s customer service even better, and we need excellent people to make that happen.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Experience in Customer Service
- Experience working with computers and Microsoft Office (including Outlook, Word, and Excel)
- Experience prioritizing and managing time effectively in dynamic environments
- Familiarity with multiple web browsers, data base searching and instant messenger tools

Preferred qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience in understanding performance metrics and developing them to measure progress against key performance indicators
- Experience with written and verbal communication and presentation
- Experience working on a merchandising/brand ambassador team for a nationally recognized consumer brand

title: Technical Program Manager III - Edge Connectivity Services, Edge Connectivity
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a Senior Technical Program Manager to own and drive AWS region expansion programs across the AWS Mission Networking family of services. You will enable dedicated network connectivity options for our U.S. National Security and Department of War customers to AWS Classified regions. You will also work with Defense Industrial Base (DIB) customers to support and expand Amazon's new launched AWS Secret Cloud for Industry (ASCI) service which enables dedicated connectivity to the AWS Secret Region for industry partners. You will build mechanisms and processes to automate and streamline the customer experience, working across AWS engineering, networking, and security teams to simplify access to the AWS classified (Secret and Top Secret) regions.

Are you energized by solving complex technical challenges that span multiple teams and systems? Do you thrive when turning ambiguity into clear plans and measurable outcomes? Amazon is looking for a Technical Program Manager to own and drive cross-functional programs that have considerable business impact. In this role, you will define program strategy, align stakeholders across engineering and business teams, and deliver results at scale. You will use your technical depth to question assumptions, assess architectural decisions, and ensure the right solutions ship on time. If you are a collaborative, data-driven problem solver who communicates with clarity and builds trust across all levels, we want to hear from you.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
- Define and manage the lifecycle of complex cross-functional programs, setting clear objectives, success criteria, and roadmaps that align with organizational goals.
- Drive alignment across business and technical stakeholders by facilitating crisp decision-making, providing context for technology choices, and prioritizing initiatives based on customer and business impact.
- Identify and mitigate risks proactively by overseeing gaps between teams, processes, and system architectures, reducing exposure to common failure modes such as unclear requirements or insufficient testing.
- Leverage your technical judgment to evaluate proposals, test assumptions, and make smart trade-offs between time, effort, and feature scope while partnering with engineering leaders to ensure solutions scale appropriately.
- Communicate program progress and outcomes effectively through written narratives and executive presentations, building consensus when perspectives differ and escalating with good judgment when needed.
- Partner with Business, Product, and Technology Leaders and teams to deliver value for our customers
- Drive visibility and transparency of dates, milestones, and schedule throughout the customer onboarding process
- Build inclusive relationships with partner groups in AWS Region Services, Networking and the World Wide Public Sector teams. Ensuring that these teams focus on our customers and support customer missions.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing program metrics and identifying areas that need attention before joining a cross-team sync to unblock a critical dependency. By midafternoon, you could be drafting a narrative that frames a key trade-off for senior leadership, then pivoting to a design review where you pressure-test architectural assumptions with engineers. You will regularly connect with stakeholders across the organization, ensuring priorities stay aligned and your program delivers meaningful results.

About the team
Our team is focused on building and improving the technology systems that power Amazon's operations at global scale. We value collaboration, clear communication, and a willingness to tackle hard problems together. You will work alongside engineers, product managers, and business leaders who are committed to delivering impactful solutions for our customers. We are investing in new capabilities and looking for a program leader who is excited to help shape our technical direction in the years ahead.

- Current, active TS/SCI US Government Security Clearance

Amazon Leo is building a global e-commerce experience for Internet Service Provider (ISP) customers, and we need a Front End Engineer II to help us do it. You will work with React and Next.js to design, build, and ship features that serve customers worldwide. Many of these experiences are built from zero-to-one, so you will regularly move from ambiguous problem to working product. You will own the full software development lifecycle, collaborating with product, marketing, business, and backend engineering partners to deliver accessible, performant interfaces. If you enjoy working with AI-driven development workflows, picking up new frameworks quickly, and turning complex requirements into clean user experiences, this is the role for you.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
- Design and build front-end features for the Amazon Leo e-commerce platform using React and Next.js, taking projects from concept through deployment and ongoing operation.
- Collaborate with product managers, UX designers, marketing, and backend commerce service teams to translate customer and business needs into accessible, scalable solutions that work across devices and browsers.
- Leverage agentic development workflows and generative AI tools to accelerate feature delivery, and identify opportunities to improve infrastructure using AWS native services.
- Participate actively in code reviews, providing constructive feedback to teammates while coaching others on front-end best practices, UI design patterns, and maintainable coding standards.
- Write clear documentation for your team's software and train new team members on how it is constructed, tested, and operated.

A day in the life
You might start your morning reviewing a pull request from a teammate, suggesting improvements to a React component's accessibility and performance. After standup, you pick up a new feature that doesn't have a clear precedent yet, sketching out an approach with your product manager before writing code. In the afternoon, you pair with a designer to refine interaction details for an upcoming launch, then dig into an operational metric that looks off, tracing it to a rendering edge case you fix before it reaches customers.

About the team
We are part of the Leo Commerce engineering organization at Amazon, building the e-commerce experience for a global ISP customer base. Our team works closely with backend commerce services, product, marketing, and business partners to launch new experiences from scratch. We are scaling the team and investing in AI-based development and operational workflows to meet the growing needs of our customers. If you are looking for a place where you can grow your expertise by tackling new problems regularly alongside an inclusive group of engineers, we would be glad to have you.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of non-internship professional front end, web or mobile software development using JavaScript, HTML and CSS experience
- 1+ years of computer science fundamentals (object-oriented design, data structures, algorithm design, problem solving and complexity analysis) experience
- Experience using JavaScript frameworks such as angular and react

Preferred qualifications

- 1+ years of agile software development methodology experience
- Experience with common front-end technologies such as HTML, CSS, JS, TypeScript, and Node

descriptionHtml:
This permanent, full-time position is located in Pflugerville, TX
Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!
About the Role:

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Apprentice (MRA), you will learn to combine electronic, mechanical, computer and automation engineering skills at the workplace. During on-the-job learning (OJL) you will work with complex high-performance manufacturing systems and will learn to analyze, troubleshoot, and repair systems to maintain process efficiency. The focus of your role will be to learn the skills and abilities to ensure safety regulations and policies are adhered to, assist in the installation, maintenance, and repair of the automated packaging and distribution equipment, ensure preventative maintenance is conducted on time to a high standard, and provide high levels of equipment availability through continuous improvement.

You will be paired with journey workers to carry out their work at various facilities, including high automation and robotics facilities in connection with service operations. You will be expected to complete work based on technical documents and instructions and carry out your work in compliance with the relevant provisions and safety regulations.

You should be an effective communicator, work well in a team, and be self-motivated. You must have the ability to work collaboratively and coordinate your activities with upstream and downstream operations partners. In addition to developing your skills, you will be mentored by senior technicians to grow in your role.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
• You will perform preventative/predictive maintenance of conveyance equipment using the appropriate job plans, procedures, and manuals.

• You will conduct maintenance and basic troubleshooting of robotics and robotic work cells.

- Experience troubleshooting and repairing operational items
- Knowledge of mathematics
- Experience experience using data and metrics to measure impact and determine improvements
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays

title: Senior Controls System Engineer
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking Controls Systems Engineer to work on the design, programming, commissioning, and sustained operation of controls and automation systems across our manufacturing environment. This is a technical, individual-contributor role: you will architect and program PLC systems, build SCADA/HMI applications, integrate industrial robots and automation cells, and serve as the technical authority for controls integration across the MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA layers.

Working in a fast-paced manufacturing setting, you will operate with high autonomy and a strong bias for action—diving deep into PLC programming, SCADA system design, and controls architecture while ensuring daily production reliability, safety, and performance. Your scope spans pilot operations through high-volume production across diverse processes and lines. You thrive on the practical challenges of the factory floor—troubleshooting live equipment, improving cycle time and uptime, and turning a pilot line into a repeatable, high-yield production system.

Key job responsibilities
Controls Design & Development
- Design and program PLC architecture (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000/ControlLogix), define programming standards, and develop controls design specifications for a scalable framework spanning pilot through high-volume production.
- Enforce controls standards (hardware, software, networking); review and validate that system integrators and vendors deliver in strict compliance.
- Design, deploy, and maintain the SCADA/HMI layer (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, WinCC), providing real-time visibility into line performance, alarms, and production data.
- Implement automation and robot integration (e.g., Fanuc, KUKA, ABB) across assembly and automation cells, ensuring standardized programming, safety compliance, and maintainability.
- Develop functional safety designs (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and apply equipment safety standards for all automated systems, ensuring compliance with industry regulations and Amazon safety requirements.

MES & Systems Integration
- Implement MES integration at the controls layer, bridging MES, ERP, WMS, QMS, PLC, and SCADA systems to ensure seamless data flow from the shop floor to enterprise systems.
- Partner with the Factory Software team on system architecture, data models, and integration—defining clear interface boundaries and supporting coordinated deployment.
- Build traceability, genealogy, and quality data capture at the controls layer to support analytics, yield improvement, and regulatory compliance.
- Apply standards for connectivity protocols (OPC-UA, EtherNet/IP, PROFINET), data historians, and reporting infrastructure that enable data-driven decision making.

Line Deployment, Commissioning & Ramp
- Own the controls engineering scope for line deployment: design review, vendor coordination, FAT, SAT, commissioning, and ramp to high-volume production.
- Coordinate system integrator relationships: define specifications, conduct design reviews, verify adherence to controls standards, and drive issue resolution.
- Lead troubleshooting, optimization, cycle-time improvement, and reliability growth through production ramp to steady-state operations.
- Collaborate with Operations, Process Engineering, and Quality teams to ensure controls solutions meet operational and production requirements.
- Drive root cause analysis on system failures; implement countermeasures and preventive mechanisms to improve reliability and uptime (MTTR/MTBF).
- Develop commissioning playbooks, validation protocols, and startup checklists that enable repeatable, rapid line launches.

Technical Excellence & Sustained Operations
- Support 24/7 production through on-call participation and escalation, diving deep on the factory floor to restore and improve automated systems.
- Create and maintain knowledge management resources, troubleshooting databases, and continuous-improvement mechanisms for controls reliability.
- Own technical documentation for electrical and control systems.

Basic qualifications

- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience with Linux/Unix
- Experience with CI/CD pipelines build processes
- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience with advanced automation controls systems
- Experience in a fast-paced, automated, industrial, logistics, production or manufacturing environment
- 4+ years of hands-on experience in controls engineering, industrial automation, or related disciplines.
- Experience designing and programming PLC architecture (Siemens TIA Portal and/or Rockwell Studio 5000/ControlLogix).
- Experience with SCADA/HMI system design, deployment, and management (e.g., Ignition, FactoryTalk, WinCC).
- Experience coordinating with system integrators and verifying vendor compliance with controls standards.
- Working knowledge of MES architecture and integration with ERP, WMS, QMS, and shop-floor systems.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with distributed systems at scale
- 6+ years of industrial controls and automation experience
- Experience with industrial robotics
- Experience in automotive, aerospace, battery/energy, or other advanced production environments at scale
- Experience building controls standards and architecture from scratch for a new line or organization
- Knowledge of industrial networking (EtherNet/IP, PROFINET, OPC-UA), OT cybersecurity, IT/OT convergence, data historians, and production analytics
- Experience in high-mix or evolving product environments where controls systems must adapt to frequent design changes
- Familiarity with safety system design (SafetyPLC, safety-rated networks) and compliance with relevant standards (IEC 62443, NFPA 79, ISO 13849)
- Master’s degree in Engineering
- Track record of delivering results in fast-paced, high-growth manufacturing environments with strong ownership and bias for action

title: Segmentation Analyst, SMGS Ops - Sales Planning and Compensation
descriptionHtml:
We are looking for a customer-obsessed Segmentation Analyst to join a dynamic team that is responsible for the timely and effective resolution of customer issues and questions related to sales planning cycles and revenue routing corrections. In this role, the Segmentation Analyst will triage and resolve inbound customer tickets and execute on monthly operational processes to support key data hygiene initiatives. The role demands the Segmentation Analyst exhibit customer obsession by truly understanding what customers are trying to accomplish, bias for action in order to answer and complete customer tickets in a timely manner, and earn trust by not just effectively completing requests in tickets, but also in upholding processes and policy related to actioning tickets.

A Segmentation Analyst engages with a wide range of roles and levels within the SMGS organization including Field Sales Operations (FSOs), Territory Managers (TMs), Account Managers (AMs) as well as SMGS Ops resources in the Revenue, Atlas, and Planning Tools teams. A successful candidate will demonstrate effective communication skills to ensure they understand the request, can question to clarify, and smoothly hand off an issue to another team if required. They will be responsible for upholding sales planning policy, which means they must insist on the highest standards for submissions (i.e., gathering all relevant information and approvals).

The Segmentation Analyst may also engage in project-based work to support initiatives specific to SegOps and the broader SPC team. These could include process improvements and documentation for SegOps Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) or developing metrics and analytics for SegOps processes, as well as supporting the planning and execution of key planning phases or activities.

Key job responsibilities
- Complete customer tickets on time and accurately
- Execute monthly data hygiene activities as assigned on time and accurately
- Own project-based work relating to operational excellence and/or the overall planning process
- Provide operational support to SPC program, policy, and enablement teams
- Effectively engage with other support resources across SMGS Ops and within stakeholder Business Units (BUs) on the timely execution of customer inquiries

A day in the life

Your morning starts by preparing for the team sync and organizing your day. That looks like triaging inbound tickets, then digging in to resolve customer questions on sales planning, revenue routing, and more. You partner with many groups, roles, and stakeholders to clarify requests and move them forward. title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.


Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.

Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of electrical facilities maintenance, or 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- Associate's degree in related field, or technical degree in related field

descriptionHtml:

Amazon Web Services(AWS)のProfessional Servicesでは、企業のオンプレミス環境上にある大規模なワークロードをAWSへの移行を支援し、これらのシステムをモダナイズすることで、お客様のデジタルトランスフォーメーションをより俊敏かつ弾力的な加速の実現をリードする Engagement Managerを募集しています。

Key job responsibilities

A day in the life
お客様に対してチームで対応するなど体制に柔軟性があり、コアなしフレックス制度やリモートワークも活用し、柔軟でライフステージに合った働きやすい環境が整っております。

title: Senior Global Supply Manager
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS ISCaP ASC (Amazon Subtier Components) team is seeking for a results-oriented Senior Global Supply Manager to own supply management for EE/Interconnect components that go into server racks for our global datacenter network. The role will manage internal stakeholders as well as supplier relationships to ensure support on continuity of supply, lifecycle management, key programs, process improvement, contracts, and technical needs. The ideal candidate will deliver operational excellence with a focus on hardware demand/supply optimization. This individual must be a high energy, high impact individual with demonstrated ability to succeed in a dynamic business environment. Successful candidates will build long lasting, strategic partnerships, be well organized with strong communication skills to position themselves and AWS for continued success. The ideal candidate will raise the bar on driving schedules and deep diving into data, actively participates with a strong curiosity to understand the business end-to-end, and has a track record of delivering strong results.

This role leads supply management for interconnect or EE components. The ideal candidate will deliver operational excellence with a focus on hardware demand/supply optimization. This individual must be a high-energy, high-impact individual with demonstrated ability to succeed in a dynamic business environment.

Key job responsibilities
1. Clear-to-Build (CTB) & Shortage Resolution Own and drive CTB tracking for critical components; lead shortage resolution by identifying root causes, developing mitigation plans, and coordinating across multi-tier suppliers and internal stakeholders to unblock production; engage suppliers to expedite, reallocate, or pull-in supply to close gaps; validate demand signals and communicate risk exposure and recovery plans to leadership with clarity and urgency.

2. Inventory & Buffer Strategy Design and manage supply buffer strategies (safety stock, strategic inventory, VMI) to build resiliency without driving excess; define buffer targets based on lead time variability, demand volatility, and supply risk profiles; manage allocation of on-hand and in-transit inventory to highest-priority demands across VMI sites; monitor inventory health metrics (WOS and excess/obsolescence) and partner with Finance and Operations to align buffer investment with business risk tolerance and cost targets.

3. Spot Market Buy Identify and evaluate spot market opportunities to bridge supply gaps; maintain a vetted network of authorized brokers and enforce compliance with quality and authenticity standards; lead spot buy negotiations for competitive pricing while managing counterfeit risk; define governance processes including approval thresholds and traceability requirements; track cost premiums and risk exposure while analyzing market dynamics to proactively position before shortages materialize.

4. Lead Time Reduction Analyze end-to-end lead time drivers — including raw material pre-positioning, line balance, and manufacturing process optimization — to structurally reduce effective lead times; hub/consignment arrangements;

5. Travel Up to 50% on site in suppliers’ international locations.

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

title: Senior Security Engineer, Customer Service Security
descriptionHtml:
Want to change how security works at Amazon scale? Customer Service Application Security protects customer data for one of Amazon's largest businesses, and we're building intelligent automation that makes security a built-in part of how teams ship.

As a Senior Security Engineer, you'll be the embedded security lead on our biggest, most complex initiatives. You'll work with engineering teams from first design to launch, owning security assurance through threat modeling, security investigations and control testing. You'll give teams and leaders confidence that what they ship is secure. Then you'll go further, turning key findings into guardrails, paved paths and automation that eliminate whole classes of vulnerabilities across the business unit, so builders get secure systems by default.

This is a senior role with real influence. You'll take on problems with no playbook, where the business goal is clear but the technical strategy isn't, and you'll define the approach. You'll set the technical bar by reviewing other security engineers' and SDEs' designs and code to make sure they're secure, extensible and easy to adopt. You'll lead high-stakes escalations to closure with senior managers and principal engineers. You'll strengthen how teams operate, from alarms and runbooks to COEs.

Your impact will go beyond code. You'll champion secure coding standards, improve processes and build a security culture across development teams. You'll help shape the team's long-term strategy, mentor engineers and hire the people who grow this team.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the senior security engineer on large, complex initiatives across Customer Service. Own security assurance from ideation through launch and give teams and leaders confidence that what they ship protects customer data.
- Lead the design of automated security guardrails, paved paths and secure-by-default patterns that remove classes of vulnerabilities across the business unit, and set the technical direction other engineers build on.
- Take on ambiguous security problems where the business direction is clear but the technical strategy is not.
- Drive the shift from manual, point-in-time reviews to continuous security assurance by designing preventive and detective controls and automated assessment that work at scale
- Review the designs, code and tooling of security engineers and SDEs to make sure they fit the bigger picture and are well secured, extensible, efficient and easy for developers to adopt
- Improve security beyond technology by championing secure coding standards, building training, improving processes and strengthening security culture across development teams
- Help define and drive the team's long-term security strategy with security and engineering stakeholders, informed by research into emerging threats and new techniques
- Grow the team by mentoring engineers, taking part in hiring and interviews, and giving career guidance

A day in the life
As a Senior Security Engineer, you're the embedded security lead on Customer Service's most complex initiatives. Your morning might start with shaping the threat model for a major new service, then reviewing a teammate's guardrail design to make sure it scales and is easy to adopt. Later, you're turning a recurring finding into a paved path that removes the issue across the business unit, or leading an escalation to closure with senior leaders. You'll end the day mentoring an engineer or interviewing a candidate. Every day, you're setting the direction for how security is built into how teams ship.

About the team
Customer Service Application Security protects customer data for one of Amazon's largest internal business units. We're reimagining how security integrates with development, building intelligent automation that keeps customers safe while accelerating delivery.

We're a collaborative team of security engineers, Technical Program Managers, and SDEs who move fast, value ownership, and invest heavily in each other's growth. We bridge the gap between security and engineering by championing secure coding standards, building tools that reduce friction for developers, and embedding security early through guardrails and paved paths. We stay ahead through continuous research into emerging threats and new techniques and best practices.

Diverse Experiences

If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why Amazon Security?
At Amazon, security is central to maintaining customer trust and delivering delightful customer experiences. Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon’s products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations, and physical stores.

Inclusive Team Culture
In Amazon Security, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Ongoing DEI events and learning experiences inspire us to continue learning and to embrace our uniqueness. Addressing the toughest security challenges requires that we seek out and celebrate a diversity of ideas, perspectives, and voices.

Training & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, training, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

- Experience working in identifying security issues and risks, and developing mitigation plans

descriptionHtml:

The Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) team are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it happen. We drive continuous improvement, and maintain all of the robotics and material handling equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role:
As an Automation Engineer, you will play a crucial role in maximizing equipment reliability and operational performance in our fulfillment centers by providing proactive controls automation and technical support. Your expertise will be essential in troubleshooting complex control systems, analyzing performance metrics, and driving continuous improvement initiatives. You'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to optimize material handling equipment (MHE) systems and implement innovative projects. You'll work with state-of-the-art technology, including conveyors, sortation systems, scanners, cameras, print and apply systems, and SCADA devices and programs. Through your efforts, you'll directly contribute to ensuring our customers receive their orders with Amazon's signature speed and accuracy.

What Do We Offer?
Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there’s more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!


Key job responsibilities

descriptionHtml:

The AWS Environmental team is an expanding and dynamic team that is critical to enabling AWS’s growth around the world, as well as ensuring compliance of AWS’s global operations, including physical data centers, as well as other AWS facilities, customer-facing enterprises and products. You will partner with AWS stakeholders to develop regional and site-specific development strategies enabling the construction and operation of AWS datacenters and infrastructure. The role primarily focuses on the Technical Program Management of integrating systems and devices and delivering turnkey deployable solutions to be delivered in the field.

In this role you will be responsible for working with internal customers to define highly ambiguous problem statements, influencing a global Amazon MHE sourcing and integration strategy, writing technical specifications and performing technical evaluations on equipment, generating multiyear budgets, driving project schedules from design to release, and managing multiple large, high visibility programs simultaneously through the project lifecycle.

This person will possess a strong engineering and program management background, will have demonstrated experience leading medium to large projects, and will have a well-rounded technical background in current MHE technologies and storage solutions. You must be able to thrive and succeed in an innovative environment, and not be hindered by ambiguity or competing priorities. This means you are not only able to develop and drive high-level strategic initiatives, but can also roll up your sleeves, dig in, and get the job done.

This role requires 50% regional travel and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.


Key job responsibilities
- Own multiple large, complex programs through the full development and deployment lifecycle — you are the accountable driver from concept through field delivery
- Partner with internal customers to define ambiguous problem statements and translate them into clear technical requirements and specifications
- Contribute to Amazon's MHE sourcing and integration strategy by evaluating vendor capabilities, performing technical assessments, and generating data-driven recommendations
- Understand product integration requirements across mechanical, electrical, and controls functions at a systems level
- Critique and debate technical designs, assess viability of proposed solutions, and help engineering teams make appropriate trade-offs considering business goals, throughput, quality, maintainability, and operability
- Drive project schedules from design through release, managing dependencies and risks across internal and external stakeholders
- Generate multiyear budgets and track program financials
- Identify engineering standards and drive consistent application of changes across North America
- Synthesize complex technical and business inputs into clear documentation and specifications
- Lead weekly Team Leads Sync meetings — facilitate agenda, surface hot topics, and track open action items
- Facilitate bi-weekly Team All Call meetings, coordinating topic shares across the team
- Compile and distribute bi-weekly Lookahead/Flash reports covering highlights, lowlights, key meetings, FAT testing schedules, and vendor POCs
- Manage monthly document reviews, ensuring working papers are reviewed internally before leadership submission
- Support quarterly business reviews by compiling executive summaries, sub-pillar updates, FAQs, and appendices
- Prepare quarterly Big Rocks updates for leadership review

descriptionHtml:

As a Site Procurement Manager for the Amazon Fulfillment Center team, you will serve as the bridge between centralized Procurement and the building leadership. You will own the site’s indirect procurement operation responsibilities at a site level, including vendor management of 3rd party service providers, purchase order management, and inventory management. - Reliably manages a large fleet of cloud-native OpenSearch clusters and collections, freeing customers from sizing, scaling, and patching decisions
- Guarantees high availability and durability for mission-critical search and observability workloads at the scale of the most demanding internet businesses
- Orchestrates and automates the complete lifecycle of an OpenSearch cluster or collection — from creation through scale-up, scale-out, upgrade, replication, and fail-over

The OpenSearch control plane is not just any distributed system. It orchestrates a fleet of clusters across every AWS region, detects and recovers from node failures in seconds, and serves workloads that span petabytes of customer data. Most recently, we launched **OpenSearch Serverless NextGen** — delivering ultra-fast collection provisioning and true scale-to-zero capacity, so customers pay only for what they use and get a working environment in seconds rather than minutes. We are not done; this is one of many investments raising the bar for what customers can expect from a managed search service.

OpenSearch itself is a community-driven, Apache 2.0–licensed open-source search and analytics suite built on Apache Lucene. Since launching in July 2021, the project has delivered multiple major and minor releases advancing core search, vector search, and analytics. Our next phase focuses on transforming OpenSearch into an intelligent retrieval engine — one that meets the evolving needs of customers running search, analytics, and AI-powered workloads across structured, unstructured, and multi-modal data.

We work in Java, Rust, Python, and Go. We contribute upstream to OpenSearch and Apache Lucene. We are customer-obsessed, operate with the entrepreneurial pace of a startup inside one of the world's largest cloud providers, and value strong intuition backed by metrics.

**Operations is core engineering on this team, not overhead.** Engineers operate what they build, and we treat customer-impacting incidents with the same engineering rigor we apply to feature work. Reliability and Static Stability is a forcing function for design, not a phase after launch.

Key job responsibilities
- Drive architectural decisions in a large-scale distributed system — multi-region orchestration workflows, multi-tenant control surfaces, lifecycle automation, scale-to-zero, regional failure isolation, and graceful degradation under partial outage
- Invent and Simplify in equal measure — drive simplification of legacy designs as actively as you propose new ones; identify and eliminate accidental complexity across the team's surfaces; mentor others on simplifying-by-design
- Treat operations as core engineering — own the systems you build end-to-end, lead incident response and RCAs with customer-first urgency, and drive operational improvements that compound across the team
- Lead design and development of complex services across cluster management, capacity orchestration, scaling policies, query routing, security, and machine learning
- Build and apply AI fluency across the software development lifecycle — decompose problems for AI assistance, ground prompts in relevant context, validate AI-generated output, and use AI to accelerate both code and beyond-code work
- Mentor and grow engineers across the team; raise the bar for software development, operational excellence, and security
- Set technical direction and partner with the broader OpenSearch organization to align solutions with customer needs and market opportunities

title: Sr. Software Dev Engineer, AWS EKS
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Services is looking for a Sr. Software Development Engineer to join our growing Amazon Elastic Container Services for Kubernetes (EKS) team. Amazon EKS is our managed Kubernetes service that makes it easy for customers to use Kubernetes without needing to become experts in provisioning and operating Kubernetes. EKS manages time-consuming administrative tasks like setting up, operating, scaling and updating Kubernetes, freeing customers up to focus on their applications.

The EKS Networking team builds the networking stack that connects customer workloads running on EKS clusters. We own the VPC CNI, which runs in the majority of EKS clusters worldwide, and an eBPF-based network policy enforcement path that replaced third-party dependencies with a native implementation. We are now building a service mesh, an Istio or Istio-like capability (traffic management, mTLS, policy, and observability) that avoids the per-pod sidecar tax by leaning on the kernel and the networking stack we already own. You will be joining a fast paced team working on greenfield projects, building the control plane for that mesh.

You will own the control plane: the system that turns customer intent (routing rules, policy, identity) into live configuration distributed to the data path across large clusters. You own service discovery, the config-distribution surface, and the mTLS identity and certificate-rotation story end to end. You will be solving challenging technical problems, often ones not solved before, alongside peers with remarkable technical expertise. The solutions you build will be high impact and rolled out to our large customer base across the world. If you are excited to work in a dynamic environment, we would love to hear from you!

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Design and build the control plane that distributes configuration to the mesh data path at scale, including the config-distribution protocol (xDS or equivalent) and its efficiency and convergence properties.
- Own service discovery and endpoint health across large, high-churn clusters, including on-demand lookup patterns for very large endpoint counts rather than replicating full state everywhere.
- Own the mTLS identity story: SPIFFE-style identity issuance, certificate rotation, trust domains, and Layer 4 authorization policy.
- Guarantee control-loop correctness: convergence, staleness bounds, caching, and graceful behavior under failure.
- Partner with the data path, kernel/eBPF, and protocols engineers whose subsystems consume the configuration you distribute.
- Raise the bar through design and code reviews, and mentor engineers on the team.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 5+ years of programming with at least one software programming language experience
- 5+ years of leading design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Experience as a mentor, tech lead or leading an engineering team

Preferred qualifications

- 5+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Imports Supply Chain Manager, Product Manager
descriptionHtml:

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. Amazon is one of the most recognizable brand names in the world and we distribute millions of products each year to our loyal customers.

Amazon has great opportunities to pursue a career as a leader in Operations Planning & Management. We know that learning through experience is what transforms talented people into great leaders. Our roles are designed to accelerate the growth of leaders through challenging field experiences that stretch individual capability. Our Operations environment presents the candidates with great challenges in dealing with front line management, and driving scalable and continuous improvements across our Fulfillment Centers, Supply Chain & Transportation execution teams.

As a Program Manager for the Direct Imports Program, you will be the subject matter expert in planning and orchestrating Direct Imports volume as it enters the MX network through FC Core. You will forecast and track import demand, run network connectivity and capacity analysis, run simulations and scenarios for leadership, and synchronize this inbound import flow with domestic supply and demand plans over the 13 week to 52 week horizon in order to meet our customer's needs.

Key job responsibilities
- Manage the short and medium term forecast, capacity and peak planning for Direct Imports volume entering the MX network through FC Core.
- Work in partnership with Global Logistics, Global Trade Services, and MX Operations teams to secure the best network connections and transportation choices for inbounding import units on time.
- Ensure Direct Imports program plans are accommodated within domestic network plans, balancing import flow against domestic inbound to protect receive capacity and on-time delivery goals.
- Define a near term vision and plan to deliver it, driving continuous improvement of the import inbound experience by collaborating with stakeholders on the design of new solutions that enhance business performance and achieve established quality and efficiency goals.
- Inspect import demand forecasts and capacity plans critically and challenge assumptions from Retail, S&OP, and business teams.
- Provide high quality inputs and garner alignment with finance, leadership, and cross-functional partners (Global Logistics, Global Trade Services, Amazon Transportation Services) using a combination of in-person meetings, well written data backed documents, detailed business models or presentations.

title: Compliance Analyst, Safety Monitoring, NAST Safety & Compliance , NAST Safety & Compliance
descriptionHtml:
Amazon's North American Surface Transportation Safety & Compliance team (NAST S&C) is looking for a Compliance Analyst to join Safety Monitoring. Safety Monitoring assesses carrier safety performance against Amazon's standards. We use FMCSA Safety Measurement System (SMS) data and Amazon's Violation Rate Metrics (VRM), and we take action when a carrier falls below the standard.
This role can be assigned to third-party (3P) carrier monitoring or to monitoring for Amazon's own fleet, Transportation Operations Management (TOM). The core work is the same in both. You will run recurring monitoring steps on a fixed schedule, pull and validate data, keep every case record current, and report results. The work follows written procedures and thresholds. Each result can drive an enforcement or safety action, so you will check the data before it moves. You will report to the Safety Monitoring manager and escalate anything that falls outside the procedure.


Key job responsibilities
All assignments
• Pull safety data from FMCSA SMS and internal sources on the monthly schedule.
• Validate records against source data before anything goes out. Reconcile the counts, spot-check individual records, and document what you checked.
• Keep SIM and Asana updated together so the current status of every case lives in one place.
• Prepare recurring metrics for business reviews, such as suspension and reinstatement counts, exception outcomes, inspection results, and cycle timeliness.
• Keep procedure documents current and recommend process improvements.
• Escalate data discrepancies, new types of cases, and anything with possible legal exposure.
3P carrier monitoring
• Prepare the monthly BASICs and VRM suspension and reinstatement lists against the written thresholds.
• Log carrier exception requests, build each case file against the written criteria, and present cases at the weekly exception review.
• Record every review decision as granted, denied, or pending final review.
• Submit suspension and reinstatement tickets to Carrier Health and confirm they were actioned.
• Send carrier notifications from approved templates after a decision is recorded. Answer carrier questions about their status against the standard, and route anything outside the templates to your manager.
• Monitor carriers under review each week for new violations, out-of-service events, and safety rating changes.
TOM fleet monitoring
• Run the same monitoring steps for Amazon's own fleet. Track roadside inspection results, out-of-service events, violations, and BASIC results for TOM.
• Report trends and open items to TOM safety and operations leaders on a set schedule.
• Flag changes that need attention, such as a rising violation rate or a new out-of-service event, to your manager and TOM safety leaders.
Basic qualifications
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent
• 2+ years of professional or military experience
• Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
• Experience analyzing data in Excel, including pivot tables and lookups
• Knowledge of SQL
Preferred qualifications
• Working knowledge of FMCSA regulations, the CSA program and BASICs, or roadside inspection and out-of-service criteria
• Experience supporting a motor carrier or fleet DOT safety program
• Experience working cases in a ticketing or case management system
• Experience writing to external business partners in a regulated setting
• Experience checking data across more than one system before acting on it

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required
- Are 18 years of age or older
- Experience using data to drive root cause elimination and process improvement

Preferred qualifications

descriptionHtml:
Power availability is no longer a background variable — it is the binding constraint on where and how fast Amazon can grow its real estate network. Amazon WWOps Real Estate is looking for a Senior Power Development Manager (TIPM) to own power due diligence, utility engagement, and infrastructure strategy across the industrial real estate portfolio. You will embed power intelligence upstream in the site selection process, build repeatable frameworks that replace bespoke assessments, and develop strategic utility relationships that support Amazon investment plans and capacity availability. You will define how power development operates at portfolio scale and shift it from a reactive bottleneck into a proactive input that accelerates network delivery. Along the way, you will build a rare skill set that spans grid economics, real estate development, and capital strategy — a combination that is increasingly sought after across industrial infrastructure.

Key job responsibilities
- Own portfolio-wide power due diligence — load letter requests, substation capacity analysis, service territory research, and interconnection feasibility — to make power intelligence a scalable input to site selection.
- Build and maintain strategic utility relationships across priority markets, moving from transactional inquiries to partnerships that provide advance visibility into grid investment plans and capacity availability.
- Evaluate upstream infrastructure constraints such as interconnection lead times, feeder loading, transformer capacity, and distribution upgrade requirements to identify and de-risk capacity-constrained sites early in the pipeline.
- Translate complex utility and grid data into real estate economics, delivery timelines, and investment decisions for stakeholders across real estate, engineering, operations, design and construction, and transactions.
- Design repeatable processes, templates, and market intelligence tools that standardize power development across the portfolio and reduce assessment cycle time.

A day in the life
Your week alternates between external utility engagement and internal cross-functional coordination, with heads-down analytical work filling the gaps. One morning you might be on a call with a utility interconnection team negotiating service timelines for a capacity-constrained market; that afternoon you are presenting a portfolio-level power risk summary to directors across real estate and operations. Between meetings, you are interpreting substation data, modeling interconnection feasibility, or building the trackers and templates that make the next site evaluation faster. The cadence is deal-driven and portfolio-driven, with no sprint ceremonies or ticket queues. You operate with high autonomy as the dedicated owner of power development, self-organizing across dozens of concurrent site inquiries and using your judgment daily to decide where your time creates the most portfolio impact.

About the team
Amazon's Global Realty Energy and Power team sits at the intersection of utility engineering, real estate development, and energy market strategy. We are changing how the company secures and delivers electrical infrastructure across one of the world's largest industrial real estate portfolios, moving from transactional utility engagement to strategic infrastructure positioning. Our work directly determines whether Amazon can secure the grid capacity it needs, when it needs it, in the markets that matter most. Growth on this team comes through direct leadership engagement — regular one-on-ones, real-time feedback on your work, and sponsorship into cross-functional forums where senior leaders see your contributions firsthand. The role is scoped as a launchpad: build the capability, prove the model, then grow into energy strategy leadership, real estate development management, infrastructure program leadership, or deeper technical specialization in power markets. If you want to build a new capability from the ground up and shape how Amazon approaches power development, we would like to hear from you.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of program management or technical project management experience
- Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Energy Systems, Power Engineering, or a related technical discipline
- Experience managing concurrent due diligence or project workstreams across a multi-site portfolio with competing priorities and aggressive timelines
- Experience in utility coordination, electrical infrastructure design, power development, or energy project delivery within large-scale utility, industrial, logistics, or data center environments
- Experience with utility easements, real property rights, and right-of-way documentation — including review, analysis, and coordination through resolution

Preferred qualifications

- Working knowledge of ISO/RTO market structures (PJM, ERCOT, CAISO, MISO, NYISO, ISO-NE, SPP) and their implications for large commercial load acquisition and utility procurement strategy
- Hands-on experience with load request and managing the demand/load side interconnection process
- Experience with utility rate structures, demand response programs, power purchase agreements, or energy procurement

descriptionHtml:
The Global Solutions and Risk Compliance (GSRC) organization is a component of Amazon's operations, dedicated to ensuring the compliance of its products and services worldwide. GSRC's core mission is to keep customers, partners, and associates safe while protecting the company from legal and regulatory risks. With a diverse global team spanning across India, China, Poland, Romania, Netherlands, Jordan, Philippines and Costa Rica, GSRC partners with its stakeholders to classify products and ensure regulatory and legal compliance for product listings. GSRC raises the bar on quality by implementing operational changes matching the everchanging regulatory space. The team designs global, consistent, and scalable solutions and prioritize a blend between technology-driven and human decision-making processes. GSRC believes that innovation thrives on diversity, fostering an inclusive and equitable culture that empowers employees with opportunities for learning and development.

Key job responsibilities

• Performs quality audits on a daily basis using Standard Operating Procedure (SOP) and achieves self-utilization, productivity and quality as per defined targets.
• Must be able to comprehend SOPs with minimal support and identify opportunities.

title: Sr. Manager - Technical Product Management , Alexa for Shopping (Rufus) Agentic AI
descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a Senior Product Leader to build agentic shopping experiences on Amazon. Alexa for Shopping (AFS), formerly Rufus, is Amazon's Shopping AI, a high-visibility generative AI investment within the Stores business built on large language models (LLMs). Our vision is for AFS to be an always-on personal shopping agent that learns what matters to each customer, anticipates their needs, and acts on their behalf. Beyond responding to requests, AFS will proactively recognize opportunities to help, suggest timely next steps, and follow through on goals that unfold over days, weeks, or months.

If you are passionate about reinventing e-commerce, helping customers offload tedious shopping tasks to smart, autonomous AI, and building a team that does the same, this is a rare opportunity to define the future of agentic commerce at Amazon.

In this role, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AFS's agentic portfolio. The portfolio spans customer-initiated automations such as price and deal alerts and replenishment, proactive experiences where AFS recognizes opportunities to help, long-running goals that AFS follows through over weeks or months, and the platform capabilities that let teams across Amazon Stores build agentic experiences. You will lead a team of PM-Ts, each owning a set of features. You will set the portfolio's goals, decide where to invest, and hold the team to a high bar on customer outcomes. Success means customers save time, money, and effort, trust AFS to act within their instructions, and engage more, with progress measured in customer value per action.

To get there, you will shape the priorities of AFS Engineering and Science teams, pairing a clear product vision with rigorous technical execution. You will partner with multiple Applied Science and Engineering organizations to push new frontiers and build experiences that state-of-the-art models only now make possible. You will make data-driven portfolio decisions: which bets to scale, which to iterate, and which to retire, grounded in experiment results and customer signals. You will also hire, coach, and develop product leaders who invent novel LLM-driven interactions that balance technical feasibility with customer delight.

Key job responsibilities
Build
- Build and prototype hands-on. Use AI-native tools to turn ideas into working agentic prototypes in days, test them with customers and leaders, and to set engineering and science priorities.
- Dogfood the portfolio and competitive landscape and make it a team habit.
- Set the bar for agent quality, trust, and safety with Science and Responsible AI partners.
- Partner with platform teams to define the shared agentic primitives (triggers, mission state, actions, scheduling) that let builders across Amazon Stores launch experiences independently.

Think Big
- Own the multi-year vision, strategy, and roadmap for the agentic portfolio, and write the narratives (OP1, PRFAQs, strategy docs) that align senior leadership on where agentic commerce goes next.
- Define portfolio goals and metrics that tie agentic features to incremental customer and business value. Decide which bets to scale, iterate, or retire based on experiment results and customer signals.
- Invent new interaction models for agentic shopping, and set the direction for capabilities that state-of-the-art models only now make possible.

Lead
- Hire, coach, and develop a team of PM-Ts who are builders and strategic thinkers. Set clear ownership boundaries, raise the bar on product judgment, technical depth, and writing, and expect every PM to prototype and dogfood.
- Set priorities across Engineering, Science, UX, and partner teams, including Notifications, Personalization, Pricing, Search, and Ads, and resolve trade-offs across team boundaries.
- Run the review mechanisms (WBRs, goal reviews, launch readiness) that drive delivery, experimentation, and international expansion of the portfolio.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree
- Experience in technical product management, program management or engineering
- Experience managing teams
- Experience owning/driving roadmap strategy and definition
- Experience with end to end product delivery
- Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
- Experience with feature delivery and tradeoffs of a product

Preferred qualifications

- Experience delivering consumer software products and services in a high growth environment
