The AWS Data Center Global Services team is looking for an exceptional individual to contribute to the Controls & Technology organization by joining the Controls Design Engineering team (CDE). The CDE primary responsibility is to track, document, communicate and enhance global data center design standards with a focus on control, automation and electrical power monitoring systems.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need talented, bright, and driven people. This is your chance to make history by joining a company whose potential has no limits.

The ideal candidate will need a wide-ranging background in data center environmental controls systems, IT infrastructure, networking, mechanical facility operations, electrical power monitoring, project management and strong leadership skills.

If you are passionate about the Customer Experience, think and act with a global perspective and have the ability to contribute to sophisticated innovations in the area of building controls and automation initiatives, this is the challenge you are looking for!

Controls Design Engineering (CDE)

The CDE team provides Building Management System (BMS) and Electrical Power Monitoring System (EPMS) design coordination globally.


The team’s goal is to deliver consistent standards for data center controls systems, as well as overall mechanical and electrical design practices. Due to the critical nature and complexity of designing, installing, and maintaining a BMS/EPMS, the CDE team is the primary owner of the associated specification, points list, Basis of Design and scope documents within a large infrastructure engineering team.


The CDE team is a single point of contact for multiple internal and external customers, uniting the efforts associated with:
- New construction builds
- Legacy site enhancement projects
- Data center service projects

In a continual effort to enhance the controls systems, the CDE team collaborates through design review, drives consistent standards, and collects feedback data to arrive at unified documented solutions. Due to the efforts of maintaining, updating, and distributing BMS/EPMS standards, the CDE engineer will drive significant reductions in change order expense, scope gaps between contractors, construction schedule delays, single-sourced vendor pricing, and reduced vendor project management and engineering labor costs.



Key job responsibilities
This position is for an EPMS Controls Design Engineer. Key responsibilities and requirements for this role include:
- Knowledge of EPMS programming and design, Modbus communication protocol, electrical distribution systems, single-line diagrams, complex electrical concepts, and data center redundancy
- Review MEP drawings with a focus on electrical drawing sets for EPMS design content
- Create EPMS scopes of work (SOW), provide RFI support, and review technical vendor proposals during bid review process
- Coordinate with each regional project manager to review and finalize project SOWs
- Review electrical Long Lead Equipment (LLE) submittals to ensure EPMS scope is captured
- Attend Factory Witness Tests (FWTs) and Equipment Qualification Tests (EQTs) to perform EPMS point validation and test EPMS device functionality on first of kind electrical equipment
- Create, update, and maintain controls points list and specifications, EPMS drawing templates, Basis of Design (BOD) documentation, and project specific SOW documents
- Develop and disseminate specification documents for global projects
- Lead and facilitate collaboration with multiple teams including construction, programmers, MEP/ACS engineers, and team managers as necessary to accomplish initiative goals
- Manage and prioritize requests for information on new construction builds, existing site facilities support, and legacy site enhancement projects
- Serve as central point of contact for multiple internal and external groups regarding EPMS design standards
- Ability to successfully operate in high security critical environments while maximizing productivity.
- Drive innovation of new solutions to support initiatives, team, and company goals

title: Safety Investigations Analyst, Middle Mile Investigations
descriptionHtml:
At Amazon, we're dedicated to becoming the most customer-centric company on Earth. To achieve this goal, we seek exceptionally talented, bright, and driven individuals. Amazon is currently looking for a Safety Investigations Analyst to join Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) within NAST Safety and Compliance.

The Safety Investigations Analyst owns investigation of Middle Mile transportation incidents end to end, from intake through documented finding, across Amazon's carrier programs: Relay Motor Carrier (RMC), Relay Motor Carrier LineHaul (RMCLH), Relay Motor Carrier Box Truck (RMCBT), and Amazon Freight Partner (AFP).

In this role you will conduct comprehensive incident investigations using telematics, video, and law enforcement records; apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria; identify trends across regions, programs, and carriers; recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices; and serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and external counsel. Findings inform network-level changes intended to reduce incident frequency and severity.

The successful candidate writes clearly for senior audiences, reaches defensible conclusions from incomplete information, and works independently across competing deadlines.

Key job responsibilities
Investigation

- Own assigned incident investigations end to end, from intake through documented finding, across RMC, RMCLH, RMCBT, and AFP.
- Collect and preserve evidence including telematics, dash camera footage, law enforcement records, and carrier documentation.
- Apply FMCSA Crash Preventability Determination Program criteria and video review standards.
- Write investigation narratives documenting what occurred and the factors identified, each sourced to verifiable data.
- Serve as incident point of contact to internal stakeholders and, when assigned, external counsel.

Analysis and enforcement

- Identify trends across regions, carrier programs, and individual carriers, and surface them to the Program Manager.
- Recommend enforcement action under published authority matrices.
- Query multiple data systems to extract and reconcile investigation data.

Operating rhythm

- Maintain case records and queue status in the systems of record, keeping tracking current and auditable.
- Review recurring vendor investigation reports for completeness, and escalate vendor performance issues.
- Report investigation status, closure metrics, and case aging to the Program Manager on a recurring cadence.
- Propose improvements to investigation process and standard work.

A day in the life
Your morning starts with the queue: new incidents overnight, open evidence requests, cases aging. You pull telematics and video on an assigned collision and chase the law enforcement report and carrier documentation. By afternoon you are writing the narrative, sourcing every line. Some events bring outside counsel into the file, and you are the person who knows what happened. A pattern you flagged last month across two regions becomes a recommendation your Program Manager takes to an enforcement decision. No two investigations are the same, and what you document today shapes what the network changes next quarter.

About the team
Middle Mile Investigations (MMI) sits within NAST Safety and Compliance. We investigate transportation incidents across Amazon's Middle Mile carrier programs, document what happened from verifiable evidence, and surface patterns that inform how the network operates. The team is small and geographically distributed. Analysts own their cases rather than a shared queue, and the written product carries to senior leaders who act on it. We are building our standard work now, so you will help shape how this function operates rather than inherit a finished process. If you want ownership and are comfortable with ambiguity, you will do well here.

Basic qualifications

- 1+ years of working with computers and Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- High school or equivalent
- Are 18 years of age or older

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with end-to-end project management

Helping our customers to design and create cloud computing architectures integrated with AI and GenAI technologies

title: Area Manager, RSR
descriptionHtml:
This position requires in-role training at an operating site which will be 2+ weeks in duration. This training will be located 50+ miles away from the home site location. All travel accommodations for training will be booked and paid for by Amazon.

Please note: this role requires open flexibility to work 10 hour overnight shifts (late afternoon to early morning hours) and will be scheduled on a front-half (Sunday – Wednesday) or back-half (Wednesday – Saturday) schedule. Shifts will be assigned upon starting in the role and could be subject to change based upon business need.


ABOUT AMAZON

Our Worldwide Operations network delivers millions of packages and smiles to Amazon customers every day. We are looking for motivated, customer-focused individuals who want to join our team as an Area Manager. In this role, you will lead a team of hourly employees and will be responsible for engaging your team during their shifts to maintain the highest levels of safety, quality, attendance, and performance. You will also play a key part in maintaining our customer expectations to ensure customer orders are delivered at the right time, to the right location.

Our Operation’s workflow has three major components: First mile - where the product is housed and ready for order; Middle mile - where the order is hauled to your area; and Last mile - when the product is delivered to the customer’s door. Please note that all workflows have slight building variations, but one thing is constant: our vision and dedication to the customer.

Rural Super Rural (RSR) is dedicated to ensuring our customers receive their deliveries and are satisfied with their service, even in our most remote area. We are a combination of operations and support teams aligned to continually strive to innovate the last mile delivery process while bringing smiles to our customer’s faces. Come build the future with us!

Key job responsibilities
- Support, mentor, and motivate your team
- Manage safety, quality, productivity, and customer delivery promises

- Lift up to 49 pounds, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach, as well as continuously climb and descend stairs
- Work in an environment where the noise level varies and is subject to variable temperatures and weather (delivery stations include outside loading departments, and grocery locations include refrigerated environments)
- Work a flexible schedule (weekends and/or overnight shifts)

title: Software Development Engineer II, Amazon 1P Lending
descriptionHtml:
Do you want to help millions of customers in Latin America get fair, simple and transparent credit? Amazon's 1P Lending team is looking for a Software Development Engineer II (SDE II) to design and build the systems behind our lending products in Brazil and Mexico.

You'll build and own services that handle customer onboarding, credit decisioning, loan servicing, repayments, and integration with local partners and regulators. These are critical financial systems, so they must be correct, secure, auditable and highly available.

You'll be part of a team of engineers in São Paulo and work closely with engineering teams in India and with Product, Risk, Finance and Compliance partners in Brazil and Mexico. You'll own features from design to production, help shape the team's architecture, and see your work directly affect customers' access to credit.

We're looking for a strong engineer with high ownership. You should enjoy solving hard problems, write high-quality code, and care about how your systems behave in production.

Key job responsibilities
Design and build: Design, write, test and launch scalable, reliable services and features for lending products in Brazil and Mexico.
Own your systems from start to finish: Take features from requirements and technical design through deployment, monitoring and ongoing improvement.
Contribute to architecture: Write and review design docs, weigh technical trade-offs, and help shape the team's system architecture with senior engineers and the SDM.
Build for financial services: Build in the security, data privacy, auditability and correctness that regulated lending systems need, including local requirements in Brazil and Mexico.
Work across geographies: Work with engineering teams in India and partner teams in Brazil and Mexico on shared services, integrations and launches.
Run what you build: Take part in on-call, debug production issues, lead root-cause analysis and make lasting fixes.
Raise the bar: Do thorough code reviews, improve engineering practices, and mentor junior engineers and interns.
Work with business partners: Partner with Product, Risk and Compliance to turn customer and regulatory needs into technical solutions.

A day in the life
On a given day you might:

Write the design doc for a new repayment-scheduling service.
Review a teammate's code and suggest a simpler approach.
Pair with an engineer in India to debug an integration issue.
Work with Risk to understand a new credit-decisioning rule.
Ship a feature to production and watch its metrics after launch.
You'll split your time between design, coding, operations and working with your team and partners.

Basic qualifications

- Experience (non-internship) in professional software development
- Experience contributing to the architecture and design (architecture, design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and current systems
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Technician, RME
descriptionHtml:
The Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) team at Amazon is fundamental to our operations – they’re the ones keeping vital machinery running at all times. As an RME Technician, you’ll maintain a wide range of equipment and workspaces while upholding Health and Safety best practices. You'll help to keep your colleagues safe and prevent machine downtime. Our RME Technicians boost the availability and quality of our equipment and work to enhance the operational environment too.

Key job responsibilities
Proactive and preventative maintenance tasks on a wide range of site equipment
Carry out reactive repairs and fault diagnosis in a live distribution warehouse
Use the latest tools to maximise equipment effectiveness
Uphold all health and safety policies and practices
Support the development and progression of on-site apprentices
Work on continuous improvement projects and roll out best practices across a range of EU sites

A day in the life
Our RME Technicians are based on-site, so they can respond quickly to any machinery issues. You’ll carry out a range of planned preventative maintenance to our sites’ equipment to make sure it’s working safely. As an RME Technician, you’ll also respond promptly to breakdowns, investigating, finding, and implementing solutions as quickly as possible. You’ll also make suggestions for long-term improvements.

Working alongside senior colleagues, you’ll undertake day-to-day maintenance tasks and will liaise with contractors if you need external expertise. You’ll work on a range of shifts to make sure our sites are supported around the clock – allowing Amazon to deliver at the speed we’re known for.

About the team
Our Reliability Maintenance Engineering or RME team keep our equipment performing at its best. We're a technically minded team, made up of excellent team players and guided by experienced leaders. We work together to maintain, troubleshoot and repair equipment across our global network of fulfilment centres. Some of our people are leaders, who oversee the team as they work on exciting technology – some of which only exists at Amazon.

From installing automated packaging systems to overseeing the general maintenance of a site to repairing key distribution equipment, our team handles most aspects of Amazon’s technical side. This includes keeping buildings legally compliant, so everyone is safe, and our sites are operating at maximum efficiency. There are lots of opportunities for progression, both within the RME team and more widely across Amazon.

Everything we do focuses on reducing downtime in Amazon’s crucial operations sites, so customers get their orders on time. We often work during early or late hours to carry out maintenance with minimal disruption, including night shifts. If we spot a better way to do something, we have the skills and the opportunity to develop and introduce completely new processes like Amazon Robotics and our Complex Item Sorter.

Basic qualifications

- NVQ Level 3 in Mechanical, Electrical or Mechatronics, or 4 years UK certified apprenticeship
- Work flexible schedules including weekends, nights, and holidays
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English at C1 level or above
- Experience in electrical or mechanical engineering

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with material handling equipment (MHE) safety standards accordance with original equipment manufacturer (OEM) and safety standards
- Experience with robotic operation and maintenance
- Experience with PLC controlled automation and issue diagnosis in a continuous process or production environment
- Experience with predictive and preventative maintenance, repair, troubleshooting, and diagnostics on material handling equipment (MHE) and automated conveyor systems

title: Sr. Product Launch Manager, Fulfillment Technology & Robotics - Product Launch
descriptionHtml:
Is your passion inspired by invention? Is problem solving through teamwork in your DNA? Do you like the idea of seeing how your work affects the bigger picture? Answer yes to all of these and you will fit right in here at Amazon Robotics International. We are a smart team of doers that work passionately to apply innovative advances in robotics and software to solve real-world challenges that will transform our customers’ experiences in ways we cannot even image yet. We invent new improvements every day. We are Amazon Robotics and we will give you the tools and support you need to invent with us in ways that are rewarding, fulfilling and fun.

The AR International organization sources a portfolio of robotics technology and is responsible for getting the right materials to the right place at the right time to support our network of global fulfillment and transportation solutions. It’s an operation that works cross-functionally with teams across Amazon globally, and is driven by data and metrics.

The team is seeking an experienced Customer Solutions Manager to manage the timely and efficient material delivery to AR International sites by managing schedules and addressing supply chain constraints. This role will own end to end planning of a portfolio and collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze demand fluctuations, resolve challenges, and communicate risks to stakeholders. The role emphasizes proactive problem-solving, risk management, and continuous improvement to enhance overall performance.

Key job responsibilities
- Own the vision and long-term strategy for first-time automation, designing mechanisms and scalable processes where problems and approaches are not yet defined with the aim to graduate products into General Availability

- Set the standards for operational excellence across the Product Launch organisation, define best practices adopted team-wide and actively remove bottlenecks that stifle innovation

- Influence business and technology direction at the organisation level; present strategic narratives and operational plans to Directors and VPs; negotiate effectively across organisations to align priorities

- Design scalable, long-term mechanisms and frameworks — enabling downstream teams to scale without direct oversight

- Serve as subject matter expert across multiple products; identify when performance issues stem from technical design issues and provide actionable feedback to engineering teams

- Drive cost efficiencies, critical issue handling, and proactive risk mitigation for significantly complex problems before they become roadblocks

- deliver data driven narratives for director and VP level for strategic Product decisions

But it's not all about projects and programs: work hard, have fun, make history.

title: Safety Coordinator, RAD WHS
descriptionHtml:
The Safety Coordinator is responsible for the proactive, day-to-day monitoring and execution of Amazon's Workplace Health & Safety (WHS) program at the site. Partnering closely with the Safety Manager, this individual monitors safety compliance, identifies and helps mitigate potential hazards within the warehouse environment, and serves as a visible, on-the-floor safety resource across all operational shifts. The qualified candidate engages professionally with the entire site workforce and leadership team to drive safety awareness, education, and a strong safety culture, and communicates clearly — both written and verbally — to correct unsafe conditions and reinforce safe behaviors.

About the role
This site supports a dynamic, fast-moving warehouse operation with a growing headcount and newly added shifts. The Safety Coordinator is the front-line owner of safety execution for their assigned shift(s) — the person associates and area managers go to for real-time hazard questions, injury response, and process-path safety support. This is a highly visible, floor-based role: expect to spend the majority of your time in operations process paths observing work, coaching associates, and partnering with Operations leadership to build safety into the way work gets done.


Key job responsibilities
- Assist in implementing, monitoring, and evaluating the workplace to ensure compliance with Company Safety policies in order to provide a safe and secure workplace for employees, visitors, vendors, and guests.
- Maintain daily documentation requirements to report activities and other related safety prevention matters.
- Perform work task Risk Assessments and develop safety standard work in conjunction with associates.
- Complete ergonomic assessments on job tasks, incorporating findings into applicable Standard Work.
- Provide immediate aid to associates, visitors, vendors, or guests that need assistance, or medical attention as appropriate.
- Provide front-line first-aid response and triage; complete injury/illness case documentation, workers' compensation intake, return-to-work (RTW) and accommodation tracking, and injury recordkeeping reconciliation.
- Manage regulated-waste compliance: label, date, and inspect waste accumulation areas; process and prepare waste shipments in accordance with RCRA and DOT requirements, including manifests; coordinate specialized waste streams (batteries, oils, coolants) with the maintenance team; and perform spill response, spill-kit inspections, and stormwater best management practice (BMP) inspections.
- Investigate, compile, and develop investigative reports on any incident/accident that may occur, and ensure action items are adequately complete. Conduct Root Cause Analyses in conjunction with Operations leadership.
- Coordinate with any outside emergency agency — Fire, Police, Sheriff, OSHA, etc.
- Be a leader in customer service to the Operations team. Understand and frequently work in operations process paths.
- Respond to situations, as they arise, based on direction from the Safety Manager.
- Perform site physical condition safety observations, associate safety behavior observations, and audits and inspections in relation to fire and safety related equipment.
- Verify Permit to Work (PTW) compliance on shift and monitor contractor safety (personal protective equipment and work-area compliance).
- Conduct training and participate in new manager orientations, associate orientations, and pre-shift meetings.
- Assist in CPR/First aid, power equipment training, and any other programs assigned by the Safety Manager.
- Facilitate and attend 5S and Kaizen events.
- Maintain Safety Data Sheets (SDS) and chemical inventory, and manage PPE inventory and fit testing.

Basic qualifications

- High school or equivalent
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays
- Can lift up to 49 pounds, stand/walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, and be able to frequently push, pull, squat, bend, and reach
- Work 40 hours/week, and overtime as required

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Experience with environmental regulations
- Knowledge of technical understanding of the waste management process

descriptionHtml:
There’s a universe of opportunity at Amazon.

At Amazon, your career doesn’t follow a straight line. It accelerates, twists, and challenges you in ways you never expected. From the moment you join, you’re part of something big: building products or services that reach millions and shaping how people live, work, and connect every day. This is where your ideas turn into real impact. You’ll work with world class tools, global platforms, and systems built to operate at an extraordinary scale. You’ll move fast, experiment and launch solutions that matter. With endless opportunities to explore across teams and roles, you’ll learn quickly, apply what you know and discover skills you didn’t know existed. This is an environment designed for builders who want to see the impact of their work in the world. Ready to start your adventure?

What’s in it for you?
With teams across the Amazon universe, you don’t have to choose one path too early. You’ll take ownership, build new skills, and shape a career that evolves as you do.

What does it look like to be an Operations Finance partner for a $350 billion and growing startup? Exciting technology, automation and a fast pace environment attract some of the brightest in Operations to help us redefine our distribution network every year. To do so, we look for exceptional candidates who possess the leadership to influence, a bias for action, and the passion to think big while diving deep. At Amazon, we move with purpose and speed, and this requires we work with a dynamic network of Operations, HR, Tech and Retail partners. We help others understand finance and are the trusted business partner by employing every facet of data and communication to ensure our partners and our leaders have the most up to date and reliable information to help them make the best possible decision. Come teach us a few things, and we’ll teach you a few things as we navigate the most customer-centric company on Earth.

The Operations Finance Rotational Program (OFRP) - Operations Financial Analyst role is an intensive two-year, entry-level undergraduate rotational program spanning two year-long assignments in preparation for large leadership roles in finance. Candidates will be placed on various finance teams that support an aspect of customer fulfillment. What is fulfillment you ask? Fulfillment is how we refer to completing or fulfilling a customer’s Amazon.com order and the acts of picking, packing, shipping and delivering their order to meet or exceed their expectations! The program combines ongoing training opportunities and challenging job assignments to equip you with exceptional financial, business, leadership, and technical skills. The program is led by senior Amazon professionals and mentors that are committed to developing financial leaders for exciting careers.

This rotational program will offer you the opportunity for accelerated career growth, and provides exposure to business leaders in a culture that recognizes and rewards excellence. After successful completion of this rotational program, participants are expected to take on financial leadership positions supporting one of Amazon’s many business units.

This role requires the ability to begin full-time employment on August 9, 2027 and the willingness to relocate nationwide throughout the two-year rotational program. Placements are based on business need but do take into consideration individual location preferences.

Please note that we are unable to offer visa sponsorship.

Key job responsibilities
- Partnering with operational leadership and frontline associates to identify, develop, and enact process improvements within the supply chain process
- Participating in daily and weekly planning discussions with senior leadership
- Maintaining and improving financial reporting to support and challenge business decisions
- Conducting financial analysis to help identify capital investment requirements and/or cost reduction opportunities
- Designing and maintaining insightful reporting to drive action of business partners using Excel/VBA/SQL
- Analyzing operational metrics, conducting root cause analysis, and communicating financial impact across Finance, Operations and other support departments
- Exposure to both variable and fixed budgeting and reconciliation on a weekly, monthly, and yearly level, upwards of $250MM

Basic qualifications

- Are 18 years of age or older
- Currently has, or is in the process of obtaining, a bachelor's degree or higher in finance, economics, accounting, business administration and management, or a related field
- Able to relocate nationwide - relocation assistance provided if eligible

Preferred qualifications

- Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities
- Knowledge of and proficiency in Excel and SQL
- Experience using data and metrics to back up assumptions, evaluate outcomes, and make data-driven decisions
- Experience dealing well with ambiguity, prioritizing needs, and delivering measurable results in an agile environment
- Experience communicating complex business concepts in verbal and written form
- Understanding of basic business, accounting, and finance concepts

title: Sr. Fire Protection Engineer, Design Quality Assurance (DQA)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Web Service (AWS) operates 123 Availability Zones (AZs) within 39 geographic Regions around the world. Amazon’s AWS Data Centers (DCs) are a major component of worldwide cloud-computing infrastructure and are industry leading examples of critical facilities.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help. You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

Architects and Engineers in AWS work to design resilient, cost-effective DC facilities. We are responsible for achieving a world-class uptime for our customers and drive to develop a fleet of buildings emphasizing security, safety, efficiency, and cost effectiveness, while finding new ways to meet AWS’s growing demand. We justify and communicate the technical decisions we make to AWS leadership and work hard to drive continuous advancements in our designs. As an Engineer at AWS you will have the opportunity to impact changes in our current design, as well as establish design procedures and protocols for future systems.

As a Sr. Fire Protection Engineer you are a technical leader in your field, collaborating with and leading the work of cross-functional teams including technical program management, product management, architecture, civil engineering, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, supply chain management, operations, safety, security, finance, and legal. You will participate in external forums/consortiums to understand current trends and developments within the industry. Additionally, you will be a leader for fire protection design strategy and development. This role will communicate the technical decisions we make to Senior Management and will drive continuous improvements and governance of our designs.


Key job responsibilities
- Provide technical oversight and governance of the global Basis of Design (BOD)
- Partner with AWS Risk Management, Construction Management, Procurement, Field Engineering and Operations to define building requirements and be a technical source for all building fire protection attributes
- Decompose complex fire protection related issues into straightforward and actionable solutions and drive resolution of mitigation measures
- Develop strategic prototypical building solutions which meet or exceed our quality requirements and drive value engineering and standardization of fire protection systems.
- Serve as a technical advisor for AWS data center design projects
- Collaborate with local regulatory agencies and certification agencies to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and building codes
- Collaborate with cross-functional engineering and partner teams to drive infrastructure strategy, resolve deficiencies, and implement new mechanisms that simplify and improve critical facility systems.
- Diagnose and resolve complex infrastructure issues by applying technical expertise, identifying root causes of endemic problems, and delivering solutions that prevent recurrence.
- Communicate technical designs, trade-offs, and recommendations clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders, ensuring alignment across teams and informed decision-making.
- Mentor and coach fellow engineers, contributing to their professional development and strengthening the overall technical capability of the team.
Anticipated travel not to exceed 25%


About the team
Our team is responsible for the infrastructure that keeps Amazon's data centers running reliably and efficiently. We design, build, and optimize the critical systems that support our customers' access to cloud services around the globe. We are a collaborative group of engineers who value creative problem-solving and continuous improvement. As we scale to meet growing demand, you will play a meaningful role in shaping our infrastructure strategy and raising the bar on engineering quality across the organization.

Basic qualifications

descriptionHtml:
About Maintenance at Amazon

Operations is at the heart of Amazon’s business. We are known for our speed, accuracy, and exceptional service. Our buildings deliver tens of thousands of products to hundreds of countries worldwide, every day. Reliability Maintenance & Engineering (RME) are the business partners that work tirelessly behind the scenes to make it all happen. We drive continuous improvement and maintain all of the Robotics and Material Handling Equipment (MHE) to ensure our customers are met with the Amazon smile. Come join us on our journey!

About the Role

As a Mechatronics & Robotics Technician, you will use your skills to support the Operations Maintenance team in repairing and maintaining material handling equipment and pneumatic systems throughout the building. You will have the opportunity to install, maintain, and repair automated packaging and distribution equipment. In addition to developing your skills, you will mentor junior technicians to grow in their roles.

What Do We Offer?

Amazon offers competitive compensation packages including comprehensive healthcare benefits starting on Day 1, matching 401(k) program, and up to 20 weeks of paid parental leave. But wait, there is more: We provide lightweight fire-resistant daily wear and composite toe safety shoes for your safety!

Here is what you can expect with the Reliability & Maintenance Engineering (RME) selection process for Mechatronics & Robotics Technicians: (Timeframe: Approximately 30-days)

Step 1: Congratulations! You successfully submitted your application!

Step 2: Amazon Recruiting will review your application and invite the most qualified candidate to complete a pre-employment assessment.

Step 3: If you meet the role qualifications, you will receive an invitation from Amazon Recruiting (do-not-reply@criteriacorp.com) to begin your Criteria assessment. You have 5 days to complete.

Step 4: Once you successfully meet the pre-employment assessment requirements, you will be invited to complete a video interview. Your video interview invitation will be from HireVue (interviews@hirevue.com) and you will have 7 days to record your interview.

Step 5: Your video interview will be reviewed by the Amazon Hiring Team and you will be notified of next steps via email within 5 business days.


Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- You will promote a safe working environment by following all safety procedures
- You will complete preventative maintenance routines with proper documentation
- You will troubleshoot electrical and mechanical problems related to all Material Handling Equipment (MHE) which includes belts, motors, photo-eyes, relays, and more
- You will maintain a positive working relationship across all of the Amazon Operations facility
- You must be able to move up to 49lbs, stand and walk during shifts lasting up to 12 hours, climb ladders and gangways safely, and without limitation, as well as perform regular bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching both below the waist and above the head

Please note that while we strive to accommodate employees' preferences for shift assignments, due to operational requirements and scheduling constraints, we cannot guarantee a specific shift assignment.

- 1+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work a flexible schedule/shift/work area, including weekends, nights, and/or holidays

- 2+ years of conducting predictive and preventative maintenance procedures experience
- 2+ years of reading blueprints and electrical schematics experience
- 2+ years of demonstrating safety standards experience
- 2+ years of troubleshooting and diagnostics of material handling equipment (MHE) experience

title: Tecnico/a Sicurezza sul Lavoro
descriptionHtml:
Garantire la sicurezza e il benessere dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro è una priorità assoluta in Amazon. I nostri Safety Technician svolgono un ruolo fondamentale per renderlo possibile. Questo ruolo rappresenta un'opportunità per avviare la tua carriera nella sicurezza sul lavoro e crescere in un'azienda internazionale. Collaborerai a stretto contatto con i nostri esperti per monitorare il tuo sito, potendo così constatare ogni giorno la differenza che fai per il benessere delle persone.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica, Trasporti e Merci. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 3 del CCNL di riferimento.

Key job responsibilities
- Eseguire valutazioni del rischio e audit.
- Monitorare il sito per assicurarsi che i processi siano conformi alle procedure di sicurezza di Amazon.
- Creare e aggiornare i report sulle metriche di sicurezza da sottoporre ai colleghi.
- Collaborare con i colleghi di Operations e di tutta l'azienda su compiti relativi alla sicurezza e offrire indicazioni sui processi.
- Supportare l'implementazione di nuove misure di sicurezza.

A day in the life
Lavorerai in uno dei nostri siti. Questo significa che potrai seguire da vicino ciò che accade e i colleghi potranno rivolgersi a te con domande durante i loro turni. Questo ruolo consiste nell'individuare potenziali problemi prima che si verifichino. Dedicherai molto tempo a controllare il sito e a osservare come le persone utilizzano le attrezzature. Comprendendo il funzionamento di ogni attività e di ogni macchinario, sarai in grado di individuare il modo migliore per mantenere i processi sicuri.

Sarai anche una delle persone che mettono in atto i cambiamenti in materia di sicurezza, il che significa che lavorerai a stretto contatto con molte persone. Oltre alle tue mansioni quotidiane e settimanali, offrirai supporto al team Operations su attività ad hoc legate alla sicurezza.

La sicurezza è fondamentale per Amazon, e ci aiuterai a raccogliere i dati essenziali che ci permettono di tenere sotto controllo i nostri processi e di prevenire qualsiasi problema. Condividerai questi dati con i colleghi di tutta l'azienda e collaborerai con altri team per assicurare che la sicurezza sia sempre al primo posto.

About the team
Il team Workplace Health and Safety (WHS) svolge un ruolo fondamentale nel garantire il benessere mentale e fisico dei nostri dipendenti sul luogo di lavoro. Il nostro team collabora con responsabili, associati e autorità locali in tutti i nostri siti, assicurando il rispetto delle politiche di Amazon e delle normative vigenti, e garantendo la sicurezza dei nostri ambienti di lavoro. Il team offre una varietà di opportunità, dai Safety Technician ai Programme Manager. Indipendentemente dal tuo ruolo, contribuirai allo sviluppo e all'implementazione della strategia di sicurezza sull'intera rete.

Basic qualifications

- -Una laurea, oppure una qualifica equivalente conforme al Quadro Europeo delle Qualifiche (EQF), preferibilmente in Tecniche della Prevenzione nell'Ambiente e nei Luoghi di Lavoro o Ingegneria della Sicurezza; oppure altra laurea accompagnata da esperienza rilevante nel campo della sicurezza sul lavoro; oppure laurea in Ingegneria o altri campi specifici, o diploma di scuola superiore con esperienza in ambito produzione/magazzino.
- -Certificazione ASPP o RSPP.
- -Conoscenza della legislazione italiana in materia di salute e sicurezza sul lavoro.
- -Padronanza dell'italiano e conoscenza base dell'inglese (A2), scritto e parlato.

Preferred qualifications

- Le qualifiche preferenziali non sono necessarie per candidarsi a una posizione in Amazon. Se possiedi tutte le qualifiche di base sopra indicate, saremo lieti di ricevere la tua candidatura.
- - Esperienza con metodologie Lean, 5S o Kaizen.
- - Esperienza nella pianificazione o gestione di iniziative attente all'ambiente.
- - Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente e in team.

descriptionHtml:
このポジションでは、Amazonで急速な進化を遂げる広告事業において、動画広告セールスの重要な役割を担っていただきます。

広告主のビジネス目標およびマーケティング課題を深く理解した上で、Prime Video広告を中心とした動画広告ソリューション（Fire TV、Twitch、DSP経由の3rd party動画広告等）を活用し、ブランド構築および中長期的な成長を支援します。

本ポジションは、新規顧客開拓に対する明確なオーナーシップを担います。動画広告を起点に、これまでAmazon Adsと接点の少なかった広告主も含め、幅広い顧客に対してAmazonが持つ購買シグナルや独自のインサイトを活用した価値提案を行い、長期的なパートナーシップ構築を目指します。

Amazon Adsの認知ソリューションの価値を分かりやすく伝え、動画広告が広告主のビジネスにどのようなインパクトをもたらすのかを、中長期視点で説明する役割を担います。

Key job responsibilities
- 広告会社と連携し、オンライン動画広告などの認知獲得型広告ソリューションの販売を通じて、新規広告主の獲得を行う。
- 長期的にみて、なぜ、動画広告を視聴しているオーディエンスにリーチするのが重要かを説得力のあるストーリーを構築して説明する。
- 提案を行い続け、案件を作成し、新規広告主からの予算獲得に必要な、決定権者に影響を与える。
- 代理店、広告主の双方における決定権者と信頼関係を構築する。
- アカウント戦略を俯瞰し、どの動画ソリューションが最も適しているかを整理して明らかにする。

- 既存、新規を問わず、広告主に対し、営業活動を行い、優れた顧客サービスを提供する。
- 広告主の目的にそった提案書を作成し、提案する。

A day in the life
Prime Video広告を中心とした動画広告ソリューションの提案機会が見込まれる広告主を特定します。

広告主のマーケティング目標や課題を理解した上で、Amazonが保有するインサイトを活用し、調査・検証を行いながら提案書を作成します。提案活動では対面でのコミュニケーションを重視。キャンペーン実施後は効果分析を通じて成果を可視化します。

得られた示唆をもとに、継続的な予算獲得や次なるビジネス機会の創出につなげていきます。

About the team
Large Customer Salesは大手企業を担当する組織です。フルファネルで価値提供を行い、生活者行動シグナルに基づくマーケティングの可視化と成果創出を重視します。広告代理店・各領域のスペシャリストと協業し、独自の価値を提供します。

Basic qualifications

- Experience in an online advertising role and have familiarity with advertising products and ad serving technologies

- Experience using English communication skills, both written and verbal, to foster seamless interaction with stakeholders at all levels
- Experience with external customer interaction, or experience communicating with a wide range of stakeholders, including colleagues and leadership

title: Engineering Operation Technician
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.



Key job responsibilities
Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
Technical writing to support change management program
Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
Role may support more than one location/site.


Physical Requirements:

Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection


This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.

Essential Requirements:

Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility


Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays

Preferred qualifications

- 2+ years of data center engineering experience
- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings
- vocational/technical training or an associate degree or above, or 4+ years of military experience

title: Reliability Maintenance Engineering Area Manager:in
descriptionHtml:
Amazon unterhält Hunderte von Betriebsstandorten in ganz Europa. Diese Standorte sind mehr als nur Arbeitsplätze – hier treffen sich unsere Teams und sorgen gemeinsam dafür, dass unsere Kund:innen zufrieden sind. Als Reliability Maintenance Engineering (RME) Area Manager:in bringst Du die Elemente zusammen, die unsere Arbeitsumgebung so unterstützend und effizient wie möglich machen. Du leitest und betreust ein Team technischer Fachkräfte, die dafür sorgen, dass unsere Geräte zuverlässig arbeiten.

Key job responsibilities
Unterstützung der Kolleg:innen bei der Einhaltung der Sicherheitsrichtlinien und -abläufe am Standort
Umsetzung des EU-Netzwerkstandards, Planung vorbeugender Wartungsmaßnahmen und Gewährleistung technischer Verfügbarkeit
Kollaboration mit Kolleg:innen zur Datenerhebung und -analyse, um Prozesse zu verbessern
Umsetzung und Unterstützung sowohl standortbasierter als auch netzwerkbasierter Projekte
Leitung, Unterstützung und Mentoring für Dein Team, um die berufliche Entwicklung zu fördern

A day in the life
Du arbeitest an einem unserer Betriebsstandorte, bietest Deinem Team praktische Anleitung und verschaffst Dir einen klaren Überblick über alle Aktivitäten am Standort. Das beinhaltet die Erhebung von Daten und die Lösung von Problemen in einer dynamischen Umgebung. Außerdem erstellst Du einen Betriebsplan, um den Standort produktiver und effizienter zu machen. Dazu führst Du auch neue Projekte ein, die alles von den Betriebsabläufen bis hin zur Gerätewartung optimieren. Neben der Sicherheit ist der wichtigste Aspekt dieser Rolle die Leitung Deines Teams. Das beinhaltet das Management der Leistung und Entwicklung Deiner Teammitglieder ebenso wie die Organisation zusätzlicher Schulungen.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.
Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. title: NW Deployment Planner I, GND - Planning, Implementation, Coordination (PIC) Team
descriptionHtml:
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build the place to find and buy anything online, this is your chance to make history.

The Global Network Delivery organization is looking to hire a highly motivated, best-in-class Network Deployment Planner to join our growing Planning and Implementation team within AWS Data Center Delivery. The team responsibilities involve scoping and planning interdependent capacity scaling projects and new network capacity deployments across several data center locations. They will review project forecasts and assure physical infrastructure resources are available for their execution.

The Network Deployment Planner will work closely with infrastructure supply chain & procurement, network engineering and technical program managers to plan and deliver customer capacity to the local data center installation & deployment technicians to facilitate smooth capacity execution.

The ideal candidate will possess a technology background that enables them to understand the complexities of the sophisticated network architecture of Amazon data centers. To be a qualified candidate you must be highly autonomous, very detail oriented, possesses strong written and verbal communication skills and have experience in managing network deployment projects. They will be competent in networking principles, data center operations, cable infrastructure and fiber solutions.

This position will provide the individual with high levels of autonomous work with minimal supervision to drive the stability and sustainability of our next-generation networks and to assist in the development of innovative ways to automate and scale our network as we expand. The desire and ability to work in a fast paced, ambiguous, collaborative environment is essential for success.



Key job responsibilities
* Ensure adherence to timelines.
* Deliver sustainable and repeatable solutions and processes always with an eye on improvement.
* Work closely with our Install/Deployment Technicians, Supply Chain & Procurement, Network Engineers and Technical Project Manager teams to ensure fast, smooth delivery of on-demand customer capacity.
* Knowledge of network cabling and optic types.
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies.
* Familiarity with common networking terms.
* Excellent judgement and analytical skills, ability to prioritize tasks based on fluctuating needs. - Strong prioritization and time management ability.
* Coordination of design, project timeline/schedule and construction milestones.
* Experience in core project management disciplines including scope, schedule, budget, quality, along with risk and critical path management. Must be well organized and able to work effectively under time pressure.

About the team
*Why AWS*
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

*Diverse Experiences*
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

*Work/Life Balance*
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

*Inclusive Team Culture*
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

*Mentorship and Career Growth*
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

- 1+ years of computer networking experience
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field
- Experience with project management
- 1+ years of in data center or critical environment in Computer Hardware Repair, Infrastructure Cabling, Network Deployment, or Data Center Operations experience
- Experience with network hardware: copper and optical fiber cabling, switches, routers

Preferred qualifications

title: Treasury Manager, Treasury Business Partner
descriptionHtml:
Join Amazon's Treasury Business Partner (TBP) team within Treasury Strategy & Markets as a Treasury Manager. You'll advise Amazon's business and finance leaders and support some of Amazon's largest capital expenditure initiatives: structuring and executing multi-billion dollar asset financing solutions, optimizing working capital metrics, launching strategic payment innovations, and developing exposure management frameworks across the enterprise.

Our team delivers innovative, best-in-class treasury solutions in partnership with business and finance leadership. We pride ourselves on customer obsession, tackling challenges of all magnitudes, and delivering effective resolutions. As a member of TBP, you'll be at the forefront of financial innovation, partnering with Directors and Finance Managers on projects that inform Amazon's global financial strategy, with regular exposure to VP and CFO leadership. This role offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to the financial success of one of the world's most dynamic companies while building your treasury expertise in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will serve as a Treasury advisor to your business partners, with a focus on asset-backed financing, working capital optimization, exposure management, and strategic payment solutions.

Key responsibilities include:
• Building strong relationships with business and business finance leadership
• Analyzing business plans to identify opportunities and financial risks
• Developing and implementing scalable Treasury solutions for specific business cases
• Quantifying financial impacts and presenting data-driven recommendations
• Leveraging AI to create or review financial models to support strategic decisions
• Applying and driving adoption of Treasury's frameworks and control mechanisms within your business areas
• Preparing and presenting Treasury recommendations to business and finance leadership, including Director- and VP-level reviews
• Partnering with cross-functional teams, including Finance, Legal, Accounting, Tax, and external banking partners, on domestic and global initiatives

A day in the life
Your morning starts analyzing a data center expansion plan, working with your finance partner to build financial models that evaluate the own vs. lease decision and assess whether an asset-level financing solution is needed. Next, you have your recurring 1:1 with finance directors to understand their current priorities and any challenges that need Treasury's support. You then present structured financing recommendations to a finance director, addressing implementation questions with cross-functional partners from Legal, Tax, and Accounting. After lunch, you facilitate a working session with Finance, Legal, Tax, and Treasury teams to develop scalable payment solutions for a new business initiative, navigating ambiguity to identify core treasury requirements. You spend the afternoon building models and presentations to support an upcoming leadership review on working capital optimization, coordinating with external banking partners. You close the day presenting treasury solutions to a business VP, responding to challenges on your assumptions and moving forward with implementation planning.

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making experience
- 5+ years of participating in continuous improvement projects in your team to scale and improve controllership with measurable results experience
- 5+ years of finance, accounting, or related analytical field experience
- Bachelor's degree in business, finance, accounting, tax, economics, or a related analytical field

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of solving complex business challenges by delivering accurate and timely financial models, analysis, and recommendations that have a proven impact on business (e.g., financial savings, operational improvements, or customer benefits) experience
- MBA, or CPA
- Experience delivering forecasting, budgeting, and variance analysis, and data interpretation of results

title: Data Engineer II, Alexa AI - ML Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Join Alexa AI - ML Engineering and help power personalized, proactive experiences for hundreds of millions of Alexa customers worldwide. As a Data Engineer II, you will design and own the large-scale data pipelines that turn raw customer-interaction signals into the context and features our personalization and proactive-agent models depend on, working side-by-side with SDEs to shape our data strategy and architecture.

- You will build and operate ETL/ELT pipelines processing billions of records a day, using AWS big-data services (Glue, EMR, Kinesis, Redshift, DynamoDB) and distributed compute.
- You will partner with SDEs and applied scientists to define data strategy, contracts, and feature pipelines, and to decide architecture direction together.
- You will own operational health: data migrations, schema/platform updates, and triage of pipeline tickets, directly supporting the SDE team's work.
- This is a high-visibility role: the data you deliver, and keep running, directly shapes what Alexa proactively tells customers, and when.

Key job responsibilities
1. Partner closely with SDEs to help define data strategy, architecture direction, and the long-term roadmap for the team's data platform.
2. Design, build, and own ETL/ELT pipelines that ingest, transform, and load customer-interaction and context data at a scale of billions of records per day.
3. Own operational items end-to-end: data migrations, schema and platform updates, and triage/resolution of data-pipeline tickets, providing day-to-day support to the SDE team.
4. Partner with applied scientists and ML engineers to define data contracts, feature pipelines, and data-quality checks feeding personalization and proactive-agent models.
5. Operate and continuously improve production pipelines: optimize data delivery, redesign for scalability, manage deployments, and drive root-cause fixes for pipeline incidents.
6. Establish and document best practices for data modeling, warehousing, and pipeline design across the team.

A day in the life
You'll join SDEs in a design discussion to shape data strategy and architecture, then pick up a migration or platform-update ticket and see it through to resolution. You'll trace a data-quality issue in a personalization feature pipeline, support SDEs with any operational asks on your pipelines, and monitor the health of systems processing billions of daily customer-interaction events. You'll partner with applied scientists to onboard new signal sources and triage pipeline alerts.


About the team
Alexa AI - ML Engineering builds the personalization and proactive-intelligence systems that let Alexa anticipate what customers need before they ask. Data Engineers work side-by-side with SDEs and applied scientists, combining data strategy and large-scale engineering to turn billions of daily customer-interaction signals into the context, features, and content that drive Alexa's ranking, personalization, and proactive-agent experiences. We value ownership, data quality, and working backwards from the customer.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of data engineering experience
- 4+ years of SQL experience
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

Preferred qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

descriptionHtml:
Are you passionate about people, and curious about what makes a great workplace actually work? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join Amazon as an HR Consultant Apprentice - a role where the decisions you support shape the day-to-day experience of thousands of employees.

HR at Amazon isn't about admin and policy for their own sake. Our teams sit alongside business leaders, using data, insight, and well-designed mechanisms to help managers lead well, grow their people, and make fair, consistent decisions at real scale.

As an apprentice, you'll learn this craft by doing it. You'll start by supporting the fundamentals and, over time, take on real responsibility - getting closer to the business, forming your own point of view, and learning how to influence outcomes rather than simply respond to requests.

A day in the life can involve:

- Partnering with managers and stakeholders to offer expert, practical HR guidance

- Contributing to diversity, equity, and inclusion initiatives

- Supporting the delivery of HR strategy for the lines of business you work with

- Using people data to spot trends and shape fair, consistent decisions

- Helping standardise and improve best practice across teams

This role suits someone who's genuinely curious about people and comfortable with a bit of grey - not every answer is in a handbook. You'll build credibility with colleagues at every level, ask good questions, and bring empathy and sound judgement to situations that are rarely black and white. We move fast, fail fast, and fix faster, so you'll be encouraged to form a view and act on it early.

title: Data Scientist, Phased Array Antenna System Validation
descriptionHtml:
Amazon LEO is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

About this role

We're looking for a Data Scientist to turn data from our satellite fleet into engineering decisions. Every satellite in orbit sends back a steady stream of telemetry. Every unit was also tested heavily on the ground before launch, and the ground segment watches the satellite every day while it operates. Your job is to connect these sources. You'll find out which in-orbit behaviors trace back to what we measured in the factory, which events repeat across the fleet, and which patterns point to weaknesses in the hardware design. Your findings will directly shape how we design, build, test, and operate the next generation of satellites.

A typical problem starts small: a handful of satellites show a drifting temperature, an occasional link dropout, or a counter that creeps up faster than expected. You'll work out whether it's a real effect or noise, whether it's spreading, and what the affected units have in common. They might share a manufacturing lot, a configuration, an orbital environment, or a signature in their factory test history. From there you'll form a hypothesis about the physical cause and argue it in front of hardware, firmware, and reliability engineers who will push back hard. You'll also have to say plainly when the data rules your own idea out.

Telemetry alone rarely settles the question, so your first stop is the ground test data we already have. Every unit in orbit has a detailed record from manufacturing and environmental testing, and the fleet as a whole is backed by an even larger population of units still on the ground. You'll dig through that history for the same behavior: did the affected units show early signs on the ground, did they sit near a test limit, does the effect appear across many units under certain conditions? Often the answer is already in data no one has looked at in this light. When it isn't, you'll design the ground experiments that can provide it. That means deciding which units to test and under what conditions, how many runs you need before the result means anything, and what outcome would confirm or refute the theory. You'll work with the engineers who run those tests, analyze the results, and close the question with a clear answer and a recommended action.

Beyond individual investigations, you'll build the fleet-level view: baselines for healthy behavior, early warning indicators that catch emerging issues before they cause outages, and reliability estimates that tell us how the population is aging. You'll decide which recurring analyses should become automated monitoring and work with software engineers to make that happen. You'll be the person the team turns to when someone asks "is this normal?" about the fleet.

The ideal candidate is curious about how hardware fails and comfortable with messy data from many sources. They can turn "we're seeing something odd on a few satellites" into a rigorous analysis and a clear recommendation.


What you'll bring:

- Master's degree or above in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, physics, electrical or aerospace engineering, or computer science, or PhD
- 3/5+ years of hands-on experience in an applied or industry setting using Python and SQL to analyze large datasets such as time series, telemetry, sensor, or test data
- Experience applying statistical methods (hypothesis testing, regression, time-series analysis, anomaly detection) to noisy, incomplete real-world data
- Experience building visualizations and dashboards that communicate findings to engineers and decision makers
- Experience framing and solving loosely defined problems, from the first question to a recommendation people act on
- Ability to work with hardware and software engineers and turn their questions into analyses you can actually run

Nice to have:

- Experience analyzing telemetry from satellites, spacecraft, aircraft, vehicles, or other fleets of deployed hardware
- Experience with reliability and failure analysis methods such as survival analysis, Weibull modeling, failure-mode analysis, and root-cause investigation
- Familiarity with electronics or RF hardware, manufacturing test, environmental stress screening (thermal cycling, burn-in, HASS/HALT), or yield analysis
- Experience with pattern-discovery techniques such as clustering, change-point detection, and unsupervised anomaly detection
- Experience with large-scale data tools (Spark, Athena/Presto, Redshift) and AWS
- Experience with visualization tools such as QuickSight, Tableau, Grafana, or Plotly/Dash
- Experience working with software engineers on data pipelines: data requirements, schema design, data quality checks, and automating recurring analyses
- Experience using AI-assisted tools to speed up analysis and automate repetitive work
- A track record of changing engineering design or test decisions with data

Export Control Requirement
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

Key job responsibilities
As a Data Scientist, you will…

- Analyze in-orbit telemetry to measure the health and performance of satellite subsystems, and detect anomalies and slow degradation early
- Correlate in-orbit behavior with pre-launch data, including manufacturing, production test, and environmental test results, to find which ground measurements predict on-orbit performance. Feed those insights back into test limits and screening strategy
- Correlate in-orbit data with what the ground segment sees (gateways, customer terminals) and with failure analysis of lab and returned units
- Connect events across the fleet by build lot, component, configuration, firmware version, orbit, and operating conditions, so we can tell systemic issues apart from one-off events
- Find patterns that point to hardware design weaknesses, measure their impact on the fleet, and present the evidence to hardware engineering teams with clear recommendations
- Build visualizations and dashboards that support decisions in fleet health reviews, anomaly investigations, and design reviews
- Work with software engineers to improve the data pipeline: define data requirements, improve data quality, link ground and in-orbit datasets, and automate recurring analyses
- Own ambiguous investigations end to end, from forming the hypothesis to reporting the outcome to senior engineering leaders


About the team
Phased Array Antenna System Validation is the team that decides whether a satellite's phased array antennas (PAAs) are ready to fly. These are the electronically steered transmit and receive panels that form the link between the satellite and the ground. We're part of Amazon Leo, Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite constellation, and we own the test strategy, the automation, and the data pipeline that every PAA goes through on its way to orbit. That path runs from early component-level screening through full-panel functional testing and extended environmental stress testing across temperature, vacuum, and vibration. Our responsibility doesn't end at launch. We also own the analysis of telemetry from PAAs in orbit, and we use what the constellation tells us to improve how we test on the ground.

We are a hardware-facing software and test team, and we sit where several disciplines meet. Our test automation directs firmware provisioning, self-tests, and environmental profiles on test stations at manufacturing sites. Over a single run it exercises thousands of measurement points: high-speed serial links, clocking, digital beamformer firmware, RF chains, power, and thermal behavior. Every result is tied to a specific serial-numbered part. That builds a detailed, part-level history of how each panel and component behaved under stress, from the factory floor to launch.

A large part of our work is investigation. When something fails, we work out whether the cause is the hardware, the firmware, the test equipment, or our own automation, and we decide what should happen next. Over time we have built a growing catalog of failure signatures and their root causes, internal tools for analyzing long-duration tests, and AI-assisted agents that help turn raw logs into conclusions. We care about evidence over assumption. A label on a result isn't the result itself, and a search that finds nothing doesn't prove the problem has no history. Theories get tested against the data before they're accepted.

We support multiple hardware generations at once, so the architecture, the questions, and the tooling keep changing. You'll work closely with antenna hardware, firmware, manufacturing, and reliability engineers who are glad to dig into a hard problem with you. Because we own both ends, from the first ground test to behavior in orbit, the loop is closed within the team. What we learn from the constellation goes straight back into our screens, thresholds, and test sequences, so that the next panel we validate is more likely to keep working in orbit.

Basic qualifications

- 2+ years of data scientist or similar role involving data extraction, analysis, statistical modeling and communication experience
- 2+ years of data querying languages (e.g. SQL), scripting languages (e.g. Python) or statistical/mathematical software (e.g. R, SAS, Matlab, etc.) experience
- Master's degree in a quantitative field such as statistics, mathematics, data science, business analytics, economics, finance, engineering, or computer science

Preferred qualifications

- Experience diving into data to discover hidden patterns and of conducting error/deviation analysis
- Experience developing experimental and analytic plans for data modeling processes, use of strong baselines, ability to accurately determine cause and effect relations
- Experience applying theoretical models in an applied environment
