title: Process Design Engineer, Quick Commerce Design Engineering
descriptionHtml:
Quick Commerce Process Design is looking for an innovative, solutions-oriented Process Design Engineer to help build the operational processes and standards behind Amazon's next-generation, sub-30-minute delivery network. Do you want a high level of ownership in solving complex, undefined problems? Does the challenge of designing processes and small-format, temperature-controlled fulfillment sites, from the ground up, with no legacy playbook, appeal to you? If so, we have the job for you!

We're looking to add high-impact engineers to our team. In this role, you'll collaborate with internal teams, operations, and external vendors to define, standardize, and document the processes that QC sites run on, and translate them into clean, design-ready inputs for building-design teams. Your work will span a variety of site concepts and template-based design solutions across ambient, chilled, and frozen operations. You'll work alongside a highly skilled, highly engaged team in a fast-paced and often ambiguous greenfield environment.

Key job responsibilities
• Develop Process & Material Handling design solutions for QC sites — process design, material flow, equipment specification, and site layout — supporting modern operations running 24/7.

• Define, standardize, and document operational processes into repeatable modules and design-ready inputs (requirements, volumes/rates, adjacencies, constraints) that building-design teams consume.

• Collaborate with internal teams, external vendors, and stakeholders, including Operations, WHS, and Ergonomics, to produce high-quality, cost-effective solutions on tight timelines.

• Manage multiple projects and tasks concurrently, communicating and coordinating effectively with internal partners, contractors, and vendors.

• Apply data-driven analysis (throughput, rate, capacity, utilization) to evaluate design options and support decisions with clear cost, efficiency, and scalability tradeoffs.

• Partner with Operations to identify pain points, discover problems, and surface improvement opportunities across the value chain.

• Communicate technical solutions and recommendations clearly to partners and leadership.

• Up to 50% travel requirement to visit sites and support projects.

A day in the life
You start your morning with a briefing from your AI assistant, a snapshot pulled from the information sources you've built, surfacing the latest from operations, your ongoing projects, and progress against long-term goals. With priorities clear, you move into deep work: producing high-quality process packages, such as SOPs, policy documents, flow diagrams, and value stream maps, that become the standard sites run on.

Mid-morning, you partner with the tech team to reconcile your time-study and ergonomics findings against real-world data through a dashboard you're building with actual cycle times, error rates, process yield, and DPMO. From there, you shift to a site working on new equipment designed to improve ergonomics and eliminate safety incidents. In the afternoon, you join operations, supply chain, and WHS to shape the process design behind a new initiative.

You close the day by reviewing an AI-generated summary from your project-management systems for the input for next week's leadership business review and prepare for your business trip to the next site to observe, learn, and get feedback from operations.

No two days look the same. You move fluidly between hands-on design, data analysis, cross-functional collaboration, and the standards work that scales across the network.

About the team
The Quick Commerce (QC) Process Design team defines, standardizes, and maintains the operational processes and standards behind Amazon's sub-30-minute delivery network. We own the full lifecycle of a process from diagnosing operational problems, to designing and standardizing the solution, to shaping it into clean, design-ready inputs that building-design teams build from, to maintaining and improving it as the network scales.

Through this ownership, we create standardized, repeatable process and module definitions, spanning ambient, chilled, and frozen operations, that drive efficiency, safety, and speed across the QC network.

Our dedication to standardization and continuous improvement sets the benchmark for how a new, fast-growing quick-commerce business operates by supporting Amazon's commitment to operational excellence and exceptional customer service.

- Bachelor's degree in industrial or manufacturing engineering
- 3+ years of industrial engineer, operations engineer, manufacturing engineer, or project engineer in a manufacturing environment experience
- Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Visio, and MS Project) at an advanced level

Preferred qualifications

- Knowledge of AutoCAD, VBA, and SQL at the intermediate level
- Experience with Six Sigma tools and Lean techniques
- Experience communicating technical concepts to non-technical audiences
- Experience with retrofits, launches, or automation deployments

title: Senior Reliability Engineer, Amazon LEO
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon’s low Earth orbit satellite network. Our mission is to deliver fast, reliable internet connectivity to customers beyond the reach of existing networks. From individual households to schools, hospitals, businesses, and government agencies, Amazon Leo will serve people and organizations operating in locations without reliable connectivity.

Export Control Requirement: Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Reliability Engineer to join the Hardware Reliability Engineering team within the satellite development organization. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electronics manufacturing processes, hardware reliability concepts, and reliability test practices, with a focus on ensuring the functional reliability and performance of satellite hardware systems in the harsh environment of space. You will be responsible for developing and implementing design-for-reliability best practices, conducting rigorous testing, and analyzing on-orbit data to enhance the robustness of Amazon Leo satellite hardware.

You will play an important role across key dimensions of a product’s lifecycle: design trades, product development and release, manufacturing process qualification, supply chain reliability, environmental stress screens, and on-orbit fault and failure investigations. You will be a key member of a high-performance team responsible for delivering a reliable satellite constellation.

Key job responsibilities
Reliability Analysis and Testing:
- Develop and implement reliability test plans for satellite hardware components.
- Perform stress screening, environmental testing, and drive failure analysis to ensure satellite hardware meets reliability and performance targets
- Analyze designs and test results to identify potential failure modes and mitigations.

Design and Development Support:
- Collaborate with design engineers to implement design for reliability best practices.
- Act as a key stakeholder in reviewing and approving designs for release.
- Participate in design reviews and failure mode effects analysis (FMEA) to assess potential reliability issues.

Failure Investigation and Root Cause Analysis:
- Investigate manufacturing non-conformances and field hardware failures to determine root cause. Travel as needed to perform deep dives into supplier processes.
- Develop and recommend corrective actions to address identified reliability issues.
- Maintain detailed records of failure analysis and reliability assessments.

Reliability Modeling and Simulation:
- Utilize reliability modeling and simulation tools to predict hardware performance and lifespan.
- Develop and maintain reliability prediction models and databases.

Documentation and Reporting:
- Prepare detailed reliability reports, test plans, and procedures.
- Present findings and recommendations to engineering teams and management.
- Ensure compliance with industry standards and regulatory requirements for satellite hardware reliability.

Continuous Improvement:
- Stay current with industry trends, advancements, and best practices in hardware reliability engineering.
- Propose and implement process improvements to drive improvements in reliability across the program.

Basic qualifications

- Experience in developing functional specifications, design verification plans and functional test procedures
- Bachelor's degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- 5+ years of experience in hardware reliability engineering, preferably with a focus on satellite systems or space applications.
- Significant knowledge of reliability engineering principles, methods, and tools.
- Knowledge with environmental testing
- Proficiency in failure analysis techniques and materials characterization methods.
- Familiarity with electronics (PCBs, PCBAs, electronic components) and moving mechanical assemblies.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working with interdisciplinary teams to execute product design from concept to production
- Experience with the project management of technical projects
- Master's or Doctorate degree or above in Mechanical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
- Experience with environmental testing, including temperature cycling, vibration, highly accelerated limit testing (HALT), and highly-accelerated stress screening (HASS).
- Proficiency in Python, including NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, Plotly, and Matplotlib.
- Familiarity with PCB fabrication, SMT, and polymerics application manufacturing processes.
- Familiarity with relevant industry standards, including IPC, JEDEC, AIAA, AEC, MIL, and SMC standards.

descriptionHtml:
El Representante Médico en Sitio (OMR, por sus siglas en inglés) es el profesional de salud responsable de la atención médica de primer contacto en el Centro de Distribución o Estación de Entrega. Su función principal es atender lesiones y malestares de los asociados mediante primeros auxilios, identificar de forma proactiva riesgos ergonómicos y de seguridad en las tareas operativas, y contribuir a la implementación del programa de bienestar del sitio.
#AmazonMexico


Key job responsibilities
• Realizar la clasificación inicial (triaje) de asociados que se presenten con lesiones o malestares, brindar primeros auxilios y, cuando sea necesario, canalizarlos a un proveedor médico externo.
• Documentar y mantener actualizados todos los registros de atención médica proporcionada a los asociados.
• Administrar los botiquines de primeros auxilios: llevar el control de inventario, reabastecer insumos y asegurar que el equipo utilizado esté limpio y en condiciones de uso.

title: Sr Program Manager, MX Holiday & Contingency
descriptionHtml:
Want to work at a company that aims to be Earth's most customer-centric? Then meet Amazon. Amazon has spent more than 25 years inventing on behalf of customers and is now one of the world's largest online retailers and marketplaces. Our entrepreneurial culture has produced new products and services such as Echo and Amazon Web Services.

The Holiday and Contingency Planning (HCP) team coordinates Amazon's operational response to holidays, planned events and unplanned contingencies. The goal is to protect the customer experience and limit operational impact, balancing reliability against speed. As a central coordination team, HCP plans and executes network configuration changes that adjust customer promises and package flow, so the network keeps performing and recovers quickly from disruption.

We are hiring an HCP Program Manager in Mexico to own contingency management for the Mexico network and support HCP programs across LATAM. Mexico's network faces many kinds of disruption: national and state holidays, peak events such as Hot Sale and El Buen Fin, Semana Santa and Día de Muertos, hurricanes and floods, road blockades and civil demonstrations, and cross-border (US–MX) flow disruptions. You will work with stakeholders across all miles and lines of business, including Middle Mile/ATS and Relay Operations, Last Mile (AMZL and DSP network), Fulfillment and Sort Centers, First Mile/3P, Regional Planning and Business Continuity teams. You will also partner with Legal, Public Policy, PXT and Tech teams, and with the global HCP team in India and other regions.

We're looking for a hands-on, motivated self-starter who is passionate about using data to make quick decisions and who exemplifies "Bias for Action" and "Are Right, A Lot." The successful candidate has strong analytical and problem-solving skills, is detail-oriented, and is comfortable working with large data sets. They communicate complex analysis clearly, build strong relationships with stakeholders, and drive toward simple, scalable solutions to difficult problems.


Key job responsibilities
- Based in Mexico, or open to relocation
- Own the end-to-end holiday planning & contingency management for Mexico: plan the holiday and event calendar, assess risk, define the network response (promise, capacity and flow changes), execute it, and run post-event reviews.
- Lead real-time response to unplanned disruptions such as weather, blockades and carrier or site outages. Coordinate decisions across miles and drive fast recovery.
- Analyze historical event performance, including delivery experience, promise accuracy, backlog and recovery time. Turn the analysis into recommendations for senior leadership.
- Build and improve the team's reporting tools, mechanisms and processes so internal and external partners get more actionable, granular data.
- Drive the operating cadence: WBR/MBR inputs, goal setting, goal tracking and process improvement for HCP Mexico.
- Standardize and scale HCP mechanisms across LATAM. Bring best practices from other regions and share Mexico learnings with the global team.
- Communicate complex analyses and decisions clearly, in writing and verbally, in Spanish and English, to audiences from operations teams to senior leaders.


A day in the life
You start by checking the risk outlook for the coming days: upcoming holidays, weather alerts and planned demonstrations. You align with Middle Mile, Last Mile and site operations on any network changes needed, then go deeper on data to size a promise adjustment for an upcoming peak or holiday. You might lead a cross-functional event review, write the narrative for leadership, or work with tech partners to automate a manual step in the contingency process. When something unexpected happens, you coordinate the response and keep stakeholders informed until the network recovers.

title: Principal Product Manager - Technical, Prime Air Drone Delivery
descriptionHtml:
Prime Air is Amazon’s drone delivery service, delivering millions of items to customers at ultrafast speeds. We are scaling to serve hundreds of communities and tens of millions of customers. Achieving this takes more than a best-in-class fleet of drones. It also requires a host of safety-critical, highly regulated support operations to keep our fleet healthy, compliant, and efficient. Today these operations are tied to individual sites. However, the size of our mission and the velocity of our growth require we develop a fundamentally different, centralized model.

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Technical to be the single-threaded leader and business owner for that transformation. You will own it end to end: the business case, the solution design, the technology that brings it to life, and the execution and continuity plan across every team that supports live operations. You will set the vision, build and drive the team, and own the outcome. You will be successful when you deliver the support operations that scale safely, at the pace of Amazon, and are durable across changes in drone technology and operating concepts.

The right person is comfortable, but never satisfied, with ambiguity. You bring structure and clarity to unstructured problems, and you earn the trust of specialists across domains even where you are not the deepest expert. No one has done all of this before. The leader who wins here learns fast across unfamiliar territory, imposes structure where there is none, aligns the organization behind a plan, and delivers the solution that unblocks true scale for ultrafast drone delivery.

Key job responsibilities
Define and own the business case for centralization, including the target operating model, regulatory approach, and financial case.

Design the end-to-end solution and define the technology, tooling, and infrastructure required, translating your operational vision into clear technical requirements for cross-functional engineering teams.

Drive execution across all supporting teams, and own the operational continuity plan that protects live operations through the transition.

Build and lead the team that delivers the mission and scale the team as the model matures.

Drive cross-functional alignment to the vision, and secure the commitments needed to deliver it.

Launch the central model in support of our next concept of operations, then raise the bar on the safety, scalability, and efficiency of Prime Air's operations through continued innovation.

title: Senior Solutions Architect, AWS Well-Architected Solutions Innovation
descriptionHtml:
AWS is transforming how customers operate in the cloud. AI agents and human experts now work as one system - proactively optimising architectures, detecting and resolving incidents autonomously, and compounding intelligence over time. We need Solutions Architects who can bring this story to life for customers and the field.

This role combines deep technical expertise with go-to-market instinct. You will lead pre-sales engagements that advance enterprise deals, design and deliver hands-on workshops that accelerate customer adoption, and build the reusable enablement content that scales our impact worldwide. You will serve as the technical escalation point for complex operational and security questions, drive Well-Architected best practices across customer environments, and channel structured field feedback into the product roadmap.

This role has a particular focus on operations, security, compliance, and governance — helping customers navigate the security implications of agentic AI, cloud operations, and responsible AI adoption. You will work across five focus areas: migrations and critical events, emerging product adoption, AWS managed agents, agentic operations and cloud best practices, and AI governance and compliance.

If you thrive at the intersection of product, sales, and engineering - and you want to shape how AWS Support is positioned in the market - this is your role.
You understand your customers' business priorities and leverage that insight to shape their longer-term strategic technology direction. You evaluate architectural trade-offs across Well-Architected pillars, balancing competing priorities while transforming constraints into opportunities to simplify solutions and drive innovation - always grounding your approach in real-world customer challenges and framework best practices. Your work directly influences how thousands of customers architect and operate on AWS, with your patterns and solutions becoming reusable assets that scale across the global organization.

This role suits someone who thrives in ambiguity, moves with velocity, and is equally comfortable writing infrastructure-as-code, presenting architectural strategies to a CTO, or mentoring colleagues through complex design challenges. You bring both technical depth and the communication skills to influence stakeholders at all levels.

Key job responsibilities
- Serve as the technical escalation point for complex operational, security, and support-architecture questions that generalist Solutions Architects cannot resolve alone.
- Lead pre-sales technical engagements alongside business development teams, advancing opportunities through technical validation.
- Lead executive conversations connecting operational excellence, security posture, and compliance readiness to business outcomes.
- Design and deliver hands-on workshops including Well-Architected Framework Reviews, AI-driven operations maturity assessments, AI governance frameworks, agentic AI prototyping sessions, and simulated incident exercises.
- Run hackathons with partners and enterprise customers to drive adoption of new AWS capabilities.
- Build reusable enablement assets: workshops, labs, prototypes, battlecards, and demos that field teams, Technical Account Managers, and partners can deliver at scale.
- Enable and mentor account-aligned Solutions Architects and sales teams on support positioning, Well-Architected best practices, and operational excellence.
- Prototype agentic modules and build maturity frameworks that may feed directly into product roadmaps.
- Author whitepapers, reference architectures, and best-practice guidance.
- Deliver external sessions at AWS events and represent AWS Support at customer briefings and executive business reviews.
- Channel structured customer and field feedback into the product and engineering roadmap.

A day in the life
You might start the morning leading a technical validation call with an enterprise customer exploring how AI agents can transform their operations. By midday you are running a hands-on workshop helping a partner team assess their AI governance readiness. After lunch you are refining a prototype that demonstrates autonomous incident detection, then reviewing a Well-Architected best-practice whitepaper with a colleague. You close the day joining an internal enablement session, sharing field insights with Technical Account Managers and shaping how the team positions AWS Support to the next wave of customers.

About the team
Our Solutions Architecture team sits at the intersection of AWS Support's product portfolio and the customers who depend on it. We do not just talk about best practices — we build the assets, run the workshops, and prototype the solutions that prove them out. We work across migrations, emerging products, managed agents, agentic operations, and AI governance. Our culture is hands-on and builder-oriented. You will write code, create content, and deliver directly to customers — then turn what you learn into mechanisms that scale across the global field organisation.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (gender diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Experience communicating across technical and non-technical audiences, including executive level stakeholders or clients

descriptionHtml:

And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

The AWS Hardware Engineering team is driving rapid innovation in the server and storage infrastructure used by Amazon Web Services. Our designs are industry-leading in frugality and operational excellence, and are critical to the success of the AWS business and the more than one million customers who use AWS today. Our Firmware Engineers solve challenging technology problems, and build architecturally sound, high-quality components to enable AWS to realize critical business strategies.

title: Fraud and Abuse Head, Financial Services Mexico
descriptionHtml:
Lead the end-to-end fraud defense for a financial payment product in Mexico while directly shaping the balance between loss containment, customer experience, and approval rates. If you thrive on making high-stakes decisions with imperfect data and turning fraud signals into actionable rules, this is your opportunity to build and scale a fraud prevention function from the ground up.
As the Fraud Prevention Head, you will design and execute the fraud prevention strategy across three critical stages: account onboarding, transaction monitoring, and post-transaction behavior analysis.
To succeed, you must demonstrate a disciplined, evidence-based approach to rule design—combined with the sound judgment needed to operate under pressure and make critical decisions when information is incomplete. Success in this role is measured by fraud loss, detection and false positive rates and First Payment Default rate attributed to fraud.

Key job responsibilities
You will manage the full ecosystem—including identity verification, biometrics, and document validation—while building and refining fraud rules and models grounded in evidence and data. You will own the loss taxonomy and lead the attribution process between fraud and financial risk in close partnership with the financial Risk team, ensuring clear accountability and precise measurement.

Your scope extends beyond external threats: you will lead the detection of internal fraud in coordination with business partners and the Payment Risk department and manage the disputes to ensure compliance with onboarding rules. You will serve as the primary liaison for incident reporting with Ops, AML, Legal, and Information Security teams, ensuring swift and coordinated responses.

A day in the life
You will monitor and tune the fraud prevention framework. This includes overseeing fraud alerts, following transaction anomaly dashboards, reviewing false positive rates to ensure legitimate customers are not being unnecessarily blocked, assessing detection rate trends against fraud loss targets and tracking First Payment Default cases attributed to fraud. You will analyze data to assess whether newly detected patterns warrant rule adjustments, model recalibrations, or escalation to the identity and biometrics vendors. You will join working sessions with Ops, AML, Legal, and BRP to coordinate active incident investigations, share intelligence on suspicious activity.

About the team
Inclusive team culture
At Amazon we embrace our differences and we are committed to furthering our culture of inclusion. Amazon’s culture of inclusion is reinforced within our 14 Leadership Principles, which remind team members to seek diverse perspectives, learn and be curious, and earn trust.

Work Life Balance
We offer flexibility in working hours and encourage you to find your own balance between your work and personal lives.

Mentorship & Career Growth
Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree or equivalent
- Experience working across functional teams and senior stakeholders
- 5+ years of fraud identification and detection, investigation and analysis for root causing and providing suitable preventive mechanisms, or 5+ years of security service, loss prevention, asset protection, investigations, or law enforcement experience
- Experience in building financial and operational reports/data sets that inform business decision-making, or experience using financial models, KPIs, and data analysis to support business decisions
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English, and have the ability to take direction in English

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in influencing senior leadership through data driven insights
- Experience in SQL Server/MySQL, or experience in Postgres
- Knowledge of identity and validation vendors in Mexico, blacklists, device signals, and geolocation

title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCEO
descriptionHtml:
Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.

Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.

NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.

NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.

Key job responsibilities
- Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
- Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
- Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
- Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
- Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
- Technical writing to support change management program
- Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
- On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
- Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12 hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
- Role may support more than one location/site.
Physical Requirements:
- Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
- Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
- Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
- Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
- Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
- Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection
- This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
Essential Requirements:
- Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed
- Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational
- Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.

A day in the life
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.

Basic qualifications

- Work flexible schedule including weekends, nights, and holidays
- 2+ years of electrical and mechanical facilities maintenance, or 2+ years of electrical facilities maintenance and 1+ years of mechanical facilities maintenance experience
- 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience

Preferred qualifications

- Experience reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

title: Mechatroniker
descriptionHtml:
Das Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) ist für unseren Betrieb von fundamentaler Bedeutung – es sorgt dafür, dass unsere technischen Systeme und Anlagen laufend funktionieren. Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du für die Wartung und Instandhaltung unserer förder- und haustechnischen Anlagen sowie Produktionsanlagen zuständig. Du hilfst, die höchsten Sicherheitsstandards im Arbeitsschutz zu gewährleisten und Maschinenausfallzeiten zu verhindern. Unser technisches Team stellt eine hohe Verfügbarkeit der technischen Anlagen sicher und verbessert die Qualität unserer Geräte.

Key job responsibilities
- Ausführung präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an einer breiten Vielfalt von Geräten an unseren Standorten
- Durchführung von Reparaturen und Fehlerdiagnosen
- Verwendung neuester Tools zur Maximierung der Geräteeffektivität
- Einhaltung aller Arbeitsschutzrichtlinien und -praktiken
- Unterstützung der Entwicklung und des beruflichen Fortschritts von Auszubildenden am Standort
- Arbeit an Projekten zur kontinuierlichen Verbesserung und Einführung von Best Practices an verschiedenen EU-Standorten

A day in the life
Als Instandhaltungstechniker:in bist Du vor Ort in einem unserer Logistikzentren tätig, um schnell auf technische Störungen reagieren zu können. Du führst eine Reihe geplanter präventiver Wartungsmaßnahmen an Geräten durch, um für ihren sicheren Betrieb zu sorgen. Außerdem reagierst Du als Instandhaltungstechniker:in unverzüglich auf Störungen und Ausfälle. Du untersuchst die Ursachen, findest so schnell wie möglich Lösungen und wendest sie an. Zudem machst Du Vorschläge für langfristige Verbesserungen.
In Zusammenarbeit mit leitenden Kolleg:innen nimmst Du tägliche Wartungsaufgaben wahr und kommunizierst mit Dienstleistern, falls Du externe Expertise benötigst. Du arbeitest in rotierenden Schichten, damit wir rund um die Uhr unsere Standorte unterstützen – und dafür sorgen, dass Amazon weiterhin in dem Tempo liefern kann, für das wir bekannt sind.

About the team
Unser Wartungs- und Instandhaltungsteam (Reliability Maintenance Engineering Team oder RME-Team) sorgt dafür, dass unsere Geräte und Ausstattung jederzeit optimal funktionieren. Wir sind ein Team von Techniker:innen und Ingenieur:innen, das aus hervorragenden Teamplayern besteht und von erfahrenen Führungskräften geleitet wird. Wir arbeiten gemeinsam daran, die Geräte in unserem gesamten globalen Netzwerk von Fulfillment-Centern zu warten, zu reparieren und ihre Fehler zu beheben. Einige unserer Mitarbeiter:innen sind Führungskräfte, die das Team bei der Arbeit an spannender, innovativer Technologie beaufsichtigen – die es teilweise nur bei Amazon gibt.

Von der Installation automatisierter Verpackungssysteme bis hin zur Beaufsichtigung der allgemeinen Wartungsarbeiten eines Standorts sowie der Reparatur von für den Vertrieb wesentlichen Geräten wickelt unser Team einen Großteil der technischen Aufgaben bei Amazon ab. Unter anderem sorgt es auch dafür, dass Gebäude weiterhin den rechtlichen Auflagen entsprechen, damit alle sicher bleiben und unsere Standorte mit maximaler Effizienz betrieben werden. Es gibt zahlreiche Aufstiegschancen im RME-Team selbst ebenso wie im gesamten Amazon-Unternehmen.
Alle unsere Aktivitäten sind darauf ausgerichtet, die Ausfallzeiten an Amazons wichtigsten Betriebsstandorten zu reduzieren, damit Kund:innen ihre Bestellungen rechtzeitig erhalten. Oft arbeiten wir früh morgens, spät abends oder in der Nachtschicht, um Wartungsarbeiten mit den geringstmöglichen Störungen vorzunehmen. Falls wir eine bessere Möglichkeit finden, eine bestimmte Aufgabe zu erledigen, verfügen wir über die Fertigkeiten und Gelegenheiten, vollständig neue Prozesse oder bahnbrechende Technologie wie Amazon Robotics oder unseren Complex Item Sorter einzuführen.

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, anerkannt durch die Industrie- und Handelskammer (IHK) oder Handwerkskammer (HWK) oder Nachweis eines erfolgreich abgeschlossen Hochschulstudium im Ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Bereich (Maschinenbau / Elektrotechnik oder artverwandt) einer deutschen Hochschule oder anerkannte ausländische Hochschulabschlüsse (BA, B. Sc., MA, M. Sc., Dipl.-Ing.)
- Mindestens zweijährige Berufserfahrung in dem entsprechenden Handwerk
- Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von industriellen Produktionsanlagen
- Fortgeschrittene Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift

Preferred qualifications

- Erfahrung mit zustandsorientierter Überwachung
- Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Druck- und Applikationsmaschinen
- Erfahrung in der Störungssuche und Wartung von Förder- oder Automationssystemen

title: Customer Solutions Manager, AGS Brazil FSI
descriptionHtml:
As an AWS Customer Solutions Manager, you'll guide customers through their multi-year cloud transformation journey, ensuring seamless collaboration across AWS teams to deliver measurable business outcomes. You'll serve as a trusted advisor, orchestrating strategy and execution while solving complex cloud adoption challenges at scale.

Key job responsibilities
- Partner with customers to understand their cloud adoption goals and guide them through each phase of their transformation journey, from initial planning through operational excellence.
- Coordinate across AWS teams to ensure aligned execution, breaking down silos between sales, support, solutions architecture, and professional services to deliver integrated customer solutions.
- Develop and manage customer engagement plans that translate strategic objectives into actionable milestones, tracking progress and adjusting approaches based on business outcomes.
- Lead customer business reviews and executive briefings that communicate progress, address challenges, and identify opportunities for expanded AWS adoption and innovation.
- Identify and advocate for new AWS services and solutions that address customer needs, bringing creative approaches and tools to solve complex technical and operational challenges.

A day in the life
In this role, you'll work directly with customers navigating their cloud adoption, helping them understand the operational, educational, and governance aspects of their AWS journey. You'll coordinate across multiple AWS teams—including sales, support, solutions architecture, and professional services—to plan and support large-scale workload migrations. Your day might include translating strategic customer initiatives into executable plans, leading business reviews and executive briefings, or facilitating knowledge-sharing sessions that align technical solutions with business goals. You'll also identify opportunities to introduce new AWS services and tools that address emerging customer challenges, working collaboratively with your peers to drive innovation and operational excellence.

About the team
We're a global team dedicated to helping customers succeed in their cloud transformation. Our vision is to make cloud adoption accessible, efficient, and impactful for organizations of all sizes. We work closely with customers across industries, understanding their unique business challenges and helping them unlock the full potential of cloud technology. You'll collaborate with a diverse group of technical experts, account leaders, and customer teams who are committed to delivering exceptional outcomes. We value inclusive perspectives, continuous learning, and a culture where everyone contributes to our shared success. Our team embraces flexibility and supports a healthy balance between work and personal life, recognizing that our best work happens when we're energized and supported both professionally and personally.

Diverse Experiences
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Why AWS?
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Inclusive Team Culture
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Mental Health and Well-Being (MHW), Glamazon, and Women at Amazon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.

Mentorship & Career Growth
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

- Bachelor's degree in engineering, management, or technology, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field

- Experience leading large-scale, technical or engineering programs with a proven record of thought leadership, business case development, realizing customer benefits, and successful program completion experience

title: Software Development Engineer
descriptionHtml:
The Artificial General Intelligence (AGI) team is looking for a passionate, talented, and inventive Software Development Engineer to help advance the quality and capabilities of industry-leading large language models and Generative AI systems.

In this role, you will build scalable solutions for discovering, processing, curating, transforming, and delivering high-value data used across model evaluation, training, and post-training workflows. You will work with large-scale and heterogeneous datasets, including data produced by partner teams, long-context data, and other data sources that can help improve model development.

You will collaborate closely with scientists, ML engineers, evaluation teams, and other engineering teams to identify valuable data sources, understand downstream data requirements, and develop mechanisms that make data easier to discover, standardize, validate, transform, and consume at scale.

Your work will help expand the breadth, quality, and usability of data available for Generative AI development and establish scalable data infrastructure, quality standards, and workflows that enable downstream teams to evaluate and improve models more effectively.

This is an opportunity to solve challenging problems at the intersection of data infrastructure, evaluation data, and Generative AI, and to directly influence the data foundation supporting Amazon’s next generation of AI models and experiences.

Key job responsibilities
Quickly learn and apply emerging technologies, methodologies, and best practices in Generative AI, data processing, and large-scale model development.

Design, build, and maintain scalable platforms and infrastructure for discovering, scanning, processing, curating, and delivering data used to support LLM evaluation, training, and model improvement.

Develop systems and mechanisms to identify useful evaluation data produced by partner teams, understand its characteristics and usability, and make relevant data easier to discover, standardize, validate, and consume.

Expand the breadth and quality of data available for model development, including evaluation datasets, long-context data, training data, and other high-value data sources.

Build scalable capabilities to transform heterogeneous data from different sources and formats into standardized, high-quality datasets that can be reliably consumed by downstream evaluation and training workflows.

Partner closely with Applied Scientists, ML Engineers, evaluation teams, and other engineering teams to understand data needs, identify gaps in available data, and translate those needs into scalable data solutions.

Investigate design approaches, prototype new technologies, evaluate technical feasibility, and drive data infrastructure solutions from concept to production.

Build reliable, high-quality data discovery and processing pipelines that operate at massive scale while improving data quality, coverage, observability, efficiency, and developer productivity.

Influence technical architecture and establish engineering best practices for data discovery, curation, transformation, and delivery across Generative AI model development workflows.

A day in the life
As an SDE with the AGI team, you will build scalable systems that discover, process, curate, transform, and deliver high-value data for model evaluation, training, and post-training workflows.

You will work with large-scale, heterogeneous data sources and partner closely with scientists, ML engineers, and evaluation teams to understand downstream data needs and make useful data easier to identify, standardize, validate, and consume.

You will influence technical architecture, establish engineering best practices, and build reliable infrastructure that improves data quality, usability, and developer productivity across Generative AI model development.

About the team
Join our AGI team and work at the forefront of Generative AI. We build scalable data and model development infrastructure that helps teams discover, process, curate, transform, and use high-value data to support the development of large language models and other foundation models.

You will collaborate with talented engineers and scientists working across model development, evaluation, data, and large-scale distributed systems. Together, we solve challenging technical problems at massive scale and build mechanisms that make valuable data easier to identify, standardize, validate, and consume across evaluation, training, and post-training workflows.

This is an opportunity to influence how next-generation AI systems are developed, expand the breadth and quality of data available to model development teams, and help shape the future of artificial intelligence at Amazon.

Mission of the team:

We build scalable data discovery, curation, transformation, and infusion capabilities that accelerate the development of high-quality foundation models. By identifying high-value data across 1P and other relevant sources—including data produced through evaluation workflows—we make that data easier to discover, standardize, validate, and use across evaluation, training, and post-training.

Our mission is to expand the breadth, quality, and usability of data available for model development, enabling downstream teams to more effectively evaluate models, address data gaps, and improve model performance.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 3+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 3+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 3+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience

title: Data Center Technician (Night Shift), ADC InfraOps DCO
descriptionHtml:
The Infrastructure Operations team is looking for cleared Data Center Technicians to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team. Data Center Technicians are the primary resolver and troubleshoot and solve a range of datacenter infrastructure issues including, but not limited to: hardware, fiber, networking, and related problems.

If you like to use IT principles like computer architecture and the OSI model (Open Systems Interconnection Model) and apply them to finding solutions to problems, we’d like to meet you. Your work will help to maintain one of the world's largest information system infrastructures.

This position requires that the candidate selected be a US Citizen and must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph.

Key job responsibilities
You will be required to engage in physical data center activities with or without reasonable accommodation. This includes all tasks associated with planning and tracking capacity, rack deployment, rack cabling, hardware and software troubleshooting, and rack decommissioning.

These activities include the following:
- Lifting and moving material up to 49 pounds each
- Working in cramped and/or elevated locations
- Bending, lifting, stretching, and reaching
- Standing and walking for up to 8+ hours a day
- Ascending and descending ladders, stairs, and gangways safely and without limitation
- Work in a noisy environment
- Work shifts longer than 8 hours to support 24/7 operations (covering both night and day shifts).

A day in the life
Our Data Center Technician professionals, who have industry-leading technical abilities and demonstrate a breadth of knowledge:
- Take ownership of technical issues brought by their customer base, engaging other teams when needed to drive resolution
- Show a strong aptitude for troubleshooting and problem solving
- Solve problems at their root and step back to understand the broader context
- Maintain service level agreements through the implementation of proactive issue detection and reporting
- Are biased to act in the absence of direction or support
- Improve effectiveness through process innovation

This position will fill an opening at one of multiple separate sites. This position may shift work that will include days/nights/weekends/holidays.

About the team
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. title: Security Industry Specialist II
descriptionHtml:
At AWS, Security is priority zero. AWS Compliance, Assurance, and Privacy Services (CAPS) is looking for a technically deep security controls specialist to serve as a steward for a portfolio of technical security and compliance control areas. These areas are built into how AWS designs, builds, deploys and operates its services, including areas such as secure software development, application security, service resilience and change management. You won't operate the controls yourself. Instead, you'll work with the engineering and service teams who do to clearly capture how their controls are designed, implemented and evidenced. That way, the control's purpose and effectiveness are understood across AWS, from service and leadership teams to the compliance and audit teams who represent those controls externally. You'll make sure the controls in your areas are well defined, technically accurate, consistent with one another, and give the right scope and coverage for AWS's compliance obligations. To do this well, you'll need to understand the underlying engineering mechanisms, such as development pipelines, code review and testing practices, deployment safety and resilience patterns, well enough to judge whether a control works as described. CAPS works across AWS to drive strategic security initiatives, deliver tooling and automation, and support customers in regulated industries such as Healthcare, Finance and Government.

The ideal candidate has hands-on experience with software development, application security or cloud operations practices. They are comfortable with ambiguity, can earn credibility with engineers and technical leaders, and can turn complex technical implementations into clear, accurate control documentation.

Key job responsibilities
In this role, you will:

* Partner with control owners and engineering teams to clearly document how their controls are designed, implemented and evidenced, so internal stakeholders and audit-facing teams understand what each control does and how well it works.*
* Assess the overall shape of your control areas: find gaps, overlaps and conflicts, and make sure controls work together and give appropriate coverage.
* Dive deep into the technical mechanisms behind each control, such as build and deployment pipelines, code review, security testing and resilience mechanisms, to confirm that control descriptions reflect how systems actually work.
* Translate security, regulatory and framework requirements into actionable, testable technical controls in partnership with service teams.
* Build a deep understanding of how AWS services are developed, deployed and operated, and how those practices map to our internal control framework and assessment processes.
* Evaluate the risk profile of emerging AI platforms and capabilities, including AI-assisted development, and reflect those risks in control design and assessment processes.
* Support service, feature and control assessments for customer, regulatory and audit requirements, and give audit-facing teams the technical context they need on control design and intent.
* Identify high-risk areas and work with control owners and service teams to drive remediation and process improvement.
* Help design and deliver tooling and automation that simplifies control documentation, evidence collection and compliance reporting.
* Communicate program status, risks and outcomes to engineering teams and leadership.

A day in the life
* Dive deep into the AWS control environment to understand how controls are implemented, and explain their compliance implications to internal stakeholders and audit-facing teams.
* Set direction for your control areas, improve documentation, track progress, coordinate improvement efforts, and measure whether those improvements are working.
* Build broad domain and technical knowledge of AWS security, including the operational processes and controls that support AWS compliance programs.
* Act as a trusted advisor, facilitator and creative problem solver for control owners and stakeholders.
* Develop and share frameworks, tools and best practices that teams across the organization can adopt.
* Help the teams that work with auditors by explaining how controls are implemented and what they cover, and by applying security, privacy and compliance concepts to a technical cloud environment.
* Communicate program results, including assessment status, workflow, remediation and reporting, to a broad audience that includes peers and senior leaders.

Our organization is responsible for creating and maintaining a high bar for security across all of Amazon's products and services. We offer talented security professionals the chance to accelerate their careers with opportunities to build experience in a wide variety of areas, including cloud, devices, retail, entertainment, healthcare, operations and physical stores.

Training & Career Growth

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve.

- Experience with monitoring and automating security controls.

Our teams build and operate scalable solutions across a wide range of functions, with a focus on customer experience, operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement. Employees work in a fast-paced environment, partnering across teams and geographies to solve complex business problems and deliver results at scale.
Operations as a Service (OaaS enables the business to deliver products and services to customers across the globe. Our teams manage complex, high-volume processes and continuously improve how work is executed through standardization, technology, data, and automation. The role offers an opportunity to work across teams and geographies, solve operational challenges, and drive improvements at scale


Key job responsibilities
• Process Ownership & Execution: Independently learn and execute new processes across test and production environments, meeting defined SLA, productivity, quality, and other business metrics.
• Operational Ownership: Own day-to-day queue and workflow management, ensuring timely resolution, effective prioritization, and consistent delivery against business goals. Manage volume fluctuations and changing priorities without impacting performance.
• Stakeholder Management: Serve as a point of contact for assigned processes; partner with business and operations stakeholders to understand requirements, provide updates, resolve issues, and deliver agreed outcomes.
• Data & Business Reviews: Track and analyze process metrics, identify trends and gaps, and contribute to WBRs, MBRs, QBRs, and other business reviews with relevant insights and actions.
• Problem Solving: Investigate defects and process gaps, perform root-cause analysis, and implement corrective actions. Make sound decisions in ambiguous situations using available data and business context.
• Process Improvement & Automation: Identify process inefficiencies, standardize workflows, and drive best-practice adoption. Identify opportunities to eliminate manual effort through automation and partner with Tech and other teams to implement scalable solutions.
• Documentation & Knowledge Management: Develop and maintain SOPs, process documentation, and workflow mechanisms to support consistent execution and effective knowledge transfer.
• Flexibility to work in 24x7 shift and rotational weekly off

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in any field of study
- 3+ years of experience in operations, program management, or a related field.
- Experience managing stakeholders and communicating with business and operations partners.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to operate in ambiguous environments.
- Experience with process documentation, workflow design, and process improvement.

Preferred qualifications

- Experience in operations transitions, shared services, or centralized operations models.
- Proficiency in Excel, VBA, SQL, dashboards, or workflow tools.
- Experience in supply chain, procurement, compliance, or related operational workflows.
- Experience driving automation, process simplification, or continuous improvement initiatives.

descriptionHtml:
External job description

This role is on the Chronicle team within Selling Partner Services. We own the Turismo product suite, which is powered by Ripple, a dynamic query engine. Turismo is a well loved product, with 15k+ users globally. Ripple is a PrestoDB based query engine that is built to scale, and processes 2M+ queries per week. We are a full stack team, with Product managers, UX designers, TPMs, SDEs, DEs and Data Scientists.

Impact
Ever wondered how Amazon offers the Earth's biggest selection and still manages to offer lower prices every day to our customers? Our retail business teams work with a massive array of vendors and business financial performance metrics to expand selection and drive costs lower. Given the rapid growth of our business, this requires our category leaders, financial analysts, site merchandisers and vendor managers to quickly analyze vendors, categories and brands, diving deep into data showing business efficiency down to the unit sale level. The technology that enables this has huge visibility and impact and is critical to Amazon's continued profitability and growth.

Innovation
We're working on the future. If you are seeking an environment where you can drive innovation. If you want to apply state-of-the-art software technologies to solve real world problems. If you want the satisfaction of providing visible benefit to end-users in an iterative fast paced environment, this is your opportunity. The responsibilities of this role will be key in paving the future of Amazon Retail and transforming how we do business.

Opportunity
You will be part of a team of creative, top-notch engineers who work hard, have fun, and make history.



Key job responsibilities
Strategic & Technical Leadership:

Establish architectural patterns for enterprise analytics solutions

Design technical standards and best practices for analytics delivery

Create frameworks for metrics definition and governance

Lead implementation of strategic analytics initiatives

Drive innovation in analytics capabilities

Solution Development:

Analyze reports and dashboards to determine appropriate migration strategies

Leverage latest technologies to convert legacy report layouts and KPI calculations into modern AWS QuickSight solutions

Design and implement technical solutions with appropriate analytics strategy and data set design

Drive best practices in operational excellence, data modeling, and analysis

Ensure BI solutions correctly and efficiently support the business

Collaboration & Mentorship:

Work closely with business stakeholders to understand their needs and build sophisticated analytics solutions

Mentor team members on architecture and design

Define patterns for self-service analytics platforms

Communicate effectively with management audiences through narratives and business reviews

Basic qualifications

- 5+ years of SQL experience
- Experience programming to extract, transform and clean large (multi-TB) data sets
- Experience with AWS technologies
- Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
- Experience with theory and practice of information retrieval, data science, machine learning and data mining
- Proficiency in ETL processes and data modeling

Preferred qualifications

- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience managing, analyzing and communicating results to senior leadership
- Demonstrated experience leveraging generative AI tools to enhance workflow efficiency and productivity, with the ability to craft effective prompts and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs in a professional setting

descriptionHtml:

Non sono semplici luoghi di lavoro, ma anche la cornice in cui i team si confrontano e collaborano, aiutandoci a offrire sempre il massimo ai clienti. In qualità di Responsabile Area Tecnica / Manutenzione, creerai le condizioni per rendere l’ambiente di lavoro non solo efficiente, ma anche attento al personale. Le tue priorità saranno la gestione e la formazione di un team di tecnici di vasta esperienza per assicurare l’affidabilità delle attrezzature.

Il contratto collettivo nazionale di lavoro applicabile a questo ruolo è Logistica e Trasporti. La posizione è inquadrata al livello 1 o superiore, in base alle competenze, capacità ed esperienza del/della candidato/a.

title: Sys Development Engineer II, AWS Cross Domain Services (CDS)
descriptionHtml:
The AWS Cross Domain Services team is seeking a Systems Development Engineer who is passionate about operational excellence. This engineer will help to operate and scale the services that connect AWS regions of differing security requirements.

An Amazon Dedicated Cloud (ADC) is a collection of AWS regions provided for a customer with specific security requirements. The AWS Cross Domain Services team provides solutions for customers to move data between regions with differing security requirements. We are obsessed with earning and maintaining customer trust. AWS is building some of the largest and most complex distributed systems in the world and the AWS Cross Domain Services team is essential to AWS’s dedicated cloud expansion. We need talented, adaptable engineers to help us implement and operate these complex systems.

As a Systems Development Engineer on the AWS Cross Domain Services team, you will:

- Have the opportunity to leverage the latest cloud computing technologies.
- Improve the availability of cross domain services to better serve U.S. Government agencies.
- Use your strong background in Linux, networking, and cloud services to raise our already high operational excellence bar.
- Operate, automate, and troubleshoot complex systems in partnership with software developer peers.
- Be given opportunities to grow your automation skills and gain a deeper understanding of cloud computing design patterns.

You'll be part of a world-class team in a fast-paced environment that has the entrepreneurial feel of a start-up. This is an opportunity to operate and engineer systems on a massive scale and to gain top-notch experience in cloud computing. You'll be surrounded by people who are smart, passionate about cloud computing, and believe that world class service is critical to customer success. You will be able to measure your success by its visible impact on the efficiency and effectiveness of government services for our nation.

This position requires that the candidate selected must currently possess and maintain an active TS/SCI security clearance with polygraph. The position further requires the candidate to opt into a commensurate clearance for each government agency for which they perform AWS work.


Key job responsibilities
It is “day one” for Amazon’s Dedicated Cloud offerings. We are seeking a talented and motivated Systems Development Engineer eager to: shape the development of infrastructure foundational services, write tools and services to improve automation for deployment and releases, build and maintain test fleets, perform functional and regression testing on software, define and perform stress testing, and monitor production software. We are looking for someone who can build on existing services and architectures and is excited to create new automated solutions.

We are not constrained by how “things are usually done.” You will be encouraged to dive deep into issues and then reinvent systems, processes, and tools as needed to drive continuous improvement for our customers.

A day in the life
Amazon has a fast-paced environment where we “Work Hard, Have Fun, Make History.” On a “typical” day engineers might deep dive to root cause a customer issue, investigate why a metric is trending the wrong way, consult with the top engineers at Amazon, or discuss radical new approaches to automate operational issues.

We’re an agile, innovative team that is dedicated to supporting our new team members. Our team has a broad mix of experience levels and Amazon tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge sharing and mentorship.

About the team
About AWS

Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.

Why AWS?

Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we’re building an environment that celebrates knowledge-sharing and mentorship. Our senior members enjoy one-on-one mentoring and thorough, but kind, code reviews. We care about your career growth and strive to assign projects that help our team members develop your engineering expertise so you feel empowered to take on more complex tasks in the future.

AWS Infrastructure Services (AIS)

AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.

Diverse Experiences

AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.

Inclusive Team Culture

AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.

Mentorship & Career Growth

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.

Work/Life Balance

We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.

Basic qualifications

- Bachelor's degree, or CSSLP (Certified Secure Software Lifecycle Professional)
- 4+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- Current, active US Government Security Clearance of TS/SCI with Polygraph

Preferred qualifications

- 6+ years of administrative experience in networking, storage systems, operating systems and hands-on systems engineering experience
- Experience programming with at least one modern language such as Python, Ruby, Golang, Java, C++, C#, Rust
- Experience utilizing AWS cloud solutions in a DevOps environment

title: Software Development Engineer , Ground Control Console (GC2)
descriptionHtml:
Amazon Leo is Amazon's low Earth orbit satellite network, built to deliver fast, reliable broadband to customers and communities around the world, including places traditional networks don't reach.

As a Software Development Engineer II on the Leo Ground Control Console team, you'll build the services, infrastructure and platform that power the web tools Leo's engineers and operators use every day to run the constellation. That includes mission operations, network health, satellite and ground systems, and leadership views of network performance. You'll own systems end to end, from design and infrastructure as code through production operations.

What you'll do
- Design and build backend services and APIs that connect operator tools to data and systems across Leo's ground and space segments, with a focus on security, reliability and low latency.
- Own the cloud infrastructure behind a shared platform used by many teams: infrastructure as code, deployment pipelines, account and access guardrails, and the shared constructs other teams build on.
- Make the platform fast and dependable at fleet scale. Find where latency and errors come from across services, fix them, and prove the improvement with data.
- Build in observability: metrics, alarms, logging and real-user monitoring, so problems surface before users report them.
- Work with engineering teams across ground and space systems to turn complex mission workflows into robust, well-designed systems.
- Raise the bar on engineering practice: design reviews, automated code review and quality checks, safe deployments, and AI-assisted development workflows that help a small team move quickly without lowering the bar.
- Support high-stakes moments such as launches, on-orbit operations and operational rehearsals, where the systems have to just work.

About you
You care about craft, reliability and the people who depend on what you build. You're comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end, balancing several priorities, and staying calm under pressure. You have strong software engineering fundamentals, experience building and operating distributed systems or cloud services, and you like making complex systems simpler and faster. Experience with infrastructure as code, security, performance tuning or frontend platforms is a plus. Familiarity with space or network systems is welcome but not required; you'll learn the domain here.

Export Control Requirement:
Due to applicable export control laws and regulations, candidates must be a U.S. citizen or national, U.S. permanent resident (i.e., current Green Card holder), or lawfully admitted into the U.S. as a refugee or granted asylum.

About the team
The Leo Ground Control Console team owns the operational tooling used across Amazon Leo, on the ground and in orbit. We build a shared platform that is scalable, reliable, adaptable and fast, so every team at Leo can deliver tools their users rely on. We're a small, high-ownership team that ships quickly, measures its impact, and invests in the tools and practices that make the whole organization more productive.

Key job responsibilities
Key job responsibilities
- Design, build, test and operate backend services, APIs and infrastructure for Amazon Leo's operator and leadership tools, from design through production support.
- Own the platform's cloud infrastructure and deployment pipelines as code, including the shared building blocks and guardrails other teams depend on.
- Measure and improve the latency, reliability and cost of services and their dependencies, and make them resilient to slow or failing systems.
- Add metrics, alarms and logging to what you ship, and use the data to prioritize improvements and show their impact.
- Partner with engineers, operators and product owners across ground and space systems to understand requirements and turn them into well-designed solutions.
- Write high-quality, well-tested code, review others' changes, and help define the team's design standards, security practices and automated quality checks.
- Improve developer productivity through better tooling, CI/CD, test automation and AI-assisted development workflows.
- Participate in on-call and support launches, on-orbit operations and operational rehearsals.

About the team
The Ground Control Console team owns the operational tooling platform used across Project Leo to support all aspects of the mission, both on the ground and in orbit. We prioritize building a platform that is scalable, reliable, adaptable and performant in order to provide our customers with tools and support that they have come to rely on for the mission's ongoing success.

Basic qualifications

- 3+ years of non-internship professional software development experience
- 2+ years of non-internship design or architecture (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems experience
- 1+ years of software development engineer or related occupational experience
- 1+ years of designing and developing large-scale, multi-tiered, multi-threaded, embedded or distributed software applications, tools, systems, and services using: C#, C++, Java, or Perl experience
- 1+ years of Object Oriented Design experience
- Bachelor's degree or foreign equivalent in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, or a related field
- Experience programming with at least one software programming language

Preferred qualifications

- 3+ years of full software development life cycle, including coding standards, code reviews, source control management, build processes, testing, and operations experience
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
